with site_context as (
    -- Keep operating sites and expose map attributes as columns.
    select
        site_id,
        site_name,
        region,
        capacity_mw,
        element_at(operational_tags, 'owner') as owner,
        element_at(operational_tags, 'tracking_mode') as tracking_mode
    from solar_sites
    where coalesce(element_at(operational_tags, 'status'), 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE'
),
metric_rows as (
    -- Explode metric structs and derive report-level quality signals.
    select
        r.report_id,
        r.site_id,
        r.report_date,
        item.metric,
        item.metric_value,
        size(filter(r.daily_metrics, x -> x.metric_value is not null)) as reported_metric_count,
        array_join(
            transform(
                filter(r.daily_metrics, x -> x.metric_value is not null),
                x -> x.metric
            ),
            ','
        ) as reported_metrics,
        exists(
            r.daily_metrics,
            x -> x.metric = 'AC_MWH' and x.metric_value > cast(30 as decimal(12,3))
        ) as high_output_day,
        from_json(
            r.telemetry_json,
            'struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>'
        ).curtailment_mwh as curtailment_mwh,
        from_json(
            r.telemetry_json,
            'struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>'
        ).grid_frequency_hz as grid_frequency_hz,
        from_json(
            r.telemetry_json,
            'struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>'
        ).data_quality as data_quality
    from generation_reports r
    lateral view explode(r.daily_metrics) as item
    where r.report_date between date '2025-03-01' and date '2025-03-03'
),
daily_metrics as (
    -- Pivot the long metric series into one row per daily report.
    select
        report_id,
        site_id,
        report_date,
        reported_metric_count,
        reported_metrics,
        high_output_day,
        curtailment_mwh,
        grid_frequency_hz,
        data_quality,
        ac_mwh,
        poa_irradiance,
        availability_pct
    from metric_rows
    pivot (
        max(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'AC_MWH' as ac_mwh,
            'POA_IRRADIANCE' as poa_irradiance,
            'AVAILABILITY_PCT' as availability_pct
        )
    )
),
outage_snapshots as (
    -- Retain the latest outage started on each site and day.
    select
        site_id,
        to_date(started_at) as outage_date,
        outage_id,
        cause_code,
        round(
            (unix_timestamp(ended_at) - unix_timestamp(started_at)) / 3600.0,
            1
        ) as duration_hours,
        cast(get_json_object(event_json, '$.lost_mwh') as decimal(10,2)) as lost_mwh,
        get_json_object(event_json, '$.severity') as severity
    from outage_events
    where to_date(started_at) between date '2025-03-01' and date '2025-03-03'
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by site_id, to_date(started_at)
        order by started_at desc, outage_id desc
    ) = 1
),
latest_inspection as (
    -- Choose the newest deterministic inspection record for every site.
    select
        site_id,
        inspected_at,
        inspection_score,
        passed
    from field_inspections
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by site_id
        order by inspected_at desc, inspection_id desc
    ) = 1
),
scored_days as (
    -- Enrich daily production with site, outage, and inspection context.
    select
        a.*,
        s.site_name,
        s.region,
        s.owner,
        s.tracking_mode,
        s.capacity_mw,
        o.outage_id,
        o.cause_code,
        o.duration_hours,
        o.lost_mwh,
        o.severity,
        i.inspected_at,
        i.inspection_score,
        i.passed,
        round(a.ac_mwh / s.capacity_mw, 3) as specific_yield,
        case
            when a.data_quality <> 'OK' then 'REVIEW'
            when o.severity = 'HIGH' then 'OUTAGE'
            when coalesce(i.passed, false) = false then 'INSPECT'
            when a.availability_pct < 95 then 'LOW_AVAILABILITY'
            else 'NORMAL'
        end as performance_flag
    from daily_metrics a
    join site_context s
        on s.site_id = a.site_id
    left join outage_snapshots o
        on o.site_id = a.site_id
       and o.outage_date = a.report_date
    left join latest_inspection i
        on i.site_id = a.site_id
)
select *
from scored_days
where reported_metric_count >= 2
order by
    performance_flag asc,
    report_date desc,
    specific_yield desc nulls last,
    site_id asc nulls last

WITH normalized_events AS (
    -- Keep billable-period activity and decode the client-supplied JSON payload.
    SELECT
        event_id,
        acct_id,
        actor_id,
        occurred_at,
        feature_nm,
        qty,
        from_json(
            properties_json,
            'struct<client:string,source:string,billable:boolean>'
        ) AS event_props
    FROM feature_usage
    WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND qty > 0
),
flagged_events AS (
    -- Attach at most one rollout window, allowing a 36-hour observation grace period.
    SELECT
        u.*,
        fw.window_id,
        element_at(fw.targeting, 'cohort') AS matched_cohort,
        CASE
            WHEN fw.window_id IS NULL THEN 'BASELINE'
            WHEN coalesce(u.event_props.billable, TRUE) = FALSE THEN 'TRIAL'
            WHEN element_at(fw.targeting, 'cohort') = 'enterprise' THEN 'CONTROLLED'
            ELSE 'ROLLED_OUT'
        END AS rollout_state
    FROM normalized_events u
    LEFT JOIN flag_windows fw
      ON u.acct_id = fw.acct_id
     AND u.feature_nm = fw.feature_nm
     AND u.occurred_at BETWEEN fw.starts_at
                           AND fw.ends_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR
),
entitlement_grants AS (
    -- Flatten each account bundle and remove disabled feature grants.
    SELECT
        b.acct_id,
        item.feature_nm,
        item.state AS entitlement_state,
        item.seat_cap
    FROM entitlement_bundles b
    LATERAL VIEW explode(b.entitlements) AS item
    WHERE item.state IN ('ENABLED', 'LIMITED')
),
feature_totals AS (
    -- Create one usage column per product surface for account-level comparisons.
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT acct_id, feature_nm, qty
        FROM normalized_events
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        sum(qty) AS qty
        FOR feature_nm IN (
            'DASHBOARD' AS dashboard,
            'BOARD' AS board,
            'API_CALL' AS api_call
        )
    )
)
-- Enrich each usage event with subscription, entitlement, and account total context.
SELECT
    fe.*,
    a.acct_nm,
    a.plan_nm,
    a.billing_profile.country AS billing_country,
    a.billing_profile.segment AS customer_segment,
    element_at(a.quotas, 'API_CALL') AS api_quota,
    coalesce(eg.entitlement_state, 'MISSING') AS entitlement_state,
    eg.seat_cap,
    coalesce(p.dashboard, 0) AS dashboard_qty,
    coalesce(p.board, 0) AS board_qty,
    coalesce(p.api_call, 0) AS api_call_qty,
    CASE
        WHEN eg.entitlement_state IS NULL THEN 'NO_ENTITLEMENT'
        WHEN eg.entitlement_state = 'LIMITED' THEN 'CAPPED'
        WHEN fe.qty > coalesce(eg.seat_cap, 0) THEN 'OVER_CAP'
        WHEN nullif(fe.matched_cohort, '') IS NULL THEN 'STANDARD'
        ELSE 'ENTITLED'
    END AS access_label
FROM flagged_events fe
LEFT JOIN acct_subscriptions a
  ON fe.acct_id = a.acct_id
LEFT JOIN feature_totals p
  ON fe.acct_id = p.acct_id
LEFT JOIN entitlement_grants eg
  ON fe.acct_id = eg.acct_id
 AND fe.feature_nm = eg.feature_nm
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, event_id DESC

    .join(entitlement_grants.alias("eg"), (F.col("fe.acct_id") == F.col("eg.acct_id")) & (F.col("fe.feature_nm") == F.col("eg.feature_nm")), "left")

        F.coalesce(F.col("p.dashboard"), F.lit(0)).alias("dashboard_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.board"), F.lit(0)).alias("board_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.api_call"), F.lit(0)).alias("api_call_qty"),

with charge_rows as (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes the missing optional fees.
    select pnr, acct_id, booked_ts, origin, destination, cabin,
           booking_status, distance_miles, charge_type, charge_amt
    from flight_bookings
    unpivot (
        charge_amt for charge_type in (
            base_fare as BASE, tax_amt as TAX, fee_amt as FEE
        )
    )
    where booking_status in ('CONFIRMED', 'FLOWN')
),
booking_rollup as (
    select pnr, acct_id, booked_ts, origin, destination, cabin,
           booking_status, distance_miles,
           cast(coalesce(sum(charge_amt) filter (where charge_type = 'BASE'), 0)
                as decimal(12,2)) as base_paid,
           cast(coalesce(sum(charge_amt) filter (where charge_type = 'FEE'), 0)
                as decimal(12,2)) as fee_paid,
           cast(sum(charge_amt) as decimal(12,2)) as total_paid,
           round(sum(charge_amt) / nullif(distance_miles, 0), 4) as cost_per_mile
    from charge_rows
    group by pnr, acct_id, booked_ts, origin, destination, cabin,
             booking_status, distance_miles
),
points_pivot as (
    select acct_id,
           coalesce(base_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as base_points,
           coalesce(bonus_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as bonus_points,
           coalesce(redeem_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as redeem_points
    from (
        select acct_id, metric, points
        from loyalty_txn
        where txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    ) txn
    pivot (
        sum(points) for metric in (
            'BASE' as base_points, 'BONUS' as bonus_points,
            'REDEEM' as redeem_points
        )
    )
),
enriched as (
    select bk.*, acct.cust_name, acct.tier,
           acct.contact.home_city as home_city,
           coalesce(nullif(acct.contact.email, ''), 'not-on-file') as contact_email,
           coalesce(element_at(acct.profile_map, 'vip_flag'), 'NO') as vip_flag,
           case
               when bk.cost_per_mile is null then 'UNRATED'
               when bk.cost_per_mile >= 0.18 then 'PREMIUM_YIELD'
               when bk.cost_per_mile >= 0.12 then 'STANDARD_YIELD'
               else 'VALUE_YIELD'
           end as yield_band
    from booking_rollup bk
    join loyalty_accounts acct
      on acct.acct_id = bk.acct_id
     and acct.acct_status = 'ACTIVE'
),
account_summary as (
    select e.acct_id, e.cust_name, e.tier, e.home_city, e.contact_email, e.vip_flag,
           count(*) as booking_qty,
           count(*) filter (where e.booking_status = 'FLOWN') as flown_qty,
           cast(round(sum(e.total_paid), 2) as decimal(12,2)) as total_spend,
           round(avg(e.cost_per_mile), 4) as avg_cost_per_mile,
           array_sort(collect_list(distinct e.cabin)) as cabins,
           size(collect_set(e.origin)) as origin_qty,
           max(coalesce(pp.base_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) as base_points,
           max(coalesce(pp.bonus_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) as bonus_points,
           max(coalesce(pp.redeem_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) as redeem_points,
           floor(max(coalesce(pp.base_points, 0)) / 1000) as base_point_thousands,
           ceil(sum(e.distance_miles) / 1000) as distance_thousands,
           max(coalesce(pp.base_points, 0))
             + max(coalesce(pp.bonus_points, 0))
             + max(coalesce(pp.redeem_points, 0)) as net_points
    from enriched e
    left join points_pivot pp on pp.acct_id = e.acct_id
    group by e.acct_id, e.cust_name, e.tier, e.home_city, e.contact_email, e.vip_flag
)
select s.acct_id, s.cust_name, s.tier, s.home_city, s.contact_email, s.vip_flag,
       s.booking_qty, s.flown_qty, s.cabins, s.origin_qty,
       s.total_spend, s.avg_cost_per_mile,
       round(s.total_spend / nullif(s.booking_qty, 0), 2) as avg_booking_spend,
       s.base_points, s.bonus_points, s.redeem_points, s.net_points,
       s.base_point_thousands, s.distance_thousands,
       case
           when s.net_points >= 12000 and s.total_spend >= 1200 then 'ANCHOR'
           when s.net_points >= 8000 or s.total_spend >= 800 then 'GROWTH'
           when s.net_points >= 1500 and s.total_spend >= 150 then 'STEADY'
           else 'NURTURE'
       end as loyalty_segment,
       -- Numeric RANGE deliberately uses spend rather than a row-count frame.
       sum(s.total_spend) over (
           order by s.total_spend range between 300 preceding and current row
       ) as nearby_spend,
       ntile(3) over (order by s.total_spend desc, s.acct_id) as spend_tercile,
       round(percent_rank() over (order by s.net_points desc, s.acct_id), 3)
           as points_percent_rank,
       round(cume_dist() over (order by s.total_spend desc, s.acct_id), 3)
           as spend_cume_dist,
       dense_rank() over (order by s.total_spend desc) as spend_rank
from account_summary s
order by s.total_spend desc, s.acct_id

WITH normalized_leases AS (
    SELECT
        l.lease_id,
        l.property_id,
        l.unit_number,
        l.tenant_id,
        l.lease_start_date,
        l.lease_end_date,
        l.monthly_rent,
        l.deposit_amount,
        l.status,
        FROM_JSON(
            l.preferences_json,
            'STRUCT<autopay:BOOLEAN,insurance_required:BOOLEAN,pet_count:INT>'
        ) AS lease_preferences,
        -- Zero-value lines and credits do not belong in the charge schedule.
        FILTER(l.charge_schedule, charge -> charge.amount > 0) AS billable_charges,
        t.contact.primary_email AS primary_email,
        t.contact.emergency_phone AS emergency_phone,
        t.risk_tier,
        p.city,
        p.management_tier
    FROM lease_contracts l
    LEFT JOIN tenants t
        ON t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id
    JOIN properties p
        ON p.property_id = l.property_id
       AND p.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE l.lease_end_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND l.status <> 'draft'
),
charge_rows AS (
    SELECT
        nl.lease_id,
        nl.property_id,
        item.charge_type,
        item.amount,
        item.due_date,
        CASE
            WHEN item.due_date < nl.lease_start_date THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
            ELSE item.amount
        END AS recognized_amount
    FROM normalized_leases nl
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(nl.billable_charges) charges AS item
),
lease_charge_summary AS (
    SELECT
        lease_id,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(charge_type)) AS charge_types,
        SUM(recognized_amount) AS scheduled_charge_total,
        COUNT(*) AS charge_line_count
    FROM charge_rows
    GROUP BY lease_id
),
utility_long AS (
    SELECT
        property_id,
        billing_month,
        utility_type,
        utility_amount
    FROM utility_statements
    UNPIVOT (
        utility_amount FOR utility_type IN (
            water_amount,
            common_area_amount,
            parking_amount
        )
    )
),
utility_summary AS (
    SELECT
        property_id,
        SUM(utility_amount) AS property_utility_total,
        COUNT(*) AS reported_utility_lines,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN utility_type = 'water_amount' THEN utility_amount ELSE 0 END
        ) AS water_total
    FROM utility_long
    WHERE billing_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    GROUP BY property_id
),
reporting_rows AS (
    SELECT
        nl.*,
        cs.charge_types,
        cs.scheduled_charge_total,
        cs.charge_line_count,
        us.property_utility_total,
        us.reported_utility_lines
    FROM normalized_leases nl
    LEFT JOIN lease_charge_summary cs
        ON cs.lease_id = nl.lease_id
    LEFT JOIN utility_summary us
        ON us.property_id = nl.property_id
)
SELECT
    lease_id,
    property_id,
    unit_number,
    city,
    primary_email,
    emergency_phone,
    status,
    monthly_rent,
    COALESCE(lease_preferences.autopay, FALSE) AS autopay_enabled,
    CASE
        WHEN lease_preferences.pet_count IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
        WHEN lease_preferences.pet_count = 0 THEN 'no_pets'
        ELSE 'pets'
    END AS pet_policy,

    COALESCE(property_utility_total, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS property_utility_total,
    -- Rent bands include every lease within 250 dollars on either side.

        ),
        2
    ) AS rent_vs_nearby_avg,
    COALESCE(charge_line_count, 0) AS charge_line_count
FROM reporting_rows
ORDER BY property_id, lease_id

with send_blocks as (
    -- flatten creative blocks before rolling each send back up
    select
        s.send_id,
        s.subscriber_id,
        s.newsletter_id,
        s.sent_at,
        s.delivery_context.region as delivery_region,
        coalesce(element_at(s.experiment_tags, 'variant'), 'unassigned') as variant,
        blk.block_code,
        blk.block_weight,
        blk.is_primary
    from newsletter_send_log s
    lateral view explode(s.content_blocks) as blk
    where s.send_status = 'delivered'
      and s.sent_at >= timestamp '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
      and s.sent_at < timestamp '2025-04-16 00:00:00'
      and s.delivery_context.region in ('US', 'CA')
),
send_rollup as (
    select
        send_id,
        subscriber_id,
        newsletter_id,
        sent_at,
        delivery_region,
        variant,
        count(distinct block_code) as creative_block_count,
        sum(block_weight) as block_weight_total,
        max(case when is_primary then block_code end) as primary_block_code
    from send_blocks
    group by
        send_id,
        subscriber_id,
        newsletter_id,
        sent_at,
        delivery_region,
        variant
),
send_enriched as (
    select
        sr.*,
        nc.newsletter_title,
        sd.email
    from send_rollup sr
    join newsletter_catalog nc
      on nc.newsletter_id = sr.newsletter_id
     and nc.is_active = true
    join subscriber_directory sd
      on sd.subscriber_id = sr.subscriber_id
     and sd.consent_status = 'subscribed'
),
open_steps as (
    select
        oe.open_id,
        oe.send_id,
        oe.subscriber_id,
        oe.opened_at,
        from_json(
            oe.payload_json,
            'event_type string, engaged_seconds int, client string'
        ).engaged_seconds as engaged_seconds,
        lag(oe.opened_at) over (
            partition by oe.subscriber_id
            order by oe.opened_at, oe.open_id
        ) as prior_opened_at
    from newsletter_open_events oe
    join send_enriched se
      on se.send_id = oe.send_id
     and se.subscriber_id = oe.subscriber_id
    where from_json(
              oe.payload_json,
              'event_type string, engaged_seconds int, client string'
          ).event_type = 'open'
      and lower(oe.user_agent) not like '%bot%'
),
open_sessions as (
    select
        flagged.*,
        sum(flagged.new_session_flag) over (
            partition by flagged.subscriber_id
            order by flagged.opened_at, flagged.open_id
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row
        ) as session_id
    from (
        -- a thirty-minute quiet period starts a new reading session
        select
            open_steps.*,
            case
                when prior_opened_at is null then 1
                when unix_timestamp(opened_at) - unix_timestamp(prior_opened_at) > 1800 then 1
                else 0
            end as new_session_flag
        from open_steps
    ) flagged
),
session_metrics as (
    select
        se.newsletter_id,
        se.newsletter_title,
        os.subscriber_id,
        se.email,
        os.session_id,
        min(os.opened_at) as session_start_at,
        max(os.opened_at) as session_end_at,
        count(distinct os.open_id) as open_count,
        count(distinct os.send_id) as opened_send_count,
        sum(distinct os.engaged_seconds) as distinct_engaged_seconds,
        max(se.variant) as experiment_variant
    from open_sessions os
    join send_enriched se
      on se.send_id = os.send_id
     and se.subscriber_id = os.subscriber_id
    group by
        se.newsletter_id,
        se.newsletter_title,
        os.subscriber_id,
        se.email,
        os.session_id
)
select
    newsletter_id,
    newsletter_title,
    subscriber_id,
    email,
    session_id,
    session_start_at,
    session_end_at,
    open_count,
    opened_send_count,
    distinct_engaged_seconds,
    experiment_variant,
    cast(
        (unix_timestamp(session_end_at) - unix_timestamp(session_start_at)) / 60
        as int
    ) as session_duration_minutes,
    case
        when coalesce(distinct_engaged_seconds, 0) >= 40
             and open_count >= 2 then 'high'
        when coalesce(distinct_engaged_seconds, 0) > 0 then 'medium'
        else 'low'
    end as engagement_band,
    (select count(distinct send_id) from send_enriched) as eligible_send_count
from session_metrics
order by session_start_at, subscriber_id, newsletter_id, session_id

        ) as has_amplified_sound,
        coalesce(

    from permit_txn p

        on e.park_id = p.park_id

/*
  CI/CD reliability snapshot.
  Normalizes run-level test metrics and compares runs with similar durations.
  Release windows include a one-day grace period for late-running pipelines.
*/
WITH staged_runs AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        service_id,
        commit_sha,
        branch_name,
        run_status,
        triggered_at,
        COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS effective_finished_at,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            MINUTE,
            triggered_at,
            COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR)
        ) AS duration_minutes,
        date_trunc('DAY', triggered_at) AS run_day,
        DATEDIFF(
            CAST(COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS DATE),
            CAST(triggered_at AS DATE)
        ) AS calendar_days_spanned,
        element_at(runner_labels, 'runner_pool') AS runner_pool,
        code_coverage,
        code_coverage >= (
            SELECT AVG(code_coverage)
            FROM stg_pipeline_runs
            WHERE run_status = 'SUCCESS'
        ) AS coverage_above_baseline
    FROM stg_pipeline_runs
    WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
),
run_context AS (
    -- The non-equi join also catches runs just after a release window closes.
    SELECT r.*, w.window_name, w.risk_weight
    FROM staged_runs r
    LEFT JOIN dim_release_windows w
      ON r.service_id = w.service_id
     AND r.triggered_at BETWEEN w.window_start
                            AND w.window_end + INTERVAL '1' DAY
),
test_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT test_id) AS total_tests,
        COUNT(DISTINCT suite_name) AS suite_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result_status = 'FAILED') AS failed_tests,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result_status = 'FLAKY') AS flaky_tests,
        SUM(DISTINCT duration_ms) AS distinct_runtime_ms_total
    FROM stg_test_executions
    GROUP BY run_id
),
scored_runs AS (
    SELECT
        rc.*,
        tm.total_tests,
        tm.suite_count,
        tm.failed_tests,
        tm.flaky_tests,
        tm.distinct_runtime_ms_total,
        sc.service_name,
        sc.owning_team,
        ROUND(
            rc.duration_minutes * COALESCE(rc.risk_weight, CAST(1.00 AS DECIMAL(4,2))),
            2
        ) AS risk_adjusted_duration,
        SUM(rc.duration_minutes) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rc.service_id
            ORDER BY rc.duration_minutes
            RANGE BETWEEN 15 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_duration_minutes
    FROM run_context rc
    LEFT JOIN test_metrics tm ON tm.run_id = rc.run_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_service_catalog sc ON sc.service_id = rc.service_id
),
metric_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL metrics for runs without test executions.
    SELECT
        run_id,
        service_id,
        service_name,
        owning_team,
        branch_name,
        run_day,
        runner_pool,
        window_name,
        duration_minutes,
        calendar_days_spanned,
        coverage_above_baseline,
        nearby_duration_minutes,
        risk_adjusted_duration,
        metric_name,
        metric_value
    FROM scored_runs
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            total_tests,
            failed_tests,
            distinct_runtime_ms_total
        )
    )
)
SELECT
    run_id,
    service_id,
    service_name,
    owning_team,
    branch_name,
    run_day,
    runner_pool,
    window_name,
    duration_minutes,
    calendar_days_spanned,
    coverage_above_baseline,
    nearby_duration_minutes,
    risk_adjusted_duration,
    metric_name,
    metric_value
FROM metric_long
ORDER BY run_id, metric_name

/*
  March charging-session audit.
  Produces long-form operational metrics with component charges and site context.
*/
WITH parsed_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        s.session_id,
        s.station_id,
        s.driver_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.energy_kwh,
        s.session_status,
        s.charge_items,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.started_at) AS usage_hour,
        s.started_at + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE AS grace_ends_at,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            MINUTE,
            s.started_at,
            COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE)
        ) AS billed_minutes,
        DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(s.ended_at), TO_DATE(s.started_at)) AS calendar_span_days,
        CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(s.vehicle_json, '$.battery_kwh') AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS battery_kwh,
        ELEMENT_AT(s.session_tags, 'membership') AS membership_tier,
        -- Discounts and non-positive components are excluded from this control total.
        AGGREGATE(
            FILTER(
                s.charge_items,
                item -> item.amount > CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                    AND item.component <> 'discount'
            ),
            CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
            (acc, item) -> acc + CAST(item.amount AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS positive_item_total
    FROM charging_sessions s
    WHERE s.started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
),
component_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.session_id,
        ROUND(SUM(
            CASE WHEN item.component = 'discount' THEN -item.amount ELSE item.amount END
        ), 2) AS net_component_total,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(item.component)) AS component_names
    FROM parsed_sessions p
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(p.charge_items) AS item
    GROUP BY p.session_id
),
session_options AS (
    SELECT p.*, c.net_component_total, c.component_names
    FROM parsed_sessions p
    LEFT JOIN component_totals c ON c.session_id = p.session_id
),
selected_sessions AS (
    -- Normal billable sessions use the best available component control total.
    SELECT
        session_id, station_id, driver_id, usage_hour, grace_ends_at,
        session_status, membership_tier, battery_kwh, calendar_span_days,
        component_names,
        CAST(energy_kwh AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(billed_minutes AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS billed_minutes,
        CAST(COALESCE(net_component_total, positive_item_total, 0) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS extra_charges,
        'STANDARD' AS audit_lane
    FROM session_options
    WHERE session_status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND energy_kwh >= CAST(12 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
    UNION ALL
    -- Non-completed sessions are retained only when they consumed time or energy.
    SELECT
        session_id, station_id, driver_id, usage_hour, grace_ends_at,
        session_status, membership_tier, battery_kwh, calendar_span_days,
        component_names,
        CAST(energy_kwh AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(billed_minutes AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS billed_minutes,
        CAST(net_component_total AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS extra_charges,
        'ATTENTION' AS audit_lane
    FROM session_options
    WHERE session_status <> 'COMPLETED'
      AND (billed_minutes >= 30 OR energy_kwh > CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
),
metric_rows AS (
    SELECT *

with parsed_students as (
    -- Decode advising JSON and expose the student's notification channels.
    select student_id,
           student_name,
           program_code,
           acct_status,
           from_json(attrs_json, 'advisor string, scholarship boolean, prior_failures int') as profile,
           element_at(contact_prefs, 'email') as preferred_email,
           map_keys(contact_prefs) as contact_channels
    from student_accts
),
current_enrollments as (
    -- Keep active, unheld registrations and choose each student's latest course txn.
    select e.*,
           sec.course_code,
           sec.course_title,
           sec.dept_code,
           sec.term_code,
           ps.student_name,
           ps.profile.advisor as advisor_name,
           ps.profile.scholarship as scholarship,
           ps.preferred_email,
           ps.contact_channels,
           aggregate(
               transform(
                   filter(e.assessments, x -> x.item_type = 'lab'),
                   x -> cast(x.score as double) / cast(x.max_score as double)
               ),
               cast(0 as double),
               (acc, x) -> acc + x
           ) as lab_score_sum,
           exists(e.assessments, x -> cast(x.score as double) < cast(x.max_score as double) * 0.6) as has_low_assessment
    from enrollment_txns e
    join course_sections sec
      on sec.section_id = e.section_id
    join parsed_students ps
      on ps.student_id = e.student_id
    left join registration_holds h
      on h.student_id = e.student_id
     and h.section_id = e.section_id
     and h.is_active = true
    where h.hold_id is null
      and e.status in ('enrolled', 'completed')
      and ps.acct_status = 'active'
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by e.student_id, sec.course_code
        order by e.enrolled_at desc, e.txn_id desc
    ) = 1
),
component_scores as (
    -- Unpivot the three grade columns; SQL unpivot removes null scores.
    select txn_id,
           avg(score_value) as avg_component_score,
           count(score_value) filter (where score_value >= 70) as passing_component_qty
    from current_enrollments
    unpivot (
        score_value for score_component in (midterm_score, final_score, project_score)
    ) as u
    group by txn_id
),
assessment_stats as (
    -- Explode rubric structs and summarize the individual assessment items.
    select txn_id,
           count(*) as assessment_qty,
           round(avg(cast(item.score as double) / cast(item.max_score as double) * 100), 2) as assessment_avg_pct,
           count(*) filter (where item.item_type = 'lab') as lab_qty
    from enrollment_txns
    lateral view explode(assessments) as item
    group by txn_id
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach component and rubric metrics without losing missing assessments.
    select ce.*,
           cs.avg_component_score,
           coalesce(cs.passing_component_qty, 0) as passing_component_qty,
           ast.assessment_qty,
           coalesce(ast.assessment_avg_pct, 0.0) as assessment_avg_pct,
           coalesce(ast.lab_qty, 0) as lab_qty
    from current_enrollments ce
    left join component_scores cs on cs.txn_id = ce.txn_id
    left join assessment_stats ast on ast.txn_id = ce.txn_id
)
-- Produce section, department, and campus totals in one rollup.
select grouping_id(dept_code, section_id) as grouping_id,
       case grouping_id(dept_code, section_id)
           when 0 then 'section'
           when 1 then 'department'
           else 'campus'
       end as group_level,
       dept_code,
       section_id,
       max(course_code) as course_code,
       count(*) as enrollment_qty,
       count(*) filter (where status = 'completed') as completed_qty,
       count(*) filter (where scholarship) as scholarship_qty,
       count(*) filter (where has_low_assessment) as low_assessment_qty,
       sum(passing_component_qty) as passing_component_qty,
       round(avg(avg_component_score), 2) as avg_component_score,
       round(avg(assessment_avg_pct), 2) as avg_assessment_pct,
       round(sum(lab_score_sum), 2) as total_lab_score,
       sum(attempted_credits) as total_credits
from enriched
group by rollup (dept_code, section_id)
order by grouping_id, dept_code nulls last, section_id nulls last

WITH dedup_events AS (
    -- Keep the latest source revision for each adverse event.
    SELECT
        event_id,
        subject_id,
        site_id,
        severity,
        event_ts,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_ts) AS event_month,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            HOUR, event_ts, COALESCE(resolved_ts, updated_ts)
        ) AS duration_hours,
        CASE severity
            WHEN 'MILD' THEN 1
            WHEN 'MODERATE' THEN 2
            WHEN 'SEVERE' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS severity_score
    FROM stg_adverse_events
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY event_id
        ORDER BY updated_ts DESC, source_seq DESC
    ) = 1
),
visit_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        v.visit_id,
        v.subject_id,
        v.site_id,
        v.visit_ts,
        v.week_number,
        measurement.metric,
        measurement.metric_value
    FROM stg_visits v
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(v.measurements) exploded_measurements AS measurement
    WHERE v.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND v.visit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '7' DAY
      AND v.visit_ts < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00')
          + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
),
pivoted_vitals AS (
    SELECT
        visit_id,
        subject_id,
        site_id,
        visit_ts,
        week_number,
        temperature,
        pulse
    FROM visit_metrics
    PIVOT (
        AVG(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN ('TEMPERATURE' AS temperature, 'PULSE' AS pulse)
    )
),
long_vitals AS (
    -- Default UNPIVOT omits a visit's missing pulse measurement.
    SELECT
        visit_id,
        subject_id,
        site_id,
        visit_ts,
        week_number,
        metric,
        metric_value
    FROM pivoted_vitals
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric IN (temperature, pulse)
    )
),
moving_vitals AS (
    SELECT
        lv.visit_id,
        lv.subject_id,
        lv.site_id,
        lv.visit_ts,
        lv.week_number,
        lv.metric,
        lv.metric_value,
        s.profile.country AS country,
        sub.cohort,
        ELEMENT_AT(sub.attributes, 'risk_tier') AS risk_tier,
        ELEMENT_AT(s.capabilities, 'lab') AS lab_network,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', lv.visit_ts) AS visit_week,
        AVG(lv.metric_value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY lv.subject_id, lv.metric
            ORDER BY lv.visit_ts, lv.visit_id
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_two_reading_avg,
        DATEDIFF(lv.visit_ts, sub.enrollment_date) AS days_since_enrollment,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, sub.consent_ts, lv.visit_ts) AS hours_since_consent,
        lv.visit_ts + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS followup_due_ts
    FROM long_vitals lv
    JOIN dim_sites s ON s.site_id = lv.site_id
    JOIN dim_subjects sub ON sub.subject_id = lv.subject_id
),
event_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        e.site_id,
        sub.cohort,
        GROUPING(e.site_id) AS site_grouping,
        GROUPING(sub.cohort) AS cohort_grouping,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS distinct_event_count,
        SUM(DISTINCT e.duration_hours) AS distinct_duration_hours,
        AVG(e.severity_score) AS avg_severity_score,
        MAX(e.event_month) AS latest_event_month
    FROM dedup_events e
    JOIN dim_subjects sub ON sub.subject_id = e.subject_id
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (e.site_id, sub.cohort)
)
SELECT
    mv.country,
    mv.site_id,
    mv.cohort,
    mv.risk_tier,
    mv.lab_network,
    mv.subject_id,
    mv.visit_id,
    mv.visit_week,
    mv.metric,
    mv.metric_value,
    mv.prior_two_reading_avg,
    mv.days_since_enrollment,
    mv.hours_since_consent,
    mv.followup_due_ts,
    er.distinct_event_count,
    er.distinct_duration_hours,
    er.avg_severity_score,
    er.latest_event_month
FROM moving_vitals mv
LEFT JOIN event_rollup er
  ON er.site_id = mv.site_id
 AND er.cohort = mv.cohort
 AND er.site_grouping = 0
 AND er.cohort_grouping = 0
ORDER BY
    mv.country,
    mv.site_id,
    mv.subject_id,
    mv.metric,
    mv.visit_ts,
    mv.visit_id

with scan_rollup as (
    -- summarize the reporting-window scans at facility/type, facility, and network levels
    select
        facility_code,
        scan_type,
        grouping_id(facility_code, scan_type) as rollup_level,
        count(*) as facility_scan_count,
        count(*) filter (where scan_type = 'DELIVERY') as delivery_scan_count,
        count(*) filter (where exception_code is not null) as exception_scan_count,
        array_sort(collect_set(exception_code)) as exception_codes,
        size(array_sort(collect_set(exception_code))) as distinct_exception_count
    from parcel_scans
    where scanned_at >= timestamp '2025-02-28 00:00:00'
      and scanned_at < timestamp '2025-03-05 00:00:00'
    group by rollup(facility_code, scan_type)
),
latest_scans as (
    -- retain each parcel's latest scan while carrying scan history and global recency ranks
    select
        event_id,
        parcel_id,
        facility_code,
        scan_type,
        scanned_at,
        exception_code,
        count(*) over (partition by parcel_id) as total_scans,
        count(exception_code) over (partition by parcel_id) as exception_scans,
        min(scanned_at) over (partition by parcel_id) as first_scanned_at,
        row_number() over (
            partition by parcel_id order by scanned_at desc, event_id desc
        ) as recency_rank,
        ntile(4) over (order by scanned_at, event_id) as scan_recency_quartile,
        dense_rank() over (order by scanned_at, event_id) as scan_sequence_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by scanned_at, event_id) as scan_percent_rank
    from parcel_scans
    qualify recency_rank = 1
),
parcel_metrics as (
    -- combine manifest promises, nested destinations, courier state, and latest scan timing
    select
        p.parcel_id,
        p.service_tier,
        p.delivery_address.country as delivery_country,
        p.delivery_address.city as delivery_city,
        coalesce(c.courier_name, 'Unassigned') as courier_name,
        l.facility_code,
        l.scan_type as latest_scan_type,
        l.scanned_at as latest_scanned_at,
        date_trunc('day', l.scanned_at) as latest_scan_day,
        l.total_scans,
        l.exception_scans,
        timestampdiff(minute, l.first_scanned_at, l.scanned_at) as transit_minutes,
        datediff(date(p.promised_at), date(l.scanned_at)) as schedule_day_delta,
        case
            when l.scan_type = 'DELIVERY'
                then timestampdiff(minute, p.promised_at, l.scanned_at)
            else cast(null as bigint)
        end as delivery_delay_minutes,
        case
            when l.scanned_at <= p.promised_at then 'ON_TIME'
            when l.scanned_at <= p.promised_at + interval '6' hour then 'GRACE_PERIOD'
            else 'LATE'
        end as delivery_timing,
        case
            when l.scan_type = 'DELIVERY' then 'COMPLETED'
            when l.exception_code is not null then 'EXCEPTION'
            else 'IN_TRANSIT'
        end as parcel_state,
        l.scan_recency_quartile,
        l.scan_sequence_rank,
        l.scan_percent_rank
    from parcel_records p
    join latest_scans l on l.parcel_id = p.parcel_id
    left join courier_assignments c
        on c.courier_id = p.courier_id
       and c.is_active = true
    where p.is_test = false
),
metric_long as (
    -- turn parcel measures into rows; SQL unpivot excludes undelivered null delays
    select
        parcel_id,
        service_tier,
        delivery_country,
        metric_name,
        metric_value
    from parcel_metrics
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric_name in (
            total_scans,
            exception_scans,
            delivery_delay_minutes
        )
    )
),
service_benchmarks as (
    -- calculate comparable service and country averages for each available measure
    select
        service_tier,
        delivery_country,
        metric_name,
        round(avg(metric_value), 2) as avg_metric_value,
        count(*) as peer_metric_rows,
        count(distinct parcel_id) as parcel_count
    from metric_long
    group by service_tier, delivery_country, metric_name
)
select
    ml.parcel_id,
    pm.delivery_country,
    pm.delivery_city,
    pm.service_tier,
    pm.courier_name,
    pm.latest_scan_type,
    pm.parcel_state,
    pm.delivery_timing,
    ml.metric_name,
    ml.metric_value,
    sb.avg_metric_value,
    sb.peer_metric_rows,
    sb.parcel_count,
    sr.facility_scan_count,
    sr.delivery_scan_count,
    sr.exception_scan_count,
    sr.exception_codes,
    sr.distinct_exception_count,
    network.facility_scan_count as network_scan_count,
    pm.scan_recency_quartile,
    pm.scan_sequence_rank,
    pm.scan_percent_rank,
    pm.schedule_day_delta
from metric_long ml
join parcel_metrics pm on pm.parcel_id = ml.parcel_id
join service_benchmarks sb
    on sb.service_tier = ml.service_tier
   and sb.delivery_country = ml.delivery_country
   and sb.metric_name = ml.metric_name
left join scan_rollup sr
    on sr.rollup_level = 0
   and sr.facility_code = pm.facility_code
   and sr.scan_type = pm.latest_scan_type
join scan_rollup network on network.rollup_level = 3
order by ml.parcel_id, ml.metric_name

WITH attempt_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        q.course_id,
        q.quiz_title,
        q.passing_score,
        a.learner_context.country AS learner_country,
        a.learner_context.learning_mode,
        TRANSFORM(a.response_flags, flag -> LOWER(flag)) AS normalized_flags,
        SIZE(FILTER(a.response_flags, flag -> flag IS NOT NULL)) AS populated_flag_count,
        EXISTS(a.response_flags, flag -> flag = 'HINT_USED') AS used_hint,
        CASE
            WHEN a.score >= q.passing_score THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS passed
    FROM stg_quiz_attempts a
    JOIN dim_quizzes q
        ON q.quiz_id = a.quiz_id
),
latest_attempts AS (
    SELECT
        ae.*,
        AVG(ae.score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ae.course_id
            ORDER BY ae.score
            RANGE BETWEEN 15 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_score_avg
    FROM attempt_enriched ae
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ae.learner_id, ae.quiz_id
        ORDER BY ae.submitted_at DESC, ae.attempt_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        TO_DATE(submitted_at) AS activity_date,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(learner_id)) AS unique_learners,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS attempt_count,
        CAST(AVG(score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS avg_score,
        CAST(AVG(CAST(passed AS DECIMAL(10,4))) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS pass_rate
    FROM latest_attempts
    GROUP BY
        course_id,
        TO_DATE(submitted_at)
),
daily_scored AS (
    SELECT
        dm.*,
        AVG(dm.avg_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY dm.course_id
            ORDER BY dm.activity_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS trailing_avg_score,
        NTILE(3) OVER (
            PARTITION BY dm.course_id
            ORDER BY dm.activity_date
        ) AS activity_bucket,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY dm.course_id
            ORDER BY dm.activity_date
        ) AS activity_sequence
    FROM daily_metrics dm
),
metric_long AS (
    -- Standardize the measures before rebuilding the report shape.
    SELECT
        course_id,
        activity_date,
        unique_learners,
        trailing_avg_score,
        activity_bucket,
        activity_sequence,
        metric,
        metric_value
    FROM daily_scored
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric IN (
            attempt_count AS ATTEMPTS,
            avg_score AS AVG_SCORE,
            pass_rate AS PASS_RATE
        )
    )
),
daily_pivoted AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM metric_long
    PIVOT (
        FIRST(metric_value) FOR metric IN (
            'ATTEMPTS' AS attempts,
            'AVG_SCORE' AS avg_score,
            'PASS_RATE' AS pass_rate
        )
    )
)

    CASE

        ELSE 'AT_RISK'
    END AS mastery_band
FROM daily_pivoted d
JOIN dim_courses c

/*
  league form review for the 2025 english fixtures
  combines player lines, availability and longitudinal form
  the goal rollup is joined back to each eligible appearance
*/
with scoped_lines as (
    select
        s.match_id,
        s.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.club_code,
        p.primary_pos,
        f.round_no,
        f.kickoff,
        f.venue.country as venue_country,
        element_at(f.match_attrs, 'surface') as surface,
        s.minutes,
        s.goals,
        s.assists,
        s.shot_minutes
    from player_match_lines s
    join fixture_schedule f
      on f.match_id = s.match_id
     and f.status = 'completed'
    join squad_players p
      on p.player_id = s.player_id
     and p.is_active = true
    left join availability_flags x
      on x.match_id = s.match_id
     and x.player_id = s.player_id
     and x.flag_type = 'withdrew'
    where x.player_id is null -- left anti removal of withdrawals
      and f.season = 2025
      and f.venue.country = 'ENG'
),
annotated as (
    select
        sl.*,
        size(filter(shot_minutes, x -> x >= 30)) as late_shot_count,
        aggregate(shot_minutes, 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x) as shot_load,
        case
            when surface = 'hybrid' then goals * 2
            else goals
        end as adjusted_goals,
        goals + coalesce(assists, 0) as contributions
    from scoped_lines sl
),
windowed as (
    select
        match_id,
        player_id,
        player_name,
        club_code,
        primary_pos,
        round_no,
        venue_country,
        surface,
        minutes,
        goals,
        assists,
        adjusted_goals,
        contributions,
        late_shot_count,
        shot_load,
        lag(contributions, 1, 0) over player_round as prev_contrib,
        lead(contributions, 2, -1) over player_round as after_next_contrib,
        sum(goals) over player_prior_two as goals_prior_two,
        ntile(3) over (
            partition by club_code
            order by contributions desc, match_id
        ) as club_form_bucket,
        dense_rank() over (
            partition by club_code
            order by round_no
        ) as club_round_rank,
        percent_rank() over (
            partition by primary_pos
            order by contributions desc, match_id
        ) as pos_form_pct
    from annotated
    window
        player_round as (
            partition by player_id
            order by round_no, match_id
        ),
        player_prior_two as (
            partition by player_id
            order by round_no, match_id
            rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
        )
),
long_stats as (
    -- sql unpivot excludes the one null assist value
    select club_code, metric, metric_value
    from windowed
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric in (goals, assists, minutes)
    ) as u
),
rollup_stats as (
    select
        club_code,
        metric,
        grouping(club_code) as club_is_grouped,
        grouping(metric) as metric_is_grouped,
        count(*) filter (where metric_value >= 2) as high_value_rows,
        sum(metric_value) as total_metric_value,
        percentile_approx(metric_value, 0.5) as median_metric_value
    from long_stats
    group by rollup (club_code, metric)
)
select
    w.match_id,
    w.player_id,
    w.player_name,
    w.club_code,
    w.primary_pos,
    w.round_no,
    w.surface,
    w.venue_country,
    w.minutes,
    w.goals,
    w.assists,
    w.adjusted_goals,
    w.contributions,
    w.prev_contrib,
    w.after_next_contrib,
    w.goals_prior_two,
    w.late_shot_count,
    w.shot_load,
    w.club_form_bucket,
    w.club_round_rank,
    w.pos_form_pct,
    r.high_value_rows as club_goal_rows_ge_two,
    r.total_metric_value as club_goal_total,
    r.median_metric_value as club_goal_median
from windowed w
join rollup_stats r
  on r.club_code = w.club_code
 and r.metric = 'goals'
where w.minutes >= 30
order by w.club_code, w.player_id, w.round_no, w.match_id

with reservation_scope as (
    select
        r.*,
        acct.member_name,
        acct.tier,
        acct.home_region,
        r.contact.country as contact_country,
        element_at(r.attributes, 'fare_family') as fare_family,
        aggregate(
            filter(
                transform(r.ancillary_amounts, x -> coalesce(x, 0)),
                x -> x > 0
            ),
            0,
            (acc, x) -> acc + x
        ) as ancillary_total,
        exists(r.ancillary_amounts, x -> x is null) as has_missing_ancillary,
        date_trunc('DAY', r.booked_at) as booking_day,
        timestampdiff(
            HOUR,
            r.booked_at,
            r.booked_at + interval 36 hour
        ) as ticketing_window_hours,
        datediff(date '2025-04-01', cast(r.booked_at as date)) as days_to_april,
        round((
            select avg(base_fare)
            from flight_reservations
            where booking_status = 'CANCELLED'
        ), 2) as cancelled_avg_fare
    from flight_reservations r
    left join loyalty_accounts acct
        on acct.loyalty_id = r.loyalty_id
    where r.booked_at >= timestamp '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
      and r.booked_at < timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and (
          r.booking_status in ('CONFIRMED', 'FLOWN')
          or (r.booking_status = 'PENDING' and r.base_fare >= 400)
      )
      and r.base_fare > (
          select avg(base_fare)
          from flight_reservations
          where booking_status = 'CANCELLED'
      )
),
leg_stats as (
    select
        r.booking_id,
        count(*) filter (where leg.leg_id is not null) as total_legs,
        count(*) filter (where leg.leg_status = 'FLOWN') as flown_legs,
        sum(distinct leg.distance_km) as distinct_distance_km,
        count(distinct leg.flight_no) as distinct_flights,
        max(leg.arrived_at) as last_arrival_at
    from reservation_scope r
    left join flight_legs leg
        on leg.booking_id = r.booking_id
    group by r.booking_id
),
cabin_pivot as (
    select
        booking_id,
        economy_km,
        business_km,
        first_km
    from (
        select booking_id, cabin_code, distance_km
        from flight_legs
    )
    pivot (
        sum(distance_km)
        for cabin_code in (
            'ECONOMY' as economy_km,
            'BUSINESS' as business_km,
            'FIRST' as first_km
        )
    )
),
reservation_metrics as (
    -- Timestamp RANGE windows include bookings made in the prior two days.
    select
        r.*,
        s.total_legs,
        s.flown_legs,
        s.distinct_distance_km,
        s.distinct_flights,
        s.last_arrival_at,
        p.economy_km,
        p.business_km,
        p.first_km,
        sum(r.base_fare) over (
            partition by r.loyalty_id
            order by r.booked_at
            range between interval 2 day preceding and current row
        ) as recent_booking_fare
    from reservation_scope r
    left join leg_stats s
        on s.booking_id = r.booking_id
    left join cabin_pivot p
        on p.booking_id = r.booking_id
),
points_rollup as (
    select
        txn.loyalty_id,
        txn.txn_type,
        grouping_id(txn.loyalty_id, txn.txn_type) as rollup_level,
        sum(txn.points) as net_points,
        sum(txn.points) filter (where txn.txn_type = 'EARN') as earned_points,
        count(distinct txn.txn_id) as txn_count
    from loyalty_txns txn
    where txn.txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
      and txn.txn_ts < timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
    group by rollup(txn.loyalty_id, txn.txn_type)
)
select

    m.member_name,
    m.tier,
    m.home_region,
    m.booking_status,
    m.booked_at,

        ) as prev_touch_at

    select
        g.*,
        case
            when g.prev_touch_at is null
              or g.touch_at > g.prev_touch_at + interval '4' hour
            then 1
            else 0
        end as new_session_flag,
        sum(
            case
                when g.prev_touch_at is null
                  or g.touch_at > g.prev_touch_at + interval '4' hour
                then 1
                else 0

WITH latest_lease AS (
    -- Keep only the newest active revision and decode the resident JSON profile.
    SELECT lease_id,
           unit_id,
           lease_start,
           lease_end,
           monthly_rent,
           FROM_JSON(tenant_json, 'STRUCT<resident_email:STRING,autopay:BOOLEAN>').resident_email
               AS resident_email
    FROM (
        SELECT lr.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY lease_id
                   ORDER BY snapshot_ts DESC, version_no DESC
               ) AS rev_rn
        FROM lease_revisions lr
    ) ranked
    WHERE rev_rn = 1
      AND lease_status = 'ACTIVE'
),
payment_gaps AS (
    -- Mark a new payment session after three days without account activity.
    SELECT txn_id,
           lease_id,
           paid_at,
           amount,
           method,
           txn_status,
           CASE
               WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY lease_id ORDER BY paid_at, txn_id
                    ) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY lease_id ORDER BY paid_at, txn_id
                    ) + INTERVAL '3' DAY
               THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS new_session_flag
    FROM rent_txn
),
payment_sessions AS (
    -- Turn the gap flags into stable per-lease payment session identifiers.
    SELECT txn_id,
           lease_id,
           paid_at,
           amount,
           method,
           txn_status,
           SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
               PARTITION BY lease_id
               ORDER BY paid_at, txn_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_seq,
           CONCAT_WS(
               '-', lease_id,
               CAST(SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY lease_id
                   ORDER BY paid_at, txn_id
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
               ) AS STRING)
           ) AS session_id
    FROM payment_gaps
),
lease_rollup AS (
    -- Attach transactions inside the lease plus its seven-day payment grace period.
    SELECT l.lease_id,
           l.unit_id,
           l.lease_start,
           l.lease_end,
           l.monthly_rent,
           l.resident_email,
           COUNT(p.txn_id) AS joined_txn_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS payment_session_count,
           SUM(DISTINCT p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.txn_status = 'POSTED') AS posted_amount,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.txn_status = 'FAILED') AS failed_txn_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.txn_status = 'PENDING') AS pending_txn_count,
           ARRAY_SORT(
               COLLECT_SET(p.method) FILTER (WHERE p.txn_status = 'POSTED')
           ) AS posted_methods
    FROM latest_lease l
    LEFT JOIN payment_sessions p
      ON p.lease_id = l.lease_id
     AND p.paid_at BETWEEN CAST(l.lease_start AS TIMESTAMP)
                       AND CAST(l.lease_end AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    GROUP BY l.lease_id,
             l.unit_id,
             l.lease_start,
             l.lease_end,
             l.monthly_rent,
             l.resident_email
),
scored AS (
    -- Preserve every rollup column while adding unit and obligation attributes.
    SELECT a.*,
           u.property_name,
           u.unit_code,
           o.rent_due AS RENT,
           o.utility_due AS UTILITIES,
           o.parking_due AS PARKING
    FROM lease_rollup a
    JOIN unit_directory u
      ON u.unit_id = a.unit_id
    JOIN lease_obligations o
      ON o.lease_id = a.lease_id
)

       property_name,
       unit_code,
       resident_email,
       monthly_rent,
       joined_txn_count,
       payment_session_count,
       posted_amount,
       failed_txn_count,

FROM scored
UNPIVOT (
    charge_value FOR charge_name IN (RENT, UTILITIES, PARKING)
) AS up

/*
  Telecom CDR plan-period billing profile.
  Rates only completed calls (plus data sessions), preserves the plan grace
  week, and reshapes account metrics for a billing review extract.
  The two window frames expose recent-call context and nearby usage totals.
*/
with rated_calls as (
    select
        c.*,
        p.plan_nm,
        p.monthly_fee,
        p.billing_profile.region as billing_region,
        element_at(p.feature_limits, 'intl_minutes') as intl_minute_cap,
        sum(c.duration_sec) over (
            partition by c.acct_id
            order by c.call_ts, c.call_id
            rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
        ) as prior_two_duration_sec
    from call_detail_records c
    join subscriber_plans p
      on c.acct_id = p.acct_id
     and c.call_ts between p.effective_start
                       and p.effective_end + interval '7' day
    -- data sessions remain billable even when their status is not completed
    where c.call_id is not null
      and (c.completion_status = 'COMPLETED' or c.call_type = 'DATA')
),
acct_rollup as (
    select
        acct_id,
        plan_nm,
        billing_region,
        intl_minute_cap,
        count(distinct call_id) as distinct_call_cnt,
        sum(distinct duration_sec) as distinct_duration_sum_sec,
        percentile_approx(duration_sec, 0.5) as median_duration_sec,
        max(prior_two_duration_sec) as preceding_window_peak_sec,
        array_sort(collect_set(destination_region)) as destination_regions
    from rated_calls
    group by
        acct_id,
        plan_nm,
        billing_region,
        intl_minute_cap
),
metric_long as (
    -- one common decimal type keeps the positional union stable
    select
        acct_id,
        plan_nm,
        'voice_minutes' as metric,
        cast(round(sum(case when call_type = 'VOICE'
                            then duration_sec else 0 end) / 60, 2)
             as decimal(12,3)) as metric_value
    from rated_calls
    group by acct_id, plan_nm
    union all
    select
        acct_id,
        plan_nm,
        'data_gb' as metric,
        case
            when sum(case when call_type = 'DATA'
                          then coalesce(data_mb, 0) else 0 end) = 0
            then cast(null as decimal(12,3))
            else cast(round(sum(case when call_type = 'DATA'
                                     then coalesce(data_mb, 0) else 0 end) / 1024, 3)
                      as decimal(12,3))
        end as metric_value
    from rated_calls
    group by acct_id, plan_nm
    union all
    select
        acct_id,
        plan_nm,
        'sms_count' as metric,
        cast(sum(case when call_type = 'SMS' then 1 else 0 end)
             as decimal(12,3)) as metric_value
    from rated_calls
    group by acct_id, plan_nm
),
metric_pivot as (
    select *
    from metric_long
    pivot (
        sum(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'voice_minutes' as voice_minutes,
            'data_gb' as data_gb,
            'sms_count' as sms_count
        )
    )
),
metric_unpivot as (
    -- default unpivot semantics omit accounts with no data usage
    select acct_id, plan_nm, metric, metric_value
    from metric_pivot
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric in (voice_minutes, data_gb, sms_count)
    )
)
select
    m.acct_id,
    m.plan_nm,
    r.billing_region,
    coalesce(ap.segment, 'UNKNOWN') as customer_segment,
    m.metric,
    m.metric_value,
    r.distinct_call_cnt,
    r.distinct_duration_sum_sec,
    r.median_duration_sec,
    r.preceding_window_peak_sec,
    r.intl_minute_cap,
    r.destination_regions,
    sum(r.distinct_duration_sum_sec) over (
        order by r.distinct_duration_sum_sec
        range between 500 preceding and current row
    ) as nearby_duration_sum_sec
from metric_unpivot m
join acct_rollup r
  on r.acct_id = m.acct_id
 and r.plan_nm = m.plan_nm
left join account_profiles ap
  on ap.acct_id = m.acct_id
 and ap.include_in_billing = true
order by m.acct_id, m.metric

/*
  gym daily operating snapshot
  combines valid member check-ins with attended class sessions;
  watchlisted coaches and sessions without attendance are excluded.
*/
with member_checkins as (
    select
        ci.*,
        m.member_tier
    from checkin_txn ci
    join member_acct m
      on m.member_id = ci.member_id
     and m.acct_status = 'ACTIVE'
    where ci.txn_status = 'VALID'
      -- only members with at least one attended class
      and exists (
          select 1
          from class_booking eb
          where eb.member_id = ci.member_id
            and eb.booking_status = 'ATTENDED'
      )
),
daily_stats as (
    select
        gym_id,
        to_date(checkin_ts) as visit_date,
        count(*) as checkin_cnt,
        count(distinct member_id) as unique_members,
        sum(visit_minutes) as total_minutes,
        avg(distinct visit_minutes) as avg_distinct_visit_min,
        percentile_approx(visit_minutes, 0.5) as median_visit_min
    from member_checkins
    group by gym_id, to_date(checkin_ts)
),
metric_rows as (
    -- normalize the measures before pivoting them into named columns
    select
        gym_id,
        visit_date,
        avg_distinct_visit_min,
        median_visit_min,
        metric,
        metric_value
    from daily_stats
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric in (
            checkin_cnt as CHECKINS,
            unique_members as MEMBERS,
            total_minutes as MINUTES
        )
    )
),
daily_pivot as (
    select
        gym_id,
        visit_date,
        avg_distinct_visit_min,
        median_visit_min,
        checkins,
        members,
        minutes
    from metric_rows
    pivot (
        sum(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'CHECKINS' as checkins,
            'MEMBERS' as members,
            'MINUTES' as minutes
        )
    )
),
class_daily as (
    select
        s.gym_id,
        to_date(s.start_ts) as class_date,
        count(*) as session_cnt,
        count(distinct b.member_id) as attendee_members,
        percentile_approx(s.duration_min, 0.5) as median_class_min,
        collect_set(s.class_type) as class_types
    from class_session s
    left join class_booking b
      on b.session_id = s.session_id
     and b.booking_status = 'ATTENDED'
    left join coach_watchlist h
      on h.coach_id = s.coach_id
    where h.coach_id is null
      and exists (
          select 1
          from class_booking ab
          where ab.session_id = s.session_id
            and ab.booking_status = 'ATTENDED'
      )
    group by s.gym_id, to_date(s.start_ts)
),
scored as (
    select
        d.*,
        c.session_cnt,
        c.attendee_members,
        c.median_class_min,
        array_sort(c.class_types) as class_types,
        size(c.class_types) as class_type_cnt,
        sum(d.checkins) over (
            partition by d.gym_id
            order by d.minutes
            range between 30 preceding and current row
        ) as nearby_checkins,
        row_number() over (
            partition by d.gym_id
            order by d.visit_date desc, d.checkins desc
        ) as gym_day_rank
    from daily_pivot d
    join class_daily c
      on c.gym_id = d.gym_id
     and c.class_date = d.visit_date
    qualify gym_day_rank = 1
)
select *
from scored
order by gym_id

WITH candidate_base AS (
    SELECT
        c.candidate_id,
        c.full_name,
        c.req_id,
        c.target_level,
        CAST(c.expected_salary AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS expected_salary,
        c.home_location.city AS home_city,
        c.home_location.country AS home_country,
        from_json(
            c.source_payload,
            'STRUCT<source_channel:STRING,consent:BOOLEAN>'
        ) AS source_meta,
        transform(c.skills, x -> upper(x)) AS normalized_skills,
        filter(c.skills, x -> length(x) >= 4) AS long_skills,
        aggregate(c.skills, 0, (acc, x) -> acc + length(x)) AS skill_chars,
        exists(c.skills, x -> lower(x) = 'spark') AS has_spark,
        element_at(c.attrs, 'work_auth') AS work_auth
    FROM candidate_profiles c
    WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM hiring_requisitions r
          WHERE r.req_id = c.req_id
            AND r.req_status = 'OPEN'
      )
),
session_scored AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        from_json(
            s.metrics_json,
            'STRUCT<prep_minutes:INT,confidence:DOUBLE>'
        ) AS session_metrics,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(s.score, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(4,2)))
            AS DECIMAL(6,2)
        ) AS score_dec,
        -- Duration values are unique within each loop.
        SUM(s.duration_min) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.loop_id
            ORDER BY s.duration_min
            RANGE BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS recent_duration_min
    FROM interview_sessions s
    WHERE s.feedback_status = 'SUBMITTED'
),
loop_summary AS (
    SELECT
        loop_id,
        COUNT(*) AS session_count,
        ROUND(AVG(score_dec), 2) AS avg_score,
        FLOOR(SUM(duration_min) / 60) AS interview_hours,
        CEIL(SUM(duration_min) / 45.0) AS panel_blocks,
        MAX(recent_duration_min) AS peak_recent_minutes,
        ROUND(AVG(session_metrics.confidence), 2) AS avg_confidence,
        SUM(session_metrics.prep_minutes) AS prep_minutes
    FROM session_scored
    GROUP BY loop_id
),
feedback_pivot AS (
    SELECT loop_id, strong_hire, hire, no_hire
    FROM (
        SELECT loop_id, recommendation
        FROM session_scored
    ) f
    PIVOT (
        COUNT(recommendation)
        FOR recommendation IN (
            'STRONG_HIRE' AS strong_hire,
            'HIRE' AS hire,
            'NO_HIRE' AS no_hire
        )
    )
),
eligible_loops AS (
    SELECT
        l.loop_id,
        l.candidate_id,
        l.req_id,
        l.stage,
        l.recruiter_id,
        l.opened_at,
        l.closed_at,
        l.referral_bonus
    FROM interview_loops l
    WHERE l.stage IN ('ONSITE', 'DEBRIEF')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM interview_sessions s
          WHERE s.loop_id = l.loop_id
            AND s.feedback_status = 'SUBMITTED'
            AND s.recommendation = 'NO_HIRE'
      )
),
assembled AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        e.candidate_id,
        e.req_id,
        e.stage,
        e.recruiter_id,
        e.opened_at,
        e.closed_at,
        e.referral_bonus,
        p.strong_hire,
        p.hire,
        p.no_hire
    FROM loop_summary a
    JOIN eligible_loops e
      ON e.loop_id = a.loop_id
    LEFT JOIN feedback_pivot p
      ON p.loop_id = a.loop_id
)
SELECT
    a.*,
    c.full_name,
    c.home_city,
    c.home_country,
    c.normalized_skills,
    c.long_skills,
    c.skill_chars,
    c.has_spark,
    c.work_auth,
    c.source_meta.source_channel AS source_channel,
    r.department,
    r.hiring_manager,
    ROUND(
        c.expected_salary
        + COALESCE(a.referral_bonus, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),
        2
    ) AS cash_target,
    CASE
        WHEN a.avg_score >= 4.50
         AND COALESCE(a.strong_hire, 0) >= 1
            THEN 'FAST_TRACK'
        WHEN a.avg_score >= 3.50
            THEN 'DEBRIEF'
        ELSE 'COACH_PANEL'
    END AS next_action
FROM assembled a
JOIN candidate_base c

WITH ticket_base AS (
    SELECT t.ticket_id,
           t.customer_id,
           t.channel,
           t.priority,
           t.status,
           CONCAT_WS('-', t.ticket_id,
                     LPAD(CAST(HOUR(t.opened_at) AS STRING), 2, '0'),
                     UPPER(t.channel)) AS ticket_label,
           t.opened_at,
           t.resolved_at,
           t.assigned_agent_id,
           a.team_name,
           FROM_JSON(t.attributes_json,
                     'STRUCT<vip:BOOLEAN,language:STRING,retry_count:INT>') AS attributes,
           ARRAY_JOIN(
               FILTER(TRANSFORM(COALESCE(t.tags, ARRAY()), x -> UPPER(x)),
                      x -> x <> 'SPAM'), '|') AS normalized_tags,
           EXISTS(t.tags, x -> x = 'security') AS security_tagged,
           SIZE(SPLIT(t.subject, ' ', -1)) AS subject_word_count,
           ELEMENT_AT(s.targets, 'response_minutes') AS response_target_minutes,
           ELEMENT_AT(s.targets, 'resolution_minutes') AS resolution_target_minutes,
           ARRAY_JOIN(SORT_ARRAY(MAP_KEYS(s.targets)), ',') AS target_metrics,
           SIZE(MAP_VALUES(s.targets)) AS target_value_count
    FROM support_tickets t
    JOIN support_agents a ON a.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id
    JOIN sla_policies s ON s.priority = t.priority
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM support_agents ea
        WHERE ea.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id AND ea.is_active = TRUE
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ticket_activity bad
        WHERE bad.ticket_id = t.ticket_id AND bad.activity_type = 'ABUSE_REPORT'
    )
),
activity_gaps AS (
    SELECT a.activity_id, a.ticket_id, a.agent_id, a.activity_at,
           a.activity_type, a.time_spent_minutes, a.customer_visible,
           LAG(a.activity_at) OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.ticket_id ORDER BY a.activity_at, a.activity_id
           ) AS previous_activity_at
    FROM ticket_activity a
),
activity_sessions AS (
    -- An eight-hour idle gap starts a new work session.
    SELECT g.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN g.previous_activity_at IS NULL
                         OR g.activity_at > g.previous_activity_at + INTERVAL '8' HOUR
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
               PARTITION BY g.ticket_id
               ORDER BY g.activity_at, g.activity_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_seq
    FROM activity_gaps g
),
ticket_rollup AS (
    SELECT s.ticket_id,
           COUNT(*) AS activity_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.customer_visible) AS visible_activity_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(s.time_spent_minutes)
               FILTER (WHERE s.activity_type = 'CALL'), 0) AS call_minutes,
           MIN(s.activity_at) FILTER (WHERE s.customer_visible)
               AS first_customer_visible_at,
           COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_seq) AS session_count,
           MAX(s.activity_at) AS last_activity_at
    FROM activity_sessions s
    JOIN ticket_base b ON b.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
    GROUP BY s.ticket_id
),
latest_activity AS (
    SELECT s.ticket_id,
           s.activity_type AS latest_activity_type,
           s.agent_id AS latest_agent_id,
           s.activity_at AS latest_activity_at,
           s.session_seq AS latest_session_seq
    FROM activity_sessions s
    WHERE s.ticket_id IN (SELECT b.ticket_id FROM ticket_base b)
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY s.ticket_id ORDER BY s.activity_at DESC, s.activity_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
channel_priority AS (
    -- PIVOT preserves a compact per-customer channel comparison.
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT b.customer_id, b.channel,
               CASE WHEN b.priority = 'P1' THEN 'CRITICAL'
                    WHEN b.priority = 'P2' THEN 'ELEVATED'
                    ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS priority_label
        FROM ticket_base b
    ) x
    PIVOT (
        MAX(priority_label)
        FOR channel IN ('EMAIL' AS email_priority,
                        'CHAT' AS chat_priority,
                        'PHONE' AS phone_priority)
    )
)
SELECT b.*,
       r.activity_count,
       r.visible_activity_count,
       r.call_minutes,
       r.first_customer_visible_at,
       r.session_count,
       r.last_activity_at,
       la.latest_activity_type,
       la.latest_agent_id,
       la.latest_activity_at,
       la.latest_session_seq,
       cp.email_priority,
       cp.chat_priority,
       cp.phone_priority,
       COALESCE(b.attributes.vip, FALSE) AS is_vip,
       CASE WHEN r.first_customer_visible_at IS NULL THEN 'NO_RESPONSE'
            WHEN CAST(r.first_customer_visible_at AS LONG) <=
                 CAST(b.opened_at AS LONG) + b.response_target_minutes * 60
            THEN 'MET' ELSE 'BREACHED' END AS response_sla,
       CASE WHEN b.resolved_at IS NULL THEN 'PENDING'
            WHEN CAST(b.resolved_at AS LONG) <=
                 CAST(b.opened_at AS LONG) + b.resolution_target_minutes * 60
            THEN 'MET' ELSE 'BREACHED' END AS resolution_sla,
       CASE WHEN b.resolved_at IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
            ELSE ROUND((CAST(b.resolved_at AS LONG) -
                        CAST(b.opened_at AS LONG)) / 60.0, 1)
       END AS resolution_minutes,
       CONCAT_WS('/', b.priority, COALESCE(la.latest_activity_type, 'NONE'),
                 UPPER(b.status)) AS handoff_key
FROM ticket_base b
JOIN ticket_rollup r ON r.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
JOIN latest_activity la ON la.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
LEFT JOIN channel_priority cp ON cp.customer_id = b.customer_id
ORDER BY resolution_minutes DESC NULLS LAST, session_count DESC, ticket_id ASC

        exists(m.handling_tags, x -> upper(x) = 'SIGNATURE') as signature_required
    from parcel_manifests m
),
deduped_scans as (
    select
        s.scan_id,
        s.tracking_no,
        s.facility_cd,
        s.scan_ts,
        coalesce(
            nullif(regexp_extract(s.status_txt, 'EVENT=([A-Z_]+)', 1), ''),
            'UNKNOWN'
        ) as event_cd,
        s.status_txt,
        element_at(s.scan_attrs, 'vehicle_id') as vehicle_id,
        element_at(s.scan_attrs, 'note') as scan_note,
        array_sort(map_keys(s.scan_attrs)) as attr_keys,
        row_number() over (
            partition by s.scan_id
            order by s.ingest_ts desc, s.scan_ts desc, s.tracking_no
        ) as scan_rn
    from parcel_scan_events s
    qualify scan_rn = 1
),
sequenced_scans as (
    select
        d.*,
        lag(d.facility_cd, 1, 'ORIGIN') over (
            partition by d.tracking_no order by d.scan_ts, d.scan_id
        ) as prev_facility_cd,
        lead(d.event_cd, 1, 'END') over (
            partition by d.tracking_no order by d.scan_ts, d.scan_id
        ) as next_event_cd,
        lead(d.scan_ts, 1, d.scan_ts) over (
            partition by d.tracking_no order by d.scan_ts, d.scan_id
        ) as next_scan_ts,
        -- numeric epoch seconds permit a deterministic one-hour range frame
        count(*) over (
            partition by d.tracking_no
            order by unix_timestamp(d.scan_ts)
            range between 3600 preceding and current row
        ) as scans_last_hour
    from deduped_scans d
),
scan_rollup as (
    select
        d.tracking_no,
        count(*) filter (
            where d.event_cd in ('DELAYED', 'DAMAGED', 'EXCEPTION')
        ) as exception_scan_cnt,
        count(*) filter (where d.event_cd = 'DELIVERED') as delivered_scan_cnt,
        array_sort(collect_set(d.facility_cd)) as route_facilities,
        array_sort(collect_set(d.event_cd)) as event_codes
    from deduped_scans d

    -- long gaps are one branch; physical damage is a separate branch
    select

        s.scan_id,
        s.facility_cd,
        s.scan_ts,
        s.prev_facility_cd,
        s.next_event_cd,

        s.attr_keys,

        ) as issue_detail,
        round(

        ) as hours_to_next_scan
    from sequenced_scans s
    where s.next_event_cd <> 'END'
