        F.filter("handing_tags", lambda x: F.lower(x).like("%cold%")).alias("cold_chain_tags"),
        F.exists("handing_tags", lambda x: F.upper("handing_tags") == "SIGNATURE").alias("signature_required"),
    )
)

deduped_scans = (
    df_parcel_scan_events
    .select(
        "scan_id",
        "tracking_no",
        "facility_cd",
        "scan_ts",
        F.coalesce(F.col("regexp_extract(" + "status_txt", "EVENT=([A-Z_]+)", 1), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("event_cd"),
        "status_txt",
        F.element_at("scan_attrs", "vehicle_id").alias("vehicle_id"),
        F.element_at("scan_attrs", "note").alias("scan_note"),
        F.element_at("scan_attrs", "region_cd").alias("attr_keys"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("scan_id").orderBy(F.col("ingest_ts").desc(), F.col("scan_ts").desc(), "tracking_no")).alias("scan_rn"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("scan_rn") == 1)
    .drop("scan_rn")
)

sequenced_scans = (
    deduped_scans
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("facility_cd", 1, "ORIGIN").over(Window.partitionBy("tracking_no").orderBy("scan_ts", "id")).alias("prev_facility_cd"),
        F.lead("event_cd", 1, "END").over(Window.partitionBy("tracking_no").orderBy("scan_ts", "id")).alias("next_event_cd"),
        F.lead("scan_ts", 1, "scan_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("tracking_no").orderBy("scan_ts", "id")).alias("next_scan_ts"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("tracking_no").orderBy(F.unix_timestamp("scan_ts")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)).alias("scans_last_hour"),
    )
)

scan_rollup = (
    deduped_scans
    .groupBy("tracking_no")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_cd").isin(["DELAYED", "DAMAGED", "EXCEPTION"]), 1)).alias("exception_scan_cnt"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_cd") == "delivered", 1)).alias("delivered_scan_cnt"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("facility_cd")).alias("route_facilities"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("event_cd")).alias("event_codes"),
    )
)

issue_rows = (
    sequenced_scans
    .filter((F.col("next_event_cd") != "END") & (F.col("next_scan_ts") > F.col("scan_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 8 HOURS")))
    .select(
        "tracking_no",
        "scan_id",
        "facility_cd",
        "scan_ts",
        "prev_facility_cd",
        "next_event_cd",
        "vehicle_id",
        "attr_keys",
        "scans_last_hour",
        F.lit("DELAY").alias("issue_type"),
        F.concat(F.lit("Gap to "), F.col("next_event_cd"), F.lit(" exceeded 8h; vehicle="), F.coalesce(F.col("vehicle_id"), F.lit("UNKNOWN"))).alias("issue_detail"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("next_scan_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("scan_ts")) / 3600.0, 1).alias("hours_to_next_scan"),
    )
    .unionByName(
        sequenced_scans
        .filter((F.col("event_cd") == "DAMAGED") | (F.col("status_txt").rlike("(?i)crushed|torn|wet")))
        .select(
            "tracking_no",
            "scan_id",
            "facility_cd",
            "scan_ts",
            "prev_facility_cd",
            "next_event_cd",
            "vehicle_id",
            "attr_keys",
            "scans_last_hour",
            F.lit("DAMAGE").alias("issue_type"),
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("scan_note"),
                F.regexp_replace(F.col("status_txt"), "^EVENT=[A-Z_]+\\|?", ""),
                F.lit("No detail"),
            ).alias("issue_detail"),
            F.round((F.unix_timestamp("next_scan_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("scan_ts")) / 3600.0, 1).alias("hours_to_next_scan"),
        )
    )
)

facility_metric_pivot = (
    df_facility_daily_metrics
    .filter(F.col("metric_dt") == "2025-03-01")
    .groupBy("facility_cd")
    .pivot("metric_nm", ["DWELL_MIN", "MISROUTES"])
    .agg(F.avg("metric_val"))
    .select(
        "facility_cd",
        F.col("DWELL_MIN").alias("dwell_min"),
        F.col("MISROUTES").alias("misroutes"),
    )
)

result = (
    issue_rows.alias("i")
    .join(scan_rollup.alias("r"), F.col("r.tracking_no") == F.col("i.tracking_no"), "inner")
    .join(manifest_enriched.alias("m"), F.col("m.tracking_no") == F.col("i.tracking_no"), "inner")
    .join(df_delivery_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("a.acct_id") == F.col("m.acct_id"), "inner")
    .join(facility_metric_pivot.alias("f"), F.col("f.facility_cd") == F.col("i.facility_cd"), "left")
    .select(
        "i.tracking_no",
        "m.acct_id",
        "a.account_nm",
        "a.region_cd",
        "m.service_tier",
        "m.promised_ts",
        "i.scan_id",
        "i.facility_cd",
        "i.scan_ts",
        "i.issue_type",
        F.when(F.col("i.issue_type") == "DAMAGE", "P1").when(F.col("f.dwell_min") >= 80, "P2").otherwise("P3").alias("issue_priority"),
        "i.issue_detail",
        "i.prev_facility_cd",
        "i.next_event_cd",
        "i.hours_to_next_scan",
        "i.scans_last_hour",
        "r.exception_scan_cnt",
        "r.delivered_scan_cnt",
        "r.route_facilities",
        "r.event_codes",
        "m.normalized_tags",
        "m.cold_chain_tags",
        "m.signature_required",
        "i.vehicle_id",
        "i.attr_keys",
        "f.dwell_min",
        "f.misroutes",
    )
    .orderBy("issue_priority", "scan_ts", "tracking_no", "scan_id")
)

with ride_facts as (
    -- Keep rentals in the operating window and normalize device and battery arrays.
    select rental_id,
           station_id,
           cast(started_at as date) as ride_date,
           datediff(cast(started_at as date), date '2025-03-01') as day_index,
           status,
           member_type,
           duration_minutes,
           distance_km,
           from_json(device_json, 'struct<app_version:string,assisted:boolean>') as device,
           filter(battery_readings, x -> x is not null) as valid_batteries,
           aggregate(
               transform(filter(battery_readings, x -> x is not null), x -> greatest(x - 5, 0)),
               0,
               (acc, x) -> acc + x
           ) / nullif(size(filter(battery_readings, x -> x is not null)), 0) as adjusted_battery_avg,
           coalesce(exists(battery_readings, x -> x < 15), false) as low_battery_trip
    from bike_rentals
    where started_at >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and started_at < timestamp '2025-03-04 00:00:00'
      and status <> 'in_progress'
),
dock_catalog as (
    -- Flatten each station's dock layout and summarize its structured operating profile.
    select s.station_id,
           max(s.station_name) as station_name,
           max(s.capacity) as capacity,
           max(s.location.zone) as zone,
           max(s.location.access_tier) as access_tier,
           array_sort(collect_set(dock.dock_type)) as dock_types,
           count(*) filter (where dock.dock_type = 'EBIKE') as ebike_docks,
           max(cast(get_json_object(s.policy_json, '$.min_battery') as int)) as min_battery,
           max(cast(get_json_object(s.policy_json, '$.night_pause') as boolean)) as night_pause
    from docking_stations s
    lateral view explode(s.dock_layout) d as dock
    group by s.station_id
),
dock_day as (
    -- Pivot the long dock observations into one row per station and date.
    select station_id, observed_date, available_docks, blocked_docks
    from dock_observations
    pivot (
        max(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'AVAILABLE_DOCKS' as available_docks,
            'BLOCKED_DOCKS' as blocked_docks
        )
    )
),
ride_day as (
    -- Build daily rental KPIs, including filtered counts and a completed-ride median.
    select station_id,
           ride_date,
           day_index,
           count(*) filter (where status = 'completed') as completed_trips,
           count(*) filter (where status = 'cancelled') as cancelled_trips,
           count(*) filter (where low_battery_trip) as low_battery_trips,
           count(*) filter (where device.assisted = true) as assisted_trips,
           percentile_approx(duration_minutes, 0.5) filter (where status = 'completed') as median_completed_minutes,
           round(avg(adjusted_battery_avg), 2) as avg_adjusted_battery,
           sum(distance_km) as total_distance_km,
           count(distinct member_type) as rider_types
    from ride_facts
    group by station_id, ride_date, day_index
),
rolling_stats as (
    -- Attach dock supply and calculate prior-row and calendar-range rolling demand.
    select r.*,
           d.available_docks,
           d.blocked_docks,
           coalesce(
               sum(r.completed_trips) over (
                   partition by r.station_id
                   order by r.day_index

           ) as prior_completed_trips,
           sum(r.completed_trips) over (
               partition by r.station_id
               order by r.day_index
               range between 2 preceding and current row
           ) as recent_completed_trips
    from ride_day r
    join dock_day d
      on d.station_id = r.station_id

)

select a.*,

from rolling_stats a
join dock_catalog s on s.station_id = a.station_id

WITH stg_assessment_long AS (
    -- Turn the three assessment columns into one row per graded component;
    -- UNPIVOT intentionally removes components that have not been scored.
    SELECT enrollment_id,
           student_id,
           section_id,
           enrolled_at,
           last_seen_at,
           status,
           credits,
           element_at(activity_flags, 'grading_basis') AS grading_basis,
           assessment,
           score
    FROM stg_enrollment_activity
    UNPIVOT (
        score FOR assessment IN (
            midterm_score AS MIDTERM,
            final_score AS FINAL,
            attendance_score AS ATTENDANCE
        )
    )
),
stg_enriched_assessment AS (
    -- Add section and student context plus elapsed-time measures used downstream.
    SELECT a.*,
           cs.course_code,
           cs.department,
           cs.term_code,
           cs.delivery_mode,
           cs.starts_on,
           st.residency,
           st.cohort_year,
           date_trunc('MONTH', a.enrolled_at) AS enrollment_month,
           datediff(a.last_seen_at, a.enrolled_at) AS active_days,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, a.enrolled_at, a.last_seen_at) AS active_hours,
           a.enrolled_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS response_due_at
    FROM stg_assessment_long a
    JOIN dim_course_section cs
      ON cs.section_id = a.section_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_student st
      ON st.student_id = a.student_id
),
stg_activity_window AS (
    -- Compare each score with nearby activity and establish a deterministic sequence.
    SELECT e.*,
           avg(score) OVER (
               PARTITION BY student_id
               ORDER BY active_days
               RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_avg_score,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY student_id
               ORDER BY enrolled_at, enrollment_id, assessment
           ) AS assessment_sequence
    FROM stg_enriched_assessment e
),
fct_assessment_pivot AS (
    -- Restore one column per assessment for department/term average reporting.
    SELECT department,
           term_code,
           round(midterm_avg, 2) AS midterm_avg,
           round(final_avg, 2) AS final_avg,
           round(attendance_avg, 2) AS attendance_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT department, term_code, assessment, score
        FROM stg_activity_window
    )
    PIVOT (
        avg(score)
        FOR assessment IN (
            'MIDTERM' AS midterm_avg,
            'FINAL' AS final_avg,
            'ATTENDANCE' AS attendance_avg
        )
    )
),
fct_enrollment_rollup AS (
    -- Produce detail, department subtotal and university total rows in one rollup.
    SELECT department,
           term_code,
           grouping(department) AS department_grouping,
           grouping(term_code) AS term_grouping,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_assessments,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'WITHDRAWN') AS withdrawn_assessments,
           COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS student_count,
           SUM(DISTINCT credits) AS distinct_credit_sum,
           round(avg(DISTINCT score), 2) AS distinct_score_avg,
           round(
               100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN assessment = 'FINAL' AND score >= 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               / nullif(SUM(CASE WHEN assessment = 'FINAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
               2
           ) AS final_pass_pct,
           SUM(CASE WHEN assessment_sequence = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_assessment_touchpoints,
           round(avg(nearby_avg_score), 2) AS nearby_score_avg,
           array_sort(collect_set(status)) AS observed_statuses,
           array_sort(collect_set(grading_basis)) AS grading_basis_set
    FROM stg_activity_window
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (department, term_code)
)
-- Attach pivoted averages only to the most granular rollup rows.
SELECT a.*,
       b.midterm_avg,
       b.final_avg,
       b.attendance_avg
FROM fct_enrollment_rollup a
LEFT JOIN fct_assessment_pivot b
  ON a.department = b.department
 AND a.term_code = b.term_code
 AND a.department_grouping = 0
 AND a.term_grouping = 0
ORDER BY a.department_grouping,
         a.department ASC NULLS LAST,
         a.term_grouping,
         a.term_code DESC NULLS LAST,
         a.student_count DESC NULLS LAST

WITH viewing_activity AS (
    -- Keep valid plays and substantial resume/completion events as separate branches.
    SELECT event_id,
           subscriber_id,
           started_at,
           watch_minutes,
           event_type,
           network_type,
           GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_context, '$.device_id') AS device_id,
           GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_context, '$.app_version') AS app_version,
           CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_context, '$.bitrate_kbps') AS INT) AS bitrate_kbps
    FROM stg_viewing_events
    WHERE event_type = 'PLAYBACK'
      AND watch_minutes > 0
      AND started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-25 00:00:00'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_id,
           subscriber_id,
           started_at,
           watch_minutes,
           event_type,
           network_type,
           GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_context, '$.device_id') AS device_id,
           GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_context, '$.app_version') AS app_version,
           CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_context, '$.bitrate_kbps') AS INT) AS bitrate_kbps
    FROM stg_viewing_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('RESUME', 'COMPLETE')
      AND watch_minutes >= 5
      AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-05 00:00:00'
),
sessionized_events AS (
    -- Start a new session after 45 idle minutes and calculate nearby-duration volume.
    SELECT flagged.*,
           CONCAT_WS(
               '-', subscriber_id, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, 'yyyyMMdd'),
               LPAD(CAST(SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY subscriber_id
                   ORDER BY started_at, event_id
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
               ) AS STRING), 3, '0')
           ) AS session_key,
           SUM(watch_minutes) OVER (
               PARTITION BY subscriber_id
               ORDER BY watch_minutes
               RANGE BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS similar_duration_minutes
    FROM (
        SELECT lagged.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN previous_started_at IS NULL
                    OR started_at > previous_started_at + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END AS new_session_flag
        FROM (
            SELECT v.*,
                   LAG(started_at) OVER (
                       PARTITION BY subscriber_id
                       ORDER BY started_at, event_id
                   ) AS previous_started_at
            FROM viewing_activity v
        ) lagged
    ) flagged
),
daily_subscriber AS (
    -- Summarize engagement and session quality for each subscriber-day.
    SELECT subscriber_id,
           DATE(started_at) AS activity_date,
           SUM(watch_minutes) AS total_watch_minutes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS session_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE network_type = 'CELLULAR') AS cellular_events,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (
               WHERE event_type = 'PLAYBACK' AND bitrate_kbps >= 4000
           ) AS high_bitrate_playbacks,
           ROUND(AVG(watch_minutes), 2) AS avg_watch_minutes,
           MAX(similar_duration_minutes) AS nearby_duration_minutes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS devices_used,
           ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(app_version)), ',') AS app_versions
    FROM sessionized_events
    GROUP BY subscriber_id, DATE(started_at)
),
latest_billing AS (
    -- Select the current invoice deterministically for every subscriber.
    SELECT invoice_id,
           subscriber_id,
           billed_on,
           invoice_amount,
           invoice_status,
           days_past_due
    FROM fct_subscription_invoices
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY subscriber_id
        ORDER BY billed_on DESC, invoice_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
support_rollup AS (
    -- Measure recent support friction, including unresolved urgent tickets.
    SELECT subscriber_id,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket_status = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved_tickets,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (
               WHERE ticket_status = 'OPEN' AND severity IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')
           ) AS open_high_priority_tickets,
           ROUND(AVG(resolution_minutes), 1) AS avg_resolution_minutes
    FROM stg_support_tickets
    WHERE opened_on >= DATE '2025-02-25'
    GROUP BY subscriber_id
),
metric_long AS (
    -- Unpivot engagement measures so the final pivot can emit stable string values.
    SELECT subscriber_id,
           activity_date,
           metric,
           CAST(metric_value AS STRING) AS metric_value
    FROM daily_subscriber
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric IN (
            total_watch_minutes,
            session_count,
            cellular_events,
            high_bitrate_playbacks
        )
    )
)
SELECT p.subscriber_id,
       p.activity_date,
       s.plan_details.country AS country,
       s.plan_details.plan_name,
       s.plan_details.is_trial,
       ARRAY_JOIN(
           SPLIT(COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(s.account_labels, 'acquisition_source'), 'unknown'), '-'),
           ' / '
       ) AS acquisition_path,
       COALESCE(SIZE(MAP_KEYS(s.account_labels)), 0) AS account_label_count,
       CONCAT_WS(
           '|', s.plan_details.plan_name, UPPER(s.plan_details.country),
           COALESCE(b.invoice_status, 'NO_INVOICE')
       ) AS subscriber_risk_label,

       CASE

  invoice exposure and collection monitoring
  combines line-level economics, remittance metadata, and posted cash receipts
*/
with stg_invoice_base as (
    select
        h.*,
        from_json(
            h.remittance_json,
            'struct<po_reference:string,payment_terms:string,early_pay_discount:double>'
        ) as remittance,
        transform(
            h.invoice_lines,
            x -> cast(x.net_amount as double)
                 * coalesce(element_at(h.category_multipliers, x.category), 1.0)
        ) as adjusted_line_amounts,
        aggregate(
            filter(
                transform(
                    h.invoice_lines,
                    x -> cast(x.net_amount as double)
                         * coalesce(element_at(h.category_multipliers, x.category), 1.0)
                ),
                amount -> amount >= 100.0
            ),
            cast(0 as double),
            (acc, amount) -> acc + amount
        ) as large_line_total,
        exists(
            h.invoice_lines,
            x -> x.category = 'SERVICES' and x.net_amount > 0
        ) as has_service_lines,
        element_at(h.category_multipliers, 'SERVICES') as service_multiplier,
        map_keys(h.category_multipliers) as multiplier_categories
    from fct_invoice_headers h
    where h.issue_date between date '2025-01-01' and date '2025-03-31'
      and h.status in ('OPEN', 'PAID', 'SENT')
),
stg_line_items as (
    -- explode the nested invoice lines before calculating category mix
    select
        inv.invoice_id,
        item.line_id,
        item.category,
        item.tax_code,
        item.net_amount,
        cast(item.net_amount as double)
            * coalesce(element_at(inv.category_multipliers, item.category), 1.0)
            as adjusted_net_amount
    from stg_invoice_base inv
    lateral view explode(inv.invoice_lines) exploded as item
),
line_rollup as (
    select
        invoice_id,
        count(distinct line_id) as line_count,
        round(
            100.0 * sum(
                case when category = 'SERVICES' then adjusted_net_amount else 0.0 end
            ) / nullif(sum(adjusted_net_amount), 0.0),
            2
        ) as service_line_pct,
        sum(
            case when tax_code = 'STANDARD' then adjusted_net_amount else 0.0 end
        ) as standard_tax_line_total
    from stg_line_items
    group by invoice_id
),
payment_rollup as (
    select
        invoice_id,
        count(distinct payment_id) as payment_count,
        avg(distinct amount) as avg_distinct_payment,
        sum(amount) as paid_amount
    from fct_payments
    where status = 'POSTED'
    group by invoice_id
),
payment_pivot as (
    select *
    from (
        select invoice_id, method, amount
        from fct_payments
        where status = 'POSTED'
    ) pmt
    pivot (
        sum(amount)
        for method in ('ACH' as ach_paid, 'CARD' as card_paid, 'WIRE' as wire_paid)
    )
),
enriched_invoices as (
    select
        inv.*,
        cust.customer_name,
        cust.segment,
        cust.region,
        lr.line_count,
        lr.service_line_pct,
        lr.standard_tax_line_total,
        pr.payment_count,
        pr.avg_distinct_payment,
        pr.paid_amount,
        pp.ach_paid,
        pp.card_paid,
        pp.wire_paid
    from stg_invoice_base inv
    join dim_customers cust
      on cust.customer_id = inv.customer_id
     and cust.is_active = true
    join line_rollup lr on lr.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id
    left join payment_rollup pr on pr.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id
    left join payment_pivot pp on pp.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id
)
select
    e.invoice_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.customer_name,
    e.segment,
    e.issue_date,
    e.due_date,
    e.status,
    e.invoice_total,
    e.remittance.po_reference as po_reference,
    e.remittance.payment_terms as payment_terms,
    e.service_multiplier,
    e.large_line_total,
    e.service_line_pct,
    coalesce(e.paid_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as paid_amount,
    coalesce(e.payment_count, 0) as payment_count,
    e.avg_distinct_payment,
    e.ach_paid,
    e.card_paid,
    e.wire_paid,
    round(
        e.invoice_total - coalesce(e.paid_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))),
        2
    ) as outstanding_amount,
    -- nearby balances use a numeric range frame on distinct invoice totals
    sum(e.invoice_total) over (
        partition by e.customer_id
        order by e.invoice_total
        range between 2000 preceding and current row
    ) as nearby_invoice_volume,
    avg(e.invoice_total) over (
        partition by e.customer_id
        order by e.issue_date, e.invoice_id
        rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
    ) as prior_two_invoice_avg,
    case
        when coalesce(e.payment_count, 0) = 0 then 'NO_PAYMENTS'
        when e.invoice_total - coalesce(e.paid_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) > 2500
             and e.due_date < date '2025-04-01' then 'HIGH'
        else 'STANDARD'
    end as collection_priority
from enriched_invoices e
where not exists (
    select 1
    from fct_payments void_pmt
    where void_pmt.invoice_id = e.invoice_id
      and void_pmt.status = 'VOID'
)
order by e.customer_id, e.issue_date, e.invoice_id

/*
  Restaurant POS closeout: reconcile checks, posted tips and shift pools.
  One output row per rollup scope for the finance and service dashboards.
*/
WITH parsed_checks AS (
    -- Keep settled checks and parse operational payloads once.
    SELECT
        c.check_id,
        c.location_id,
        c.server_id,
        c.closed_at,
        c.subtotal,
        c.items,
        c.guest_profile.loyalty_tier AS loyalty_tier,
        ELEMENT_AT(c.payment_mix, 'GIFT_CARD') AS gift_card_amount,
        FROM_JSON(
            c.ops_json,
            'STRUCT<discount_code:STRING,kitchen_delay_min:INT>'
        ) AS ops_doc
    FROM restaurant_checks c
    WHERE c.status = 'CLOSED'
      AND c.closed_at IS NOT NULL
),
latest_tips AS (
    -- Deduplicate reposted card tips, retaining the latest posted event.
    SELECT check_id, tip_amount, captured_at
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.check_id
                ORDER BY t.captured_at DESC, t.tip_event_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM tip_events t
        WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
item_rollup AS (
    -- Flatten the check lines and retain a distinct SKU audit list.
    SELECT
        p.check_id,
        SUM(item.qty * item.unit_price) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT item.comped
        ) AS item_sales,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item.comped) AS comped_items,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(item.sku)) AS sku_list
    FROM parsed_checks p
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(p.items) exploded AS item
    GROUP BY p.check_id
),
tip_pool_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL tender amounts by default.
    SELECT location_id, service_date, channel, amount
    FROM daily_tip_pool
    UNPIVOT (
        amount FOR channel IN (cash_tips, card_tips, kiosk_tips)
    )
),
tip_pool_daily AS (
    SELECT
        location_id,
        service_date,
        SUM(amount) AS pooled_tip_total,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS pool_channels
    FROM tip_pool_long
    GROUP BY location_id, service_date
),
check_base AS (
    -- The grace period deliberately makes this an interval join.
    SELECT
        p.check_id,
        p.location_id,
        p.server_id,
        p.closed_at,
        p.subtotal AS net_sales,
        COALESCE(t.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS tip_amount,
        COALESCE(i.item_sales, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS item_sales,
        COALESCE(i.comped_items, 0) AS comped_items,
        i.sku_list,
        p.loyalty_tier,
        COALESCE(p.ops_doc.kitchen_delay_min, 0) AS kitchen_delay_min,
        COALESCE(p.gift_card_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS gift_card_amount,
        s.shift_id,
        s.target_sales,
        d.pooled_tip_total,
        d.pool_channels,
        SUM(COALESCE(t.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))) OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.location_id
            ORDER BY COALESCE(t.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
            RANGE BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_tip_total
    FROM parsed_checks p
    LEFT JOIN latest_tips t
        ON t.check_id = p.check_id
    LEFT JOIN item_rollup i
        ON i.check_id = p.check_id
    LEFT JOIN shift_windows s
        ON s.location_id = p.location_id
       AND s.server_id = p.server_id
       AND p.closed_at BETWEEN s.start_time
                           AND s.end_time + INTERVAL '2' HOUR
    LEFT JOIN tip_pool_daily d
        ON d.location_id = p.location_id
       AND d.service_date = TO_DATE(p.closed_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(b.location_id, 'ALL_LOCATIONS') AS location_scope,
    COALESCE(b.server_id, 'ALL_SERVERS') AS server_scope,
    COALESCE(b.shift_id, 'UNASSIGNED') AS shift_scope,
    GROUPING(b.location_id) AS location_grouping,
    GROUPING_ID(b.location_id, b.server_id, b.shift_id) AS scope_id,
    COUNT(*) AS check_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.tip_amount > 0) AS tipped_checks,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.kitchen_delay_min >= 15) AS delayed_checks,
    ROUND(SUM(b.net_sales), 2) AS gross_sales,
    ROUND(SUM(b.tip_amount), 2) AS posted_tips,
    ROUND(SUM(b.gift_card_amount), 2) AS gift_card_tender,
    ROUND(
        SUM(b.tip_amount) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(b.net_sales), 0),
        2
    ) AS tip_pct,
    SUM(b.comped_items) AS comped_items,
    MAX(b.pooled_tip_total) AS daily_pool_tips,
    MAX(b.nearby_tip_total) AS max_nearby_tip_total,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(b.loyalty_tier)) AS loyalty_tiers,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(sw.target_sales), 2) FROM shift_windows sw)
        AS fleet_avg_shift_target
FROM check_base b
GROUP BY ROLLUP (b.location_id, b.server_id, b.shift_id)
ORDER BY location_scope, scope_id, server_scope, shift_scope

    from fct_reservation_stays

        regexp_extract(a.confirmation_key, '([0-9]+)$', 1) as confirmation_sequence,

    -- explode the nightly array and retain only revenue-bearing in-stay nights

        e.market_code,
        e.confirmation_key,
        night.stay_date,
        night.rate_plan,
        night.nightly_revenue,
        date_trunc('month', night.stay_date) as stay_month,
        datediff(night.stay_date, e.booked_at) as advance_days,
        row_number() over (
            partition by e.reservation_id
            order by night.stay_date, night.rate_plan, night.nightly_revenue
        ) as night_sequence
    from stg_enriched e
    lateral view explode(e.night_breakdown) nightly as night
    where night.stay_date >= e.checkin_date

    ) metric_totals
    pivot (
        first(reservation_count) as reservation_count,
        first(average_metric_value) as average_metric_value
        for metric in ('ROOM' as room, 'TAX' as tax, 'FEE' as fee)
    )
)
select
    n.market_code,
    n.reservation_count,
    n.exploded_nights,

/*
  Daily card-account risk snapshot.
  Keep the newest version of each authorization, remove transactions with
  unresolved/won disputes, then summarize spend and channel mix by account.

WITH ranked_txn AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        txn_id,
        acct_id,
        card_id,
        merchant_id,
        txn_ts,
        amount,
        currency,
        channel,
        status,
        location,
        from_json(
            raw_payload,
            'trace_id STRING, installments INT, tip_amount DECIMAL(10,2)'
        ) AS auth_payload,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY txn_id
            ORDER BY version_ts DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM card_txn_versions
),
latest_txn AS (
    -- Version one is the current authorization state.
    SELECT
        txn_id, acct_id, card_id, merchant_id, txn_ts, amount,
        currency, channel, status, location, auth_payload
    FROM ranked_txn
    WHERE rn = 1
),
enriched_txn AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        a.customer_segment,
        a.home_country,
        a.risk_limit,
        m.merchant_name,
        m.category,
        m.risk_tier,
        t.location.country AS txn_country,
        coalesce(nullif(t.auth_payload.trace_id, ''), 'NO_TRACE') AS trace_id,
        coalesce(t.auth_payload.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS tip_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN t.status = 'DECLINED' THEN 'DECLINED'
            WHEN t.status = 'REVERSED' THEN 'REVERSED'
            WHEN t.location.country IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_GEO'
            WHEN t.location.country <> a.home_country THEN 'CROSS_BORDER'
            WHEN t.amount > a.risk_limit THEN 'HIGH_VALUE'
            ELSE 'STANDARD'
        END AS txn_label,
        (
            SELECT round(avg(a2.risk_limit), 2)
            FROM acct_profile a2
            WHERE a2.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) AS active_avg_limit
    FROM latest_txn t
    JOIN acct_profile a
      ON a.acct_id = t.acct_id
     AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
    LEFT JOIN merchant_profile m
      ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
),
eligible_txn AS (
    -- Anti-join: closed and rejected disputes do not suppress a transaction.
    SELECT e.*
    FROM enriched_txn e
    LEFT JOIN dispute_cases d
      ON d.txn_id = e.txn_id
     AND d.case_status IN ('OPEN', 'WON')
    WHERE d.txn_id IS NULL
),
acct_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        max(customer_segment) AS customer_segment,
        max(active_avg_limit) AS active_avg_limit,
        count(DISTINCT txn_id) AS txn_cnt,
        count(DISTINCT merchant_id) AS merchant_cnt,
        round(sum(amount), 2) AS gross_amount,
        round(sum(DISTINCT amount), 2) AS distinct_amount_total,
        round(sum(

        ), 2) AS approved_amount,
        round(

        ) AS approval_rate_pct,
        array_sort(collect_set(coalesce(category, 'UNMAPPED'))) AS merchant_categories,
        size(collect_set(coalesce(txn_country, 'UNKNOWN'))) AS country_cnt
    FROM eligible_txn
    GROUP BY acct_id
),
channel_pivot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT acct_id, channel, amount
        FROM eligible_txn
    )
    PIVOT (
        round(sum(amount), 2)
        FOR channel IN (
            'ECOM' AS ecom_amount,
            'POS' AS pos_amount,
            'ATM' AS atm_amount
        )
    )
)
SELECT
    r.acct_id,
    r.customer_segment,

    r.gross_amount,
    r.distinct_amount_total,
    r.approved_amount,

    p.atm_amount,
    r.active_avg_limit
FROM acct_rollup r
LEFT JOIN channel_pivot p
  ON p.acct_id = r.acct_id
ORDER BY
    approval_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST,
    gross_amount DESC,

WITH prepared_reviews AS (
    -- Keep in-scope reviews and attach seller and listing context.
    SELECT
        r.review_id,
        li.seller_id,
        r.reviewer_id,
        r.review_ts,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', r.review_ts) AS review_day,
        r.rating,
        r.status,
        COALESCE(r.helpful_votes, 0) AS helpful_votes,
        DATEDIFF(DATE_TRUNC('day', r.review_ts), s.seller_since) AS seller_age_days,
        r.review_ts + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS response_due_ts
    FROM review_events r
    JOIN product_listings li
        ON li.listing_id = r.listing_id
    JOIN seller_accounts s
        ON s.seller_id = li.seller_id
        AND s.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE r.review_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
        AND r.review_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06 00:00:00'
        AND r.status <> 'REMOVED'
),
scoped_reviews AS (
    -- Map reviews into service windows extended by a seven-day grace period.
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.window_id AS service_window_id,
        COALESCE(b.service_level, 'UNMAPPED') AS service_level
    FROM prepared_reviews a
    LEFT JOIN seller_service_windows b
        ON b.seller_id = a.seller_id
        AND a.review_ts BETWEEN b.window_start
            AND b.window_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
),
lagged_reviews AS (
    -- Find each reviewer's previous retained review in strict time order.
    SELECT
        sc.*,
        LAG(sc.review_ts) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.reviewer_id
            ORDER BY sc.review_ts, sc.review_id
        ) AS previous_review_ts
    FROM scoped_reviews sc
),
session_flags AS (
    -- Start a new session after the first review or a gap over ninety minutes.
    SELECT
        lr.*,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, lr.previous_review_ts, lr.review_ts) AS minutes_since_previous,
        CASE
            WHEN lr.previous_review_ts IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, lr.previous_review_ts, lr.review_ts) > 90 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM lagged_reviews lr
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Turn gap flags into reviewer-local session sequence numbers.
    SELECT
        sf.*,
        SUM(sf.new_session_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sf.reviewer_id
            ORDER BY sf.review_ts, sf.review_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_seq
    FROM session_flags sf
),
daily_metrics AS (
    -- Aggregate review quality, coverage and reviewer sessions by seller-day.
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        review_day,
        COUNT(*) AS review_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_review_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE service_window_id IS NOT NULL) AS window_mapped_review_count,
        AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
        AVG(DISTINCT rating) AS avg_distinct_rating,
        SUM(DISTINCT helpful_votes) AS distinct_helpful_votes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT reviewer_id) AS distinct_reviewers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(reviewer_id, '-', session_seq)) AS distinct_sessions,
        MAX(seller_age_days) AS seller_age_days,
        MIN(response_due_ts) AS first_response_due_ts
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY seller_id, review_day
)
SELECT
    d.seller_id,
    s.seller_name,
    d.review_day,
    d.review_count,
    d.published_review_count,
    d.window_mapped_review_count,
    ROUND(d.avg_rating, 2) AS avg_rating,
    ROUND(d.avg_distinct_rating, 2) AS avg_distinct_rating,
    d.distinct_helpful_votes,
    d.distinct_reviewers,
    d.distinct_sessions,
    ROUND(
        AVG(d.published_review_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.seller_id
            ORDER BY d.review_day
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ),
        2
    ) AS prior_two_day_published_avg,
    d.seller_age_days,
    d.first_response_due_ts

        status,
        declared_value,
        temp_excursion_minutes,
        damaged_bottles,
        returned_bottles,
        items,
        COALESCE(parsed_route.depot_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS depot_code,
        COALESCE(parsed_route.distance_km, 0.0D) AS distance_km,
        COALESCE(parsed_route.signature_required, FALSE) AS signature_required
    FROM (
        SELECT
            shp.*,
            FROM_JSON(
                route_notes,
                'STRUCT<depot_code: STRING, distance_km: DOUBLE, signature_required: BOOLEAN>'
            ) AS parsed_route
        FROM stg_wine_shipments shp
    ) parsed
),
stg_item_rollup AS (
    -- Explode bottle lines and audit both physical and distinct line quantities.
    SELECT
        shp.shipment_id,
        SUM(item.bottles) AS shipped_bottles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT item.sku) AS distinct_skus,
        SUM(DISTINCT item.bottles) AS distinct_bottle_quantity_sum,
        SUM(item.bottles * item.unit_price) AS merchandise_value,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(item.sku)) AS sku_list
    FROM stg_shipment_base shp
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(shp.items) AS item
    GROUP BY shp.shipment_id
),
stg_quality_long AS (
    -- Convert quality measures to rows; SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL measurements.
    SELECT shipment_id, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM stg_shipment_base
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            temp_excursion_minutes,
            damaged_bottles,
            returned_bottles
        )
    )
),
stg_quality_rollup AS (
    -- Summarize exceptions while retaining separate temperature and bottle KPIs.
    SELECT
        shipment_id,
        COUNT(*) AS observed_metric_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE metric_name = 'temp_excursion_minutes' AND metric_value >= 20
        ) AS heat_excursion_flags,
        SUM(metric_value) FILTER (
            WHERE metric_name <> 'temp_excursion_minutes'
        ) AS bottle_issue_total,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(

        )) AS metrics_with_issues
    FROM stg_quality_long

      and h.station_id is null

    select r.reading_id, r.station_id, r.observed_at,
           r.temp_c, r.feels_like_c, r.wind_kph, r.precip_mm,
           s.station_name, s.region, s.site_country, s.climate_zone,
           transform(coalesce(r.quality_flags, array()),
                     flag -> upper(flag)) as normalized_flags
    from weather_readings r
    join active_stations s on s.station_id = r.station_id
),
reading_gaps as (
    select *,
           filter(normalized_flags, flag -> flag <> 'OK') as issue_flags,
           exists(normalized_flags,
                  flag -> flag in ('OUTLIER', 'OFFLINE')) as has_blocking_flag,
           aggregate(normalized_flags, 0,
                     (acc, flag) -> acc + case when flag = 'ESTIMATED' then 1 else 2 end
           ) as quality_penalty,
           lag(observed_at) over (
               partition by station_id
               order by observed_at, reading_id
           ) as prev_observed_at
    from readings_enriched
),
sessionized as (
    -- a three-hour silence starts a new observation session
    select *,
           sum(case when prev_observed_at is null
                      or observed_at > prev_observed_at + interval '3' hour
                    then 1 else 0 end) over (
               partition by station_id
               order by observed_at, reading_id
               rows between unbounded preceding and current row
           ) as session_seq,
           avg(temp_c) over (
               partition by station_id
               order by observed_at, reading_id
               rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
           ) as recent_temp_avg,
           case when size(issue_flags) = 0 then 'nominal'
                else array_join(array_sort(issue_flags), ',') end as flag_label
    from reading_gaps

/*
  App-store quality digest: normalize download receipts, attach featuring
  windows (including a 36-hour grace period), and unfold app KPIs for BI.
  String pivot values retain a compact operating-system download summary.
*/
with app_base as (
    select
        a.app_id,
        a.app_name,
        a.category,
        coalesce(element_at(a.app_meta, 'content_tier'), 'UNSET') as content_tier,
        size(map_keys(a.app_meta)) as meta_key_cnt,
        concat_ws(
            ':', upper(a.store_region),
            lpad(coalesce(element_at(a.app_meta, 'build_track'), 'x'), 3, '0'),
            array_join(slice(split(a.developer_ref, '\\|'), 1, 2), '~')
        ) as app_ref
    from app_catalog a
),
normalized_downloads as (
    select
        d.txn_id, d.app_id, d.acct_id, d.downloaded_at, d.qty, d.status,
        lower(regexp_replace(d.device_os, '[^A-Za-z]', '')) as os_norm,
        cast(regexp_extract(d.receipt_ref, '^DL-([0-9]{4})$', 1) as int) as receipt_seq,
        w.window_id,
        w.window_label
    from download_txn d
    left join feature_windows w
      on w.app_id = d.app_id
     and d.downloaded_at between w.start_time and w.end_time + interval '36' hour
    -- malformed receipts and void transactions never enter the digest
    where d.receipt_ref rlike '^DL-[0-9]{4}$'
      and d.status <> 'VOID'
),
download_metrics as (
    select
        n.app_id,
        count(distinct n.txn_id) as valid_txn_cnt,
        count(distinct n.acct_id) as distinct_acct_cnt,
        sum(distinct n.qty) as distinct_qty_sum,
        size(collect_set(n.os_norm)) as os_variety_cnt,
        array_join(
            array_sort(collect_set(coalesce(n.window_label, 'ORGANIC'))), ','
        ) as window_labels
    from normalized_downloads n
    group by n.app_id
),
os_pivot as (
    select app_id, ios_summary, android_summary
    from (
        select n.app_id, n.os_norm, n.qty, n.window_label
        from normalized_downloads n
    ) s
    pivot (
        max(concat_ws(':', coalesce(window_label, 'ORGANIC'), lpad(cast(qty as string), 2, '0')))
        for os_norm in ('ios' as ios_summary, 'android' as android_summary)
    )
),
rating_metrics as (
    select
        r.app_id,
        count(*) as rating_cnt,
        count(*) filter (where r.sentiment = 'POSITIVE') as positive_rating_cnt,
        count(*) filter (where r.sentiment = 'NEGATIVE') as negative_rating_cnt,
        percentile_approx(r.rating, 0.5) as median_rating
    from (
        select
            f.app_id, f.rating,
            regexp_replace(coalesce(f.review_txt, ''), '\\s+', ' ') as review_clean,
            case
                when f.review_txt rlike '(?i)great|love|smooth' then 'POSITIVE'
                when f.review_txt rlike '(?i)crash|bad|slow' then 'NEGATIVE'
                else 'NEUTRAL'
            end as sentiment
        from rating_feedback f
    ) r
    group by r.app_id
),
app_metrics as (
    select
        b.app_id,
        b.app_ref,
        b.category,
        b.content_tier,
        b.meta_key_cnt,
        d.window_labels,
        d.os_variety_cnt,
        concat_ws(
            '/', cast(coalesce(r.positive_rating_cnt, 0) as string),
            cast(coalesce(r.negative_rating_cnt, 0) as string)
        ) as review_outcome_mix,
        p.ios_summary,
        p.android_summary,
        cast(coalesce(d.valid_txn_cnt, 0) as double) as valid_txn_cnt,
        cast(coalesce(d.distinct_acct_cnt, 0) as double) as distinct_acct_cnt,
        cast(coalesce(d.distinct_qty_sum, 0) as double) as distinct_qty_sum,
        cast(coalesce(r.positive_rating_cnt, 0) as double) as positive_rating_cnt,
        cast(r.median_rating as double) as median_rating,
        lag(coalesce(r.median_rating, 0.0), 1, 0.0)
            over (order by b.app_id) as prev_median_rating,
        lead(coalesce(r.median_rating, 0.0), 2, 0.0)
            over (order by b.app_id) as next2_median_rating
    from app_base b
    left join download_metrics d on d.app_id = b.app_id
    left join rating_metrics r on r.app_id = b.app_id
    left join os_pivot p on p.app_id = b.app_id
)

WITH lagged_scans AS (
    SELECT scan_id,
           tracking_no,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(courier_id, ''), 'UNASSIGNED') AS courier_id,
           facility_id,
           scan_ts,
           UPPER(scan_type) AS scan_type,
           dwell_minutes,
           temperature_c,
           humidity_pct,
           damage_flag,
           LAG(scan_ts) OVER (
               PARTITION BY tracking_no ORDER BY scan_ts, scan_id
           ) AS prev_scan_ts,
           LAG(COALESCE(NULLIF(courier_id, ''), 'UNASSIGNED')) OVER (
               PARTITION BY tracking_no ORDER BY scan_ts, scan_id
           ) AS prev_courier_id
    FROM stg_parcel_scans
    WHERE tracking_no IS NOT NULL
      AND scan_ts IS NOT NULL
      AND scan_type <> 'CANCELLED'
),
sessionized_scans AS (
    -- A courier change or a gap over 90 minutes starts a new work session.
    SELECT *,
           SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN prev_scan_ts IS NULL THEN 1
                   WHEN prev_courier_id <> courier_id THEN 1
                   WHEN scan_ts > prev_scan_ts + INTERVAL '90' MINUTE THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) OVER (
               PARTITION BY tracking_no
               ORDER BY scan_ts, scan_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_no
    FROM lagged_scans
),
session_rollup AS (
    SELECT tracking_no,
           session_no,
           courier_id,
           MIN(scan_ts) AS session_start,
           MAX(scan_ts) AS session_end,
           UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(scan_ts)) AS session_start_epoch,
           COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT scan_type) AS distinct_scan_types,
           SUM(DISTINCT dwell_minutes) AS distinct_dwell_minutes,
           ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT temperature_c), 2) AS avg_temperature_c,
           MAX(CASE WHEN damage_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS damaged_flag,
           COALESCE(
               MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'PICKUP' THEN 'CAPTURED' END),
               'NOT_SEEN'
           ) AS pickup_state,
           CASE
               WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'EXCEPTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                   THEN 'EXCEPTION'
               WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'DEPART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                   THEN 'IN_TRANSIT'
               WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'ARRIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                   THEN 'ARRIVED'
               ELSE 'NO_LINEHAUL'
           END AS transit_state,
           COALESCE(
               MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'DELIVER' THEN 'COMPLETED' END),
               'PENDING'
           ) AS delivery_state
    FROM sessionized_scans
    GROUP BY tracking_no, session_no, courier_id
),
status_long AS (
    SELECT tracking_no, session_no, metric, status_value
    FROM session_rollup
    UNPIVOT (
        status_value FOR metric IN (
            pickup_state AS PICKUP,
            transit_state AS TRANSIT,
            delivery_state AS DELIVERY
        )
    )
),
status_pivot AS (
    SELECT tracking_no,
           session_no,
           pickup_state,
           transit_state,
           delivery_state
    FROM status_long
    PIVOT (
        MAX(status_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'PICKUP' AS pickup_state,
            'TRANSIT' AS transit_state,
            'DELIVERY' AS delivery_state
        )
    )
),
session_enriched AS (
    SELECT sr.*,
           sp.pickup_state AS pivoted_pickup_state,
           sp.transit_state AS pivoted_transit_state,
           sp.delivery_state AS pivoted_delivery_state
    FROM session_rollup sr
    JOIN status_pivot sp
      ON sp.tracking_no = sr.tracking_no
     AND sp.session_no = sr.session_no
)
SELECT se.*,
       c.courier_name,
       c.home_region,
       r.leg_count,
       r.distance_km,
       r.actual_leg_minutes,
       r.planned_leg_minutes,
       r.median_leg_minutes,
       CASE
           WHEN se.courier_id = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN 'UNASSIGNED'
           WHEN c.courier_id IS NULL THEN 'ROSTER_GAP'
           WHEN c.active_flag = FALSE THEN 'INACTIVE_COURIER'

WITH latest_impressions AS (
    -- Keep only the newest version of each impression for delivery reporting.
    SELECT li.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY impression_id
               ORDER BY event_ts DESC, event_version DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM fct_ad_impression_events li
),
valid_clicks AS (
    -- Count usable clicks; suspicious and unknown-review clicks are not usable.
    SELECT impression_id,
           COUNT(*) AS click_count
    FROM fct_ad_click_events
    WHERE COALESCE(is_suspicious, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY impression_id
),
delivery_base AS (
    -- Enrich clean impressions, parse consent JSON, and classify engagement.
    SELECT li.*,
           COALESCE(c.campaign_name, 'Unassigned campaign') AS campaign_name,
           COALESCE(c.channel, 'unknown') AS channel,
           COALESCE(clk.click_count, 0) AS click_count,
           q.quality_score,
           CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.consent') AS BOOLEAN) AS consent_flag,
           CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.viewability') AS DOUBLE) AS viewability,
           TRANSFORM(
               FILTER(li.context_tags, tag -> tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> 'internal'),
               tag -> UPPER(tag)
           ) AS audience_tags,
           EXISTS(li.context_tags, tag -> tag = 'premium') AS premium_context,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(li.placement, ''), 'unknown') AS placement_name,
           CASE
               WHEN CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.consent') AS BOOLEAN) = FALSE
                   THEN 'consent_blocked'
               WHEN COALESCE(li.engaged_seconds, 0) >= 20
                    AND COALESCE(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.viewability') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) >= 0.7
                   THEN 'deep_engagement'
               WHEN COALESCE(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.viewability') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) >= 0.5
                   THEN 'light_engagement'
               ELSE 'unclassified'
           END AS engagement_label,
           AVG(li.media_cost) OVER (
               PARTITION BY COALESCE(c.channel, 'unknown')
               ORDER BY q.quality_score
               RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_quality_avg_cost
    FROM latest_impressions li
    LEFT JOIN valid_clicks clk
        ON clk.impression_id = li.impression_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_ad_campaigns c
        ON c.campaign_id = li.campaign_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_creative_quality q
        ON q.creative_id = li.creative_id
    WHERE li.rn = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_ad_click_events sc
          WHERE sc.impression_id = li.impression_id
            AND sc.is_suspicious = TRUE
      )
),
daily_metrics AS (
    -- Build campaign, placement, and engagement delivery segments by day.
    SELECT DATE(event_ts) AS delivery_date,
           campaign_id,
           campaign_name,
           channel,
           engagement_label,
           placement_name,
           COUNT(*) AS impression_count,
           SUM(click_count) AS click_count,
           SUM(media_cost) AS media_spend,
           AVG(nearby_quality_avg_cost) AS quality_peer_cost
    FROM delivery_base
    GROUP BY DATE(event_ts), campaign_id, campaign_name, channel,
             engagement_label, placement_name
),
delivery_with_trend AS (
    -- Add a strictly trailing two-row impression baseline within each segment.
    SELECT dm.*,
           COALESCE(
               SUM(impression_count) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY campaign_id, engagement_label, placement_name
                   ORDER BY delivery_date
                   ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
               ),
               0
           ) AS prior_two_period_impressions
    FROM daily_metrics dm
),
unpivoted_metrics AS (
    -- Turn delivery measures into a long metric table; null measures are omitted.
    SELECT delivery_date,
           campaign_id,
           campaign_name,
           channel,
           engagement_label,
           placement_name,
           prior_two_period_impressions,
           metric_name,
           metric_value
    FROM delivery_with_trend
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            impression_count AS impressions,
            click_count AS clicks,
            media_spend AS media_spend
        )
    )
)
-- Roll up the long metrics from campaign detail through the network total.
SELECT metric_name,
       COALESCE(channel, 'ALL_CHANNELS') AS channel_label,
       COALESCE(campaign_name, 'ALL_CAMPAIGNS') AS campaign_label,
       GROUPING_ID(metric_name, channel, campaign_name) AS grouping_id,
       CASE GROUPING_ID(metric_name, channel, campaign_name)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'campaign_metric'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'channel_metric'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'metric_total'
           ELSE 'network_total'
       END AS aggregation_grain,
       ROUND(SUM(metric_value), 2) AS metric_value,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE
           WHEN metric_name = 'impressions'
               THEN CAST(prior_two_period_impressions AS DECIMAL(20,2))
       END), 2) AS avg_prior_two_period_impressions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT placement_name) AS placement_count,
       MAX(delivery_date) AS last_delivery_date
FROM unpivoted_metrics
GROUP BY ROLLUP(metric_name, channel, campaign_name)
ORDER BY metric_name, grouping_id, channel_label, campaign_label

WITH parsed_usage AS (
    SELECT
        usage_id,
        acct_id,
        resource_id,
        service,
        region,
        usage_ts,
        qty,
        from_json(
            attributes_json,
            'STRUCT<environment:STRING, instance_family:STRING, committed:BOOLEAN>'
        ) AS parsed_attrs,
        transform(labels, x -> upper(x)) AS normalized_labels,
        filter(labels, x -> startswith(x, 'cost:')) AS cost_labels,
        exists(labels, x -> x = 'prod') AS has_prod_label
    FROM usage_metering
    WHERE acct_id IS NOT NULL
),
rated_usage AS (
    -- The seven-day grace period covers usage between rate versions.
    SELECT
        u.*,
        r.sku,
        r.unit_price,
        r.discount_pct,
        u.qty * r.unit_price * (1 - coalesce(r.discount_pct, 0) / 100) AS extended_cost
    FROM parsed_usage u
    JOIN rate_cards r
      ON u.service = r.service
     AND u.region = r.region
     AND u.usage_ts BETWEEN r.effective_start
                        AND r.effective_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
),
usage_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        CAST(date_trunc('MM', usage_ts) AS DATE) AS billing_month,
        service,
        sum(qty) AS usage_qty,
        round(sum(extended_cost), 2) AS gross_cost,
        sum(DISTINCT qty) AS distinct_qty_sum,
        avg(DISTINCT qty) AS avg_distinct_qty,
        count(DISTINCT resource_id) AS resource_count,
        array_sort(collect_set(resource_id)) AS resource_ids,
        array_sort(collect_set(parsed_attrs.environment)) AS environments,
        array_sort(collect_set(sku)) AS skus,
        max(has_prod_label) AS has_prod_usage,
        max(size(cost_labels)) AS max_cost_labels
    FROM rated_usage
    GROUP BY
        acct_id,
        CAST(date_trunc('MM', usage_ts) AS DATE),
        service
),
invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        usage_month,
        sum(compute_amt) AS compute_amt,

with flattened_events as (
    select
        le.event_id,
        le.user_id,
        le.session_id,
        le.event_ts,
        cast(le.event_ts as date) as login_day,
        le.status,
        le.device.platform as device_platform,
        le.device.is_managed as is_managed,
        signal.signal_code,
        signal.severity as signal_severity,
        signal.weight as signal_weight,
        lag(le.status, 1, 'NO_PRIOR_EVENT') over (
            partition by le.user_id
            order by le.event_ts, le.event_id
        ) as prior_status,
        lead(le.status, 2, 'NO_FUTURE_EVENT') over (
            partition by le.user_id
            order by le.event_ts, le.event_id
        ) as following_status
    from login_events le
    lateral view explode(le.risk_signals) exploded as signal
    where le.event_ts >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and le.event_ts < timestamp '2025-03-05 00:00:00'
),
daily_activity as (
    select
        user_id,
        login_day,
        count(distinct event_id) as total_events,
        count(distinct event_id) filter (where status = 'FAILURE') as failed_events,
        count(*) filter (
            where status = 'SUCCESS' and signal_severity >= 3
        ) as high_severity_success_rows,
        count(distinct session_id) as session_count,
        array_sort(collect_set(signal_code)) as signal_codes,
        array_sort(collect_set(device_platform)) as device_platforms,
        -- Explosion can repeat weights, so only distinct weights contribute.
        sum(distinct signal_weight) as distinct_signal_weight,
        count(distinct event_id) filter (
            where prior_status = 'FAILURE' and status = 'SUCCESS'
        ) as recovery_events,
        max(case when following_status = 'NO_FUTURE_EVENT' then 1 else 0 end) as tail_event_flag
    from flattened_events
    group by user_id, login_day
),
alert_daily as (
    select
        user_id,
        cast(opened_at as date) as login_day,
        count(*) filter (where status <> 'CLOSED') as open_alerts,
        count(distinct alert_id) as total_alerts,
        array_sort(collect_set(severity)) as alert_severities,
        max(case when owner is null then 1 else 0 end) as unassigned_alert_flag,

    from fct_billing_lines b
    lateral view explode(adjustments) adj as item
),
stg_admission_totals as (
    select
        admission_id,
        sum(distinct gross_amount) as distinct_gross_amount,
        count(distinct line_id) as billed_line_count,
        count(*) filter (where line_status = 'DENIED') as denied_adjustment_rows,
        sum(adjustment_amount) filter (where adjustment_type = 'DISCOUNT') as discount_amount
    from stg_adjustment_rows

WITH scoped_projects AS (
    SELECT prj.project_id,
           prj.region,
           prj.status,
           prj.contract_value,
           prj.contingency_rate,
           FLOOR(CAST(prj.contract_value AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 100000) AS contract_100k_floor,
           CEIL(prj.contingency_rate * 100) AS contingency_pct_ceil
    FROM project_master prj
    WHERE prj.contract_value >= CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL(14,2))
      AND prj.status <> 'ARCHIVED'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM change_order_txn ex
          WHERE ex.project_id = prj.project_id
            AND ex.status = 'APPROVED'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM project_compliance_review nx
          WHERE nx.project_id = prj.project_id
            AND nx.review_type = 'STOP_WORK'
            AND nx.cleared_ts IS NULL
      )
),
metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT project_id, actual_cost, budget_cost, forecast_cost
    FROM project_cost_metric
    PIVOT (
        SUM(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'ACTUAL' AS actual_cost,
            'BUDGET' AS budget_cost,
            'FORECAST' AS forecast_cost
        )
    )
),
co_enriched AS (
    SELECT priced.*,
           FILTER(normalized_risks, x -> x IN ('PERMIT', 'WEATHER', 'DESIGN')) AS active_risks,
           AVG(co_amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id
               ORDER BY submitted_ts, co_id
               ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ) AS prior_two_avg,
           SUM(co_amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id
               ORDER BY qty
               RANGE BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS range_exposure
    FROM (
        SELECT txn.*,
               ROUND(
                   CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))
                   * (1 + tax_rate),
                   2
               ) AS co_amount,
               TRANSFORM(COALESCE(risk_codes, ARRAY()), x -> UPPER(x)) AS normalized_risks
        FROM change_order_txn txn
    ) priced
),
co_ledger AS (
    -- Approved value carries related-quantity exposure and a risk allowance.
    SELECT project_id,
           'APPROVED' AS component,
           ROUND(
               co_amount + (range_exposure - co_amount) * 0.02
               + CASE WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(active_risks) > 0 THEN 250 ELSE 0 END,
               2
           ) AS component_value
    FROM co_enriched
    WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
    UNION ALL
    -- Pipeline value is incremental to the previous two submissions.
    SELECT project_id,
           'PIPELINE' AS component,
           ROUND(
               GREATEST(co_amount - COALESCE(prior_two_avg, 0), 0)
               + range_exposure * 0.01,
               2
           ) AS component_value
    FROM co_enriched
    WHERE status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW')
),
co_pivot AS (
    SELECT project_id, approved_change_value, pipeline_change_value
    FROM co_ledger
    PIVOT (
        SUM(component_value)
        FOR component IN (
            'APPROVED' AS approved_change_value,
            'PIPELINE' AS pipeline_change_value
        )
    )
),
regional_rollup AS (
    SELECT prj.region,
           prj.status,
           GROUPING_ID(prj.region, prj.status) AS grouping_id,
           COUNT(*) AS project_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prj.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_project_count,
           ROUND(SUM(met.actual_cost), 2) AS actual_cost,
           ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(co.approved_change_value, 0)), 2) AS approved_change_value,
           ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(co.pipeline_change_value, 0)), 2) AS pipeline_change_value,
           FLOOR(SUM(met.budget_cost) / 1000) AS budget_k_floor,
           CEIL(SUM(met.forecast_cost - met.actual_cost) / 1000) AS remaining_k_ceil,
           ROUND(SUM(prj.contract_value * prj.contingency_rate), 2) AS contingency_value,
           ROUND(AVG(prj.contingency_pct_ceil), 2) AS avg_contingency_pct,
           MAX(prj.contract_100k_floor) AS max_contract_100k_floor
    FROM scoped_projects prj
    JOIN metric_pivot met
      ON met.project_id = prj.project_id
    LEFT JOIN co_pivot co
      ON co.project_id = prj.project_id
    -- Unresolved environmental reviews are excluded via an anti-join pattern.
    LEFT JOIN project_compliance_review rev
      ON rev.project_id = prj.project_id
     AND rev.review_type = 'ENVIRONMENTAL'
     AND rev.cleared_ts IS NULL
    WHERE rev.review_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (prj.region, prj.status),
        (prj.region),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT CASE
           WHEN grouping_id = 3 THEN 'ALL_REGIONS'
           ELSE region
       END AS region_label,
       CASE
           WHEN grouping_id >= 1 THEN 'ALL_STATUSES'
           ELSE status
       END AS status_label,
       grouping_id,
       project_count,
       active_project_count,
       actual_cost,
       approved_change_value,
       pipeline_change_value,
       budget_k_floor,
       remaining_k_ceil,
       contingency_value,
       avg_contingency_pct,
       max_contract_100k_floor
FROM regional_rollup
ORDER BY grouping_id DESC, region_label, status_label

with prepared as (
    -- normalize authentication text, derive weak-method flags, and apply account policy
    select e.event_id,
           e.acct_id,
           e.occurred_at,
           e.auth_channel,
           e.status,
           regexp_extract(e.source_ip, r'^(\d+\.\d+)\.', 1) as subnet,
           lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(e.device_id, 'unknown'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '')) as device_norm,
           e.latency_ms,
           transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> upper(x)) as methods_upper,
           filter(transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> upper(x)), x -> x in ('PASSWORD', 'LEGACY')) as weak_methods,
           aggregate(transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> length(x)), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x) as method_name_chars,
           exists(e.attempted_methods, x -> x = 'push') as used_push,
           element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up') as step_up_points,
           from_json(p.policy_json, 'struct<required_factor:string,alert_floor:int>').required_factor as required_factor,
           cast(round(coalesce(e.latency_ms, 0) * p.risk_multiplier
                + coalesce(element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up'), 0) / 10.0, 2) as decimal(12,2)) as weighted_risk,
           floor((coalesce(e.latency_ms, 0) * p.risk_multiplier
                + coalesce(element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up'), 0) / 10.0) * 1.10) as risk_floor,
           ceil((coalesce(e.latency_ms, 0) * p.risk_multiplier
                + coalesce(element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up'), 0) / 10.0) + 0.5) as risk_ceiling,
           case
               when e.status = 'FAILURE'
                    and size(filter(transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> upper(x)), x -> x in ('PASSWORD', 'LEGACY'))) > 0
                   then 'WEAK_AUTH_FAILURE'
               when e.status = 'FAILURE' then 'FAILURE'
               when e.geo_country <> p.home_country then 'TRAVEL'
               else 'STANDARD'
           end as event_class
    from auth_login_events e
    join acct_security_profiles p on p.acct_id = e.acct_id
    where e.occurred_at >= timestamp '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
      and e.source_ip rlike '^[0-9]{1,3}(\\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$'
),
rollup_stats as (
    -- calculate detail, subnet subtotal, and grand-total security measures
    select subnet,
           auth_channel,
           grouping_id(subnet, auth_channel) as grp_id,
           count(*) as login_qty,
           count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILURE') as failed_qty,
           count(*) filter (where event_class = 'TRAVEL') as travel_qty,
           percentile_approx(coalesce(latency_ms, 0), 0.5) as p50_latency_ms,
           array_sort(collect_set(device_norm)) as device_ids,
           max(weighted_risk) as max_weighted_risk,
           sum(step_up_points) filter (where used_push) as push_step_up_points,
           max(case when required_factor = 'mfa' and not used_push then 1 else 0 end) as mfa_gap_flag
    from prepared
    group by grouping sets ((subnet, auth_channel), (subnet), ())
),
metric_wide as (
    -- pivot the snapshot metric names into typed decimal columns
    select *
    from login_metric_snapshots
    pivot (
        max(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'FAILED_LOGINS' as failed_logins,
            'MEDIAN_LATENCY_MS' as median_latency_ms,
            'UNIQUE_DEVICES' as unique_devices
        )
    )
),
metric_long as (
    -- unpivot snapshots so each externally reported metric remains comparable
    select subnet, auth_channel, metric_name, metric_value
    from metric_wide
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric_name in (failed_logins, median_latency_ms, unique_devices)
    )
),
scored as (
    -- attach long-form metrics only to detail rows while retaining subtotal rows
    select r.*,
           m.metric_name,
           m.metric_value
    from rollup_stats r
    left join metric_long m
      on r.grp_id = 0
     and m.subnet = r.subnet
     and m.auth_channel = r.auth_channel
)
select subnet,
       coalesce(auth_channel, 'ALL_CHANNELS') as auth_channel,
       grp_id,
       case grp_id
           when 0 then 'SUBNET_CHANNEL'
           when 1 then 'SUBNET_TOTAL'
           else 'GRAND_TOTAL'
       end as auth_scope,
       login_qty,
       failed_qty,
       travel_qty,
       round(cast(failed_qty as decimal(12,4)) * 100 / nullif(login_qty, 0), 2) as failure_pct,
       p50_latency_ms,
       concat_ws(',', device_ids) as device_list,
       max_weighted_risk,
       push_step_up_points,
       mfa_gap_flag,
       metric_name,
       metric_value
from scored
order by grp_id,
         subnet nulls last,
         scored.auth_channel nulls last,

with po_base as (
    -- clean purchase orders and derive timing and nested payload fields
    select
        po_id,
        vendor_id,
        buyer_acct,
        status,
        total_amt,
        txn_ts,
        actual_receipt_ts,
        date_trunc('month', txn_ts) as txn_month,
        txn_ts + interval '36' hour as ack_due_ts,
        coalesce(actual_receipt_ts, txn_ts + interval '240' hour) as effective_receipt_ts,
        datediff(promised_date, cast(txn_ts as date)) as promise_days,
        timestampdiff(
            hour,
            txn_ts,
            coalesce(actual_receipt_ts, txn_ts + interval '240' hour)
        ) as receipt_hours,
        shipping_address.country as ship_country,
        from_json(payload_json, 'source STRING, expedited BOOLEAN, priority INT') as po_meta,
        case
            when actual_receipt_ts is null then 'PENDING'
            when actual_receipt_ts <= cast(promised_date as timestamp) + interval '1' day
                then 'ON_TIME'
            else 'LATE'
        end as delivery_health
    from purchase_order_headers
    where txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      and status <> 'CANCELLED'
),
line_totals as (
    -- collapse line-item quantities and amounts to one row per po
    select
        po_id,
        sum(qty * unit_price) as line_amt,
        sum(receipt_qty) as received_qty,
        count(distinct sku) as sku_count
    from purchase_order_lines
    group by po_id
),
po_activity as (
    -- attach commercial line measures and flatten JSON attributes
    select
        h.*,
        coalesce(l.line_amt, 0) as line_amt,
        coalesce(l.received_qty, 0) as received_qty,
        l.sku_count,
        coalesce(h.po_meta.expedited, false) as expedited_flag,
        coalesce(h.po_meta.priority, 9) as priority
    from po_base h
    join line_totals l on l.po_id = h.po_id
),
po_timeline as (
    -- compare each txn with neighboring vendor activity and nearby promises
    select
        a.*,
        lag(txn_ts, 1, timestamp '2024-12-31 00:00:00') over (
            partition by vendor_id order by txn_ts, po_id
        ) as prev_txn_ts,
        lead(status, 2, 'END_OF_QUEUE') over (
            partition by vendor_id order by txn_ts, po_id
        ) as status_two_pos_ahead,
        sum(total_amt) over (
            partition by vendor_id
            order by promise_days
            range between 2 preceding and current row
        ) as nearby_promise_spend
    from po_activity a
),
vendor_quality as (
    -- pivot the current monthly vendor scorecard into quality measures
    select *
    from (
        select vendor_id, metric, score_value
        from vendor_scorecards
        where metric_month = date '2025-03-01'
    )
    pivot (
        avg(score_value)
        for metric in (
            'OTD' as otd,
            'DEFECT' as defect_rate,
            'RESPONSE' as response_score
        )
    )
),
enriched as (
    -- retain the po star while adding active vendor maps and quality scores
    select
        a.*,
        v.vendor_name,
        v.region,
        element_at(v.vendor_attributes, 'tier') as vendor_tier,
        size(map_keys(v.vendor_attributes)) as attribute_count,
        q.otd,
        q.defect_rate,
        q.response_score
    from po_timeline a
    join vendor_master v
      on v.vendor_id = a.vendor_id
     and v.active_flag = true
    left join vendor_quality q on q.vendor_id = a.vendor_id
)
-- summarize detail months, vendor subtotals, and one enterprise total
select
    coalesce(vendor_name, 'ALL_VENDORS') as vendor_label,
    txn_month,
    grouping_id(vendor_name, txn_month) as grp_level,
    count(distinct po_id) as po_count,
    sum(distinct total_amt) as distinct_po_spend,
    round(avg(line_amt), 2) as avg_line_amt,
    sum(case when delivery_health = 'LATE' then 1 else 0 end) as late_pos,
    sum(case when expedited_flag then 1 else 0 end) as expedited_pos,
    round(avg(priority), 2) as avg_priority,
    round(avg(receipt_hours), 1) as avg_receipt_hours,
    max(datediff(txn_ts, prev_txn_ts)) as max_gap_days,
    sum(case when status_two_pos_ahead = 'END_OF_QUEUE' then 1 else 0 end) as queue_tail_pos,
    max(nearby_promise_spend) as peak_nearby_promise_spend,
    max(vendor_tier) as vendor_tier,
    max(attribute_count) as attribute_count,
    round(avg(otd), 1) as avg_otd,
    round(avg(defect_rate), 2) as avg_defect_rate
from enriched
group by rollup (vendor_name, txn_month)
order by grp_level, vendor_label, txn_month nulls last

/*
  Learning-session quality report.
  Explodes quiz responses, summarizes attempt bands, and joins them to
  gap-based study sessions for course coaches.
*/
with answer_detail as (
    -- one row per response; retain only attempts in the reporting window
    select
        a.attempt_id, a.learner_id, a.course_id, a.status, a.score,
        concat(
            get_json_object(a.device_info_json, '$.device'), '-v',
            regexp_extract(get_json_object(a.device_info_json, '$.app_version'), '^(\\d+)', 1)
        ) as device_label,
        item.question_id, item.awarded_points,
        case when item.question_id rlike '^(MCQ|CODE)-' then 'auto' else 'manual' end as grading_kind,
        transform(filter(item.tags, x -> x is not null), x -> upper(x)) as clean_tags,
        exists(item.tags, x -> x = 'critical') as has_critical
    from quiz_attempts a
    lateral view explode(a.answer_reviews) ans as item
    where a.started_at >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
),
attempt_rollup as (
    select
        learner_id, course_id, attempt_id, status, score,
        max(device_label) as device_label,
        count(*) as answer_count,
        count(*) filter (where grading_kind = 'auto') as auto_answers,
        sum(
            awarded_points + size(clean_tags)
            + case when has_critical then 5 else 0 end
        ) as weighted_points,
        case
            when score >= 85 then 'gold'
            when score >= 70 then 'silver'
            else 'bronze'
        end as score_band
    from answer_detail
    group by learner_id, course_id, attempt_id, status, score
),
band_pivot as (
    -- string bands and numeric response metrics in one pivot
    select
        learner_id, course_id,
        coalesce(graded_band, 'none') as graded_band,
        coalesce(review_band, 'none') as review_band,
        coalesce(abandoned_band, 'none') as abandoned_band,
        graded_points, review_points, abandoned_points,
        graded_auto_answers, review_auto_answers, abandoned_auto_answers,
        graded_device, review_device, abandoned_device
    from (
