/*
  Monthly review of exceptional circulation activity.
  Open/renewed loans and notable March returns are eligible only when a
  related hold exists and the checkout did not overlap a patron suspension.
*/
WITH branch_metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT branch_id, metric, metric_value
        FROM branch_metrics
        WHERE snapshot_date = DATE '2025-03-31'
    ) metric_src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'CIRCULATION' AS circulation,
            'HOLDS_FILLED' AS holds_filled,
            'OVERDUE_ITEMS' AS overdue_items
        )
    )
),
loan_base AS (
    -- Branch one: unresolved late loans plus renewed open loans.
    SELECT loan_id, item_barcode, member_id, branch_id,
           checked_out_at, due_at, returned_at, renewal_count,
           fine_amount, loan_attributes, 'OPEN_OR_RENEWED' AS selection_branch
    FROM loan_ledger
    WHERE returned_at IS NULL
      AND (due_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' OR renewal_count > 0)
    UNION ALL
    -- Branch two: returned loans still need review for fines or heavy renewal.
    SELECT loan_id, item_barcode, member_id, branch_id,
           checked_out_at, due_at, returned_at, renewal_count,
           fine_amount, loan_attributes, 'RECENT_RETURN' AS selection_branch
    FROM loan_ledger
    WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL
      AND returned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND (fine_amount > 0 OR renewal_count >= 2)
),
flagged_loans AS (
    SELECT l.*,
           coalesce(nullif(element_at(l.loan_attributes, 'format'), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS loan_format,
           concat_ws(':', l.branch_id, lpad(CAST(l.member_id AS STRING), 4, '0'),
                     upper(array_join(slice(split(element_at(l.loan_attributes, 'call_number'), '\\.'), 1, 2), '-')),
                     l.selection_branch) AS audit_label,
           array_join(array_sort(map_keys(l.loan_attributes)), ',') AS attribute_keys,
           date_trunc('DAY', l.checked_out_at) AS checkout_day,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, l.checked_out_at, l.due_at) AS scheduled_hours,
           datediff(coalesce(l.returned_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'), l.checked_out_at) AS days_out,
           l.due_at + INTERVAL '3' DAY AS grace_deadline,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00', l.checked_out_at) AS checkout_hour_seq
    FROM loan_base l
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM hold_requests h
        WHERE h.member_id = l.member_id
          AND h.branch_id = l.branch_id
          AND h.status IN ('READY', 'QUEUED')
          AND h.requested_at <= l.due_at + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM patron_suspensions s
        WHERE s.member_id = l.member_id
          AND l.checked_out_at BETWEEN s.starts_at
              AND coalesce(s.ends_at + INTERVAL '1' DAY, l.checked_out_at + INTERVAL '1' DAY)
    )
),
scored_loans AS (
    SELECT f.*,
           b.branch_name,
           b.contact_info.email AS support_email,
           p.circulation, p.holds_filled, p.overdue_items,
           CASE
               WHEN f.returned_at IS NULL AND coalesce(f.fine_amount, 0) >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_FINE'
               WHEN f.returned_at IS NULL AND TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' > f.grace_deadline THEN 'OVERDUE'
               WHEN p.overdue_items >= 4 THEN 'BRANCH_WATCH'
               WHEN f.renewal_count >= 2 THEN 'RENEWAL_HEAVY'
               ELSE 'STANDARD'
           END AS risk_label,
           SUM(coalesce(f.fine_amount, 0)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY f.member_id
               ORDER BY f.checkout_hour_seq
               RANGE BETWEEN 168 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS rolling_week_fines
    FROM flagged_loans f
    JOIN branch_directory b ON b.branch_id = f.branch_id
    JOIN branch_metric_pivot p ON p.branch_id = f.branch_id
)
SELECT branch_id,
       max(branch_name) AS branch_name,
       loan_format,
       risk_label,
       GROUPING_ID(branch_id, loan_format, risk_label) AS grouping_level,
       CASE
           WHEN GROUPING(branch_id) = 1 THEN 'NETWORK'
           WHEN GROUPING(loan_format) = 1 THEN 'BRANCH_TOTAL'
           WHEN GROUPING(risk_label) = 1 THEN 'FORMAT_TOTAL'
           ELSE 'DETAIL'
       END AS summary_scope,
       count(*) AS loan_count,
       count(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN returned_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_loans,
       round(SUM(coalesce(fine_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))), 2) AS fine_total,
       round(avg(coalesce(rolling_week_fines, 0)), 2) AS avg_rolling_member_fines,
       round(avg(scheduled_hours), 1) AS avg_scheduled_hours,
       round(avg(days_out), 1) AS avg_days_out,
       max(audit_label) AS sample_audit_label,
       max(support_email) AS support_email,
       max(attribute_keys) AS sample_attribute_keys
FROM scored_loans
GROUP BY ROLLUP (branch_id, loan_format, risk_label)
ORDER BY grouping_level, branch_id NULLS LAST, loan_format NULLS LAST, risk_label NULLS LAST

/*
  Hotel room-revenue mart: pick one representative stay per room segment,
  summarize reservation-change sessions, and roll up daily revenue components.
  NULL adjustment components are intentionally excluded by SQL UNPIVOT.
*/
WITH stay_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        r.reservation_id,
        r.property_code,
        r.room_type,
        r.guest_profile.loyalty_tier AS loyalty_tier,
        r.guest_profile.home_country AS home_country,
        from_json(r.preferences_json,
                  'STRUCT<high_floor:BOOLEAN,accessible_room:BOOLEAN,bed_type:STRING>') AS preference_detail,
        filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0) AS valid_nightly_rates,
        transform(filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0),
                  x -> round(x * 1.10, 2)) AS gross_nightly_rates,
        aggregate(filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0),
                  CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + CAST(x AS DOUBLE)) AS total_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN exists(r.nightly_rates, x -> x >= 300) THEN 'PREMIUM'
            WHEN aggregate(filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0),
                           CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + CAST(x AS DOUBLE)) >= 400
                THEN 'EXTENDED_VALUE'
            ELSE 'STANDARD'
        END AS rate_band,
        datediff(r.checkout_at, r.checkin_at) AS stay_nights,
        timestampdiff(HOUR, r.booked_at, r.checkin_at) AS lead_hours,
        r.checkin_at - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS cancellation_deadline,
        date_trunc('MONTH', r.checkin_at) AS stay_month,
        concat_ws(':', r.property_code, r.room_type,
                  upper(coalesce(r.guest_profile.loyalty_tier, 'NONE'))) AS stay_segment_key,
        lpad(split(r.confirmation_code, '-')[1], 4, '0') AS confirmation_seq,
        array_join(transform(r.nightly_rates,
                             x -> coalesce(CAST(x AS STRING), 'NA')), '|') AS rate_audit
    FROM reservation_stays r
    WHERE r.stay_status IN ('CHECKED_OUT', 'CONFIRMED')
      AND r.checkout_at IS NOT NULL
),
activity_sessions AS (
    -- A gap over 24 hours starts a new reservation-working session.
    SELECT
        g.*,
        sum(g.gap_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.guest_id
            ORDER BY g.occurred_at, g.activity_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_seq
    FROM (
        SELECT
            a.*,
            CASE
                WHEN lag(a.occurred_at) OVER (
                         PARTITION BY a.guest_id ORDER BY a.occurred_at, a.activity_id
                     ) IS NULL
                  OR a.occurred_at > lag(a.occurred_at) OVER (
                         PARTITION BY a.guest_id ORDER BY a.occurred_at, a.activity_id
                     ) + INTERVAL '24' HOUR
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END AS gap_flag
        FROM reservation_activity a
    ) g
),
session_stats AS (
    SELECT
        reservation_id,
        count(*) AS activity_events,
        count(DISTINCT concat_ws('-', guest_id, lpad(session_seq, 3, '0'))) AS booking_sessions,
        max(concat_ws('-', guest_id, lpad(session_seq, 3, '0'))) AS last_session_label,
        sum(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'MODIFY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS modification_events
    FROM activity_sessions
    GROUP BY reservation_id
),
revenue_long AS (
    SELECT property_code, business_date, room_type, available_rooms, metric_name, metric_amount
    FROM daily_room_revenue
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_amount FOR metric_name IN (room_revenue, fee_revenue, adjustment_revenue)
    )
),
revenue_scored AS (
    SELECT
        rl.*,
        sum(rl.metric_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rl.property_code, rl.room_type, rl.metric_name
            ORDER BY rl.business_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_two_day_revenue,
        avg(rl.metric_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rl.property_code, rl.room_type, rl.metric_name
            ORDER BY datediff(rl.business_date, DATE '2025-03-01')
            RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS two_calendar_day_avg
    FROM revenue_long rl
),
ranked_stays AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        coalesce(ss.activity_events, 0) AS activity_events,
        coalesce(ss.booking_sessions, 0) AS booking_sessions,
        coalesce(ss.last_session_label, 'NO_ACTIVITY') AS last_session_label,
        coalesce(ss.modification_events, 0) AS modification_events,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY se.property_code, se.room_type
            ORDER BY se.total_rate DESC, se.lead_hours DESC, se.reservation_id
        ) AS segment_rank
    FROM stay_enriched se
    LEFT JOIN session_stats ss ON ss.reservation_id = se.reservation_id
    QUALIFY segment_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) = 0 THEN 'DETAIL'
        WHEN grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) = 1 THEN 'ROOM_TYPE_TOTAL'
        WHEN grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) = 3 THEN 'PROPERTY_TOTAL'
        ELSE 'GRAND_TOTAL'
    END AS aggregation_scope,
    concat_ws(' / ', coalesce(rs.property_code, 'ALL PROPERTIES'),
              coalesce(rs.room_type, 'ALL ROOM TYPES'),
              coalesce(rl.metric_name, 'ALL METRICS')) AS revenue_group,
    rs.property_code,
    rs.room_type,
    rl.metric_name,
    grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) AS rollup_level,
    count(DISTINCT rs.reservation_id) AS stay_count,
    round(sum(rl.metric_amount), 2) AS total_revenue,
    round(avg(rl.prior_two_day_revenue), 2) AS avg_prior_two_day_revenue,
    round(max(rl.two_calendar_day_avg), 2) AS peak_two_day_avg,
    max(rs.stay_nights) AS max_stay_nights,
    max(rs.booking_sessions) AS max_booking_sessions
FROM revenue_scored rl
JOIN ranked_stays rs
  ON rs.property_code = rl.property_code
 AND rs.room_type = rl.room_type
GROUP BY ROLLUP (rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name)
ORDER BY rollup_level, rs.property_code ASC NULLS LAST,
         rs.room_type ASC NULLS LAST, rl.metric_name ASC NULLS LAST

WITH app_scope AS (
    -- Active apps with a completed install, excluding apps with hidden one-star abuse.
    SELECT a.*
    FROM dim_apps a
    WHERE a.is_active
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stg_download_events d
          WHERE d.app_id = a.app_id AND d.status = 'COMPLETED'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stg_rating_events r
          WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.status = 'HIDDEN' AND r.stars = 1
      )
),
-- Flatten install funnel steps and parse device attributes from the event JSON.
exploded_downloads AS (
    SELECT d.download_id, d.app_id, d.user_id, d.downloaded_at, d.country, d.platform,
           from_json(d.device_json,
               'STRUCT<device_model:STRING,os_version:STRING,consent:BOOLEAN>') AS device,
           item.step_name, item.offset_min, item.step_value
    FROM stg_download_events d
    LATERAL VIEW explode(d.install_steps) AS item
    WHERE d.status = 'COMPLETED'
),
-- Aggregate the funnel, retaining only the relevant step in each FILTER clause.
download_stats AS (
    SELECT app_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT download_id) FILTER (WHERE step_name = 'INSTALL') AS completed_downloads,
           COUNT(DISTINCT download_id) FILTER (
               WHERE step_name = 'OPEN' AND device.consent
           ) AS consented_opens,
           SUM(step_value) FILTER (WHERE step_name = 'INSTALL') AS install_units,
           SUM(COALESCE(step_value, 0)) FILTER (WHERE step_name = 'OPEN') AS open_units
    FROM exploded_downloads
    GROUP BY app_id
),
-- Compute a trailing seven-day rating average using a numeric RANGE frame.
rating_windowed AS (
    SELECT r.app_id, r.rating_id, r.stars,
           AVG(CAST(r.stars AS DECIMAL(10,2))) OVER (
               PARTITION BY r.app_id
               ORDER BY unix_timestamp(r.rated_at)
               RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS trailing_7d_avg
    FROM stg_rating_events r
    WHERE r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
),
-- Summarize published ratings and their approximate median.
rating_stats AS (
    SELECT app_id,
           COUNT(*) AS published_ratings,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stars >= 4) AS positive_ratings,
           ROUND(AVG(CAST(stars AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) AS avg_stars,
           percentile_approx(stars, 0.5) AS median_stars,
           MAX(trailing_7d_avg) AS peak_7d_avg
    FROM rating_windowed
    GROUP BY app_id
),
-- Pivot the daily long-form metrics into app-level operational measures.
metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT app_id,
           downloads AS reported_downloads,
           sessions AS reported_sessions,
           crashes AS reported_crashes
    FROM (
        SELECT app_id, metric, metric_value
        FROM stg_daily_metrics
        WHERE report_date = DATE '2025-03-15'
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'DOWNLOADS' AS downloads,
            'SESSIONS' AS sessions,
            'CRASHES' AS crashes
        )
    )
)
-- Produce the app health scorecard with null-safe rates and labels.
SELECT a.*,
       d.completed_downloads,
       d.consented_opens,
       COALESCE(r.published_ratings, 0) AS published_ratings,
       COALESCE(r.positive_ratings, 0) AS positive_ratings,
       r.avg_stars,
       r.median_stars,
       ROUND(r.peak_7d_avg, 2) AS peak_7d_avg,
       m.reported_downloads,
       m.reported_sessions,
       m.reported_crashes,
       CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(d.open_units, 0) / NULLIF(d.install_units, 0), 4)
            AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS open_rate,
       FLOOR(COALESCE(r.avg_stars, a.target_rating) * 20) AS rating_score,
       CEIL(COALESCE(m.reported_downloads, 0) / 7) AS weekly_downloads,
       CASE
           WHEN r.app_id IS NULL THEN 'UNRATED'
           WHEN r.median_stars < 3 THEN 'AT_RISK'
           WHEN r.median_stars >= 4 AND COALESCE(m.reported_crashes, 0) <= 2 THEN 'HEALTHY'
           ELSE 'WATCH'
       END AS quality_label
FROM app_scope a
LEFT JOIN download_stats d ON d.app_id = a.app_id
LEFT JOIN rating_stats r ON r.app_id = a.app_id
LEFT JOIN metric_pivot m ON m.app_id = a.app_id
ORDER BY rating_score DESC, app_id

/*
  Construction portfolio review: change exposure, field sessions and direct costs.
  Activity gaps over four hours start a new session; only twelve recent activities
  per project feed this weekly operations extract.
*/
WITH change_parsed AS (
    SELECT event_id, project_id, contractor_id, change_ref, submitted_at,
           status, amount,
           from_json(metrics_json,
               'STRUCT<delay_days:INT,risk_score:DOUBLE,inspection_passed:BOOLEAN>') AS metrics,
           transform(action_codes, x -> upper(x)) AS normalized_actions,
           filter(action_codes, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x <> 'SKIP') AS actionable_codes,
           exists(action_codes, x -> x = 'FIELD_CHECK') AS needs_field_check
    FROM change_order_events
),
change_scoped AS (
    -- The seven-day grace period models crew coverage after the formal window.
    SELECT cp.*, ps.region, ps.project_name, ps.baseline_budget,
           ps.site_profile.site_class AS site_class,
           cw.crew_label
    FROM change_parsed cp
    JOIN project_sites ps
      ON ps.project_id = cp.project_id
    LEFT JOIN contractor_windows cw
      ON cw.contractor_id = cp.contractor_id
     AND cp.submitted_at BETWEEN cw.coverage_start
                             AND cw.coverage_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    WHERE ps.is_active = TRUE
      AND cp.status <> 'VOID'
),
activity_flagged AS (
    SELECT project_id, activity_id, happened_at, activity_type, crew_qty,
           LAG(happened_at) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at, activity_id
           ) AS prev_happened_at
    FROM site_activity
    WHERE activity_type <> 'CANCELLED'
),
activity_sessions AS (
    SELECT project_id, activity_id, happened_at, activity_type, crew_qty,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_happened_at IS NULL
                     OR happened_at > prev_happened_at + INTERVAL '4' HOUR
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at, activity_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_seq,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at DESC, activity_id DESC
           ) AS recency_rn
    FROM activity_flagged
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at DESC, activity_id DESC
            ) <= 12
),
cost_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes the null equipment bucket, as intended here.
    SELECT project_id, cost_type, cost_value
    FROM project_cost_buckets
    UNPIVOT (
        cost_value FOR cost_type IN (
            labor_cost AS LABOR,
            material_cost AS MATERIAL,
            equipment_cost AS EQUIPMENT
        )
    )
),
project_metrics AS (
    SELECT ps.project_id, ps.project_name, ps.region, ps.baseline_budget,
           coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN cs.status = 'APPROVED'
                             THEN coalesce(cs.amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
                             ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END),
                    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS approved_change_amount,
           count(DISTINCT cs.event_id) AS change_events,
           max(cs.metrics.risk_score) AS max_risk_score,
           sum(CASE WHEN cs.needs_field_check THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS field_check_events,
           sum(CASE WHEN cs.event_id IS NOT NULL
                    THEN size(cs.actionable_codes) ELSE 0 END) AS actionable_steps,
           coalesce(max(sa.retained_sessions), 0) AS retained_sessions,
           coalesce(max(sa.session_crew_qty), 0) AS session_crew_qty,
           max(ct.labor_cost) AS labor_cost,
           max(ct.material_cost) AS material_cost,
           max(ct.equipment_cost) AS equipment_cost,
           max(CASE WHEN cs.site_class = 'REMOTE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS remote_change_flag
    FROM project_sites ps
    LEFT JOIN change_scoped cs ON cs.project_id = ps.project_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT project_id, count(DISTINCT session_seq) AS retained_sessions,
               sum(crew_qty) AS session_crew_qty
        FROM activity_sessions
        GROUP BY project_id
    ) sa ON sa.project_id = ps.project_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM cost_long
        PIVOT (
            sum(cost_value) FOR cost_type IN (
                'LABOR' AS labor_cost,
                'MATERIAL' AS material_cost,
                'EQUIPMENT' AS equipment_cost
            )
        )
    ) ct ON ct.project_id = ps.project_id
    WHERE ps.is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY ps.project_id, ps.project_name, ps.region, ps.baseline_budget
)
SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(region) = 1 THEN 'ALL REGIONS' ELSE region END AS region_label,
       CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'ALL PROJECTS' ELSE project_id END AS project_key,
       CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'ALL PROJECTS' ELSE max(project_name) END AS project_name,
       sum(approved_change_amount) AS approved_change_amount,
       sum(baseline_budget) AS baseline_budget,
       sum(change_events) AS change_events,
       sum(retained_sessions) AS retained_sessions,
       sum(session_crew_qty) AS session_crew_qty,
       sum(coalesce(labor_cost, 0) + coalesce(material_cost, 0)
           + coalesce(equipment_cost, 0)) AS direct_cost,
       round(sum(approved_change_amount) /
             nullif(sum(coalesce(labor_cost, 0) + coalesce(material_cost, 0)
                        + coalesce(equipment_cost, 0)), 0), 3) AS approved_to_cost_ratio,
       max(max_risk_score) AS max_risk_score,
       sum(field_check_events) AS field_check_events,
       sum(actionable_steps) AS actionable_steps,
       max(remote_change_flag) AS remote_change_flag,
       GROUPING_ID(region, project_id) AS grouping_level,
       (SELECT max(baseline_budget) FROM project_sites WHERE is_active = TRUE)
           AS portfolio_budget_ceiling
FROM project_metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region, project_id), (region), ())
ORDER BY grouping_level DESC, approved_change_amount DESC NULLS LAST,
         region_label ASC, project_key ASC

WITH claim_base AS (
    SELECT
        cl.claim_id,
        cl.policy_id,
        pc.holder_name,
        pc.region,
        pc.risk_tier,
        cl.reported_at,
        date_trunc('month', cl.reported_at) AS report_month,
        cl.reported_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS review_due_at,
        datediff(to_date(cl.reported_at), cl.loss_date) AS days_to_report,
        cl.status,
        cl.peril,
        cl.incurred_amount,
        -- Ignore small and missing recoveries before summing the material ones.
        aggregate(
            filter(
                transform(
                    cl.recovery_amounts,
                    x -> coalesce(x, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
                ),
                x -> x >= CAST(500 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
            ),
            CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)),
            (acc, x) -> CAST(acc + x AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        ) AS large_recovery_total
    FROM claim_ledger cl
    JOIN policy_contracts pc
      ON pc.policy_id = cl.policy_id
     AND pc.policy_active = TRUE
),
activity_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        ca.claim_id,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.activity_type = 'INSPECTION') AS inspection_count,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.activity_type = 'PAYMENT') AS payment_count,
        max(ca.activity_at) AS last_activity_at,
        array_sort(collect_set(ca.activity_type)) AS activity_types
    FROM claim_activity ca
    GROUP BY ca.claim_id
),
metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        claim_id,
        damage_band,
        repair_route,
        fraud_flag
    FROM (
        SELECT claim_id, metric, metric_value
        FROM claim_measurements
    ) m
    PIVOT (
        max(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'DAMAGE_BAND' AS damage_band,
            'REPAIR_ROUTE' AS repair_route,
            'FRAUD_FLAG' AS fraud_flag
        )
    )
),
ranked_claims AS (
    SELECT
        cb.*,
        coalesce(mp.damage_band, 'UNSCORED') AS damage_band,
        mp.repair_route,
        coalesce(mp.fraud_flag, 'UNSCORED') AS fraud_flag,
        ntile(2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.region
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS region_amount_bucket,
        percent_rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.region
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS region_percent_rank,
        cume_dist() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.report_month
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS month_cume_dist,
        dense_rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.risk_tier
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS tier_amount_rank
    FROM claim_base cb
    LEFT JOIN metric_pivot mp
      ON mp.claim_id = cb.claim_id
),
eligible_claims AS (
    SELECT rc.*
    FROM ranked_claims rc
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM claim_activity ca
        WHERE ca.claim_id = rc.claim_id
          AND ca.activity_type = 'COVERAGE_CONFIRMED'
          AND ca.activity_at <= rc.reported_at + INTERVAL '48' HOUR
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM claim_activity blocked
        WHERE blocked.claim_id = rc.claim_id
          AND blocked.activity_type = 'FRAUD_HOLD'
    )
)
SELECT
    rc.*,
    ar.inspection_count,
    ar.payment_count,
    ar.last_activity_at,
    ar.activity_types,
    CASE
        WHEN rc.status = 'OPEN' AND rc.fraud_flag = 'REVIEW'
            THEN 'FRAUD_REVIEW'
        WHEN rc.status = 'OPEN' AND rc.large_recovery_total >= 1500
            THEN 'ESCALATE_RECOVERY'
        WHEN rc.status = 'OPEN'
            THEN 'STANDARD_REVIEW'
        WHEN coalesce(ar.payment_count, 0) > 0
            THEN 'PAID_CLOSED'
        ELSE 'ARCHIVE'
    END AS handling_path,
    CASE
        WHEN ar.last_activity_at > rc.review_due_at THEN 'LATE'
        ELSE 'ON_TIME'
    END AS review_timeliness
FROM eligible_claims rc
LEFT JOIN activity_rollup ar
  ON ar.claim_id = rc.claim_id
ORDER BY rc.region, rc.region_amount_bucket, rc.claim_id

/*
  Listing negotiation pulse as of 2025-04-01.
  Builds listing attributes, buyer activity sessions, and latest-offer diagnostics.
  The fixed cutoff keeps the report reproducible for daily batch validation.
*/
WITH listing_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        pl.*,
        FROM_JSON(details_json,
                  'STRUCT<sqft:INT, hoa_monthly:DECIMAL(10,2), energy_rating:STRING>') AS parsed_details,
        ELEMENT_AT(features, 'parking') AS parking_type,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(MAP_KEYS(features), 'garden') AS has_garden_key,
        SIZE(MAP_VALUES(features)) AS feature_value_count,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', listed_at) AS listing_month,
        listed_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS first_review_due,
        DATEDIFF(TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00', listed_at) AS days_on_market,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND ELEMENT_AT(features, 'garden') = 'yes' THEN 'ACTIVE_GARDEN'
            WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE_NO_GARDEN'
            ELSE 'NON_ACTIVE'
        END AS listing_segment
    FROM property_listings pl
    -- Remove stale and withdrawn inventory before joining negotiations.
    WHERE status <> 'WITHDRAWN'
      AND listed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '14' DAY
),
activity_marked AS (
    SELECT
        oe.*,
        LAG(event_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS previous_event_at,
        LAG(offer_amount, 1, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS previous_offer_amount,
        LEAD(offer_amount, 1, offer_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS next_offer_amount,
        LEAD(event_at, 1, event_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS next_event_at
    FROM offer_activity oe
),
activity_flagged AS (
    SELECT
        am.*,
        -- More than 36 idle hours starts a separate negotiation session.
        CASE
            WHEN previous_event_at IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, previous_event_at, event_at) > 36 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM activity_marked am
),
activity_sessioned AS (
    SELECT
        af.*,
        SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id
            ORDER BY event_at, event_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_id
    FROM activity_flagged af
),
listing_offer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        listing_id,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) AS distinct_buyers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count,
        SUM(DISTINCT offer_amount) AS distinct_offer_sum,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_types,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(buyer_id)) AS buyer_footprint
    FROM activity_sessioned
    GROUP BY listing_id
),
latest_activity AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM activity_sessioned s
)
SELECT
    l.*,
    l.address.postal_code AS postal_code,
    l.parsed_details.sqft AS square_feet,
    l.parsed_details.energy_rating AS energy_rating,
    COALESCE(a.agent_name, 'UNASSIGNED') AS agent_name,
    COALESCE(bp.financing_type, 'UNVERIFIED') AS buyer_financing,
    s.event_count,
    s.distinct_buyers,
    s.session_count,
    s.distinct_offer_sum,
    s.event_types,
    s.buyer_footprint,
    la.event_id AS latest_event_id,
    la.event_at AS latest_event_at,
    la.buyer_id AS latest_buyer_id,
    la.offer_amount AS latest_offer_amount,
    la.previous_offer_amount,
    la.next_offer_amount,
    la.session_id AS latest_session_id,
    CASE
        WHEN la.offer_amount IS NULL THEN 'NO_AMOUNT'
        WHEN la.offer_amount >= l.list_price THEN 'AT_OR_ABOVE_ASK'
        WHEN la.offer_amount >= l.list_price * 0.90 THEN 'NEAR_ASK'
        ELSE 'BELOW_ASK'
    END AS offer_position,
    ROUND(la.offer_amount - l.list_price, 2) AS latest_offer_delta,
    la.event_at + INTERVAL '12' HOUR AS response_due_at,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, l.listed_at, la.event_at) AS hours_listed_to_latest,
    (SELECT AVG(list_price)
       FROM property_listings
      WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_market_average
FROM listing_enriched l
JOIN listing_offer_stats s ON s.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN latest_activity la
  ON la.listing_id = l.listing_id AND la.recency_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN agent_directory a
  ON a.agent_id = l.agent_id AND a.is_active = TRUE
LEFT JOIN buyer_profiles bp
  ON bp.buyer_id = la.buyer_id
 AND bp.preapproval_expires >= DATE '2025-04-01'
ORDER BY la.event_at DESC, l.listing_id

    JOIN dim_campaign camp
      ON camp.campaign_id = i.campaign_id
     AND camp.is_active = TRUE
     -- The seven-day grace window deliberately admits late deliveries.
     AND i.served_at BETWEEN camp.flight_start

    WHERE i.viewable_seconds IS NOT NULL
      AND (element_at(i.delivery_attributes, 'consent_tier') IN ('GRANTED', 'LIMITED')

    SELECT d.impression_id,
           COUNT(c.click_id) FILTER (
               WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE AND c.click_type <> 'INVALID'
           ) AS valid_click_count,
           COUNT(c.click_id) FILTER (
               WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE AND c.click_type = 'PRIMARY'
           ) AS primary_click_count,
           COUNT(c.click_id) FILTER (
               WHERE c.click_type = 'INVALID'
           ) AS invalid_click_count,
           COALESCE(

    FROM stg_delivery d
    LEFT JOIN stg_click_activity c
      ON c.impression_id = d.impression_id
     AND c.clicked_at BETWEEN d.served_at AND d.served_at + INTERVAL '2' DAY

stg_click_labels AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, report_date, primary_click_label, secondary_click_label
    FROM (

        FROM stg_delivery d
        JOIN stg_click_activity c

         AND c.clicked_at BETWEEN d.served_at AND d.served_at + INTERVAL '2' DAY
        WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE
          AND c.click_type IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY')
    ) labelled_clicks
    PIVOT (
        MAX(click_label)
        FOR click_type IN (
            'PRIMARY' AS primary_click_label,
            'SECONDARY' AS secondary_click_label
        )
    )

fct_daily_performance AS (
    SELECT d.campaign_id,
           d.report_date,
           d.channel,
           GROUPING(d.campaign_id) AS campaign_grouping,
           GROUPING(d.channel) AS channel_grouping,
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS impression_count,
           CAST(SUM(r.valid_click_count) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS valid_click_count,
           CAST(SUM(r.invalid_click_count) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS invalid_click_count,
           CAST(SUM(d.cost) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS spend,
           CAST(SUM(r.accepted_revenue) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS accepted_revenue,
           CAST(PERCENTILE_APPROX(d.viewable_seconds, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(20,2))
               AS median_viewable_seconds,
           MAX(d.max_active_budget) AS active_budget_ceiling
    FROM stg_delivery d
    LEFT JOIN stg_click_rollup r ON r.impression_id = d.impression_id
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d.campaign_id, d.report_date, d.channel),
        (d.campaign_id, d.report_date),
        (d.report_date)
    )

stg_metric_rows AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, report_date, channel,
           campaign_grouping, channel_grouping, active_budget_ceiling,
           metric_name, metric_value
    FROM fct_daily_performance
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            impression_count AS impressions,
            valid_click_count AS valid_clicks,
            invalid_click_count AS invalid_clicks,
            spend AS spend,
            accepted_revenue AS revenue,
            median_viewable_seconds AS median_view_time
        )
    )
),
stg_ranked_metrics AS (
    SELECT m.*,
           SUM(metric_value) OVER (
               PARTITION BY campaign_id, channel, report_date
               ORDER BY metric_value
               RANGE BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS value_neighborhood_total
    FROM stg_metric_rows m
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY metric_name, report_date
        ORDER BY metric_value DESC NULLS LAST,
                 campaign_id ASC NULLS LAST,
                 channel ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
)
SELECT r.report_date,
       r.metric_name,
       COALESCE(r.campaign_id, 'ALL_CAMPAIGNS') AS campaign_scope,
       COALESCE(r.channel, 'ALL_CHANNELS') AS channel_scope,
       CASE
           WHEN r.campaign_grouping = 1 THEN 'PORTFOLIO'
           WHEN r.channel_grouping = 1 THEN 'CAMPAIGN_TOTAL'
           ELSE 'CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL'
       END AS granularity,
       r.metric_value,

       l.primary_click_label,
       l.secondary_click_label
FROM stg_ranked_metrics r
LEFT JOIN stg_click_labels l
  ON l.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
 AND l.report_date = r.report_date

  roll resources up to account/environment, and apply approved credits.

WITH stg_usage_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        m.usage_id,
        m.resource_id,
        c.account_id,
        c.service_name,
        c.environment,
        c.resource_type,
        c.unit_price,
        CAST(m.usage_ts AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        datediff(CAST(m.usage_ts AS DATE), DATE '2025-01-01') AS day_index,
        m.metric,
        m.quantity,
        COALESCE(element_at(m.resource_tags, 'cost_center'), 'unassigned') AS cost_center,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(get_json_object(m.request_context, '$.billing_owner'), ''), 'unowned') AS billing_owner,
        aggregate(
            FILTER(m.hourly_usage, x -> x >= 0),
            CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
            (acc, x) -> acc + x
        ) AS clean_sample_total,
        CASE
            WHEN m.quantity IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
            WHEN m.quantity < 0 THEN 'CORRECTION'
            WHEN aggregate(FILTER(m.hourly_usage, x -> x >= 0), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x) >= 12 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN aggregate(FILTER(m.hourly_usage, x -> x >= 0), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x) >= 5 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS usage_band
    FROM fct_usage_metering m
    JOIN dim_resource_catalog c
      ON c.resource_id = m.resource_id
     AND c.billing_enabled = TRUE
    WHERE m.usage_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-10 00:00:00'
      AND m.usage_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-12 00:00:00'
),
stg_usage_quality AS (
    -- Reading-level quality indicators remain separate from metric values.
    SELECT
        account_id, resource_id, service_name, environment, resource_type,
        unit_price, usage_date, day_index,
        max(cost_center) AS cost_center,
        max(billing_owner) AS billing_owner,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL) AS valid_readings,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_band = 'CORRECTION') AS correction_readings,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_band = 'HIGH') AS high_usage_readings,
        sum(clean_sample_total) AS sample_total
    FROM stg_usage_enriched
    GROUP BY
        account_id, resource_id, service_name, environment, resource_type,
        unit_price, usage_date, day_index
),
stg_daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        resource_id,
        usage_date,
        COALESCE(vcpu_hours, 0) AS vcpu_hours,
        COALESCE(memory_gb_hours, 0) AS memory_gb_hours,
        COALESCE(egress_gb, 0) AS egress_gb
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, resource_id, usage_date, metric, quantity
        FROM stg_usage_enriched
    ) meter
    PIVOT (
        sum(quantity)
        FOR metric IN (
            'VCPU_HOURS' AS vcpu_hours,
            'MEMORY_GB_HOURS' AS memory_gb_hours,
            'EGRESS_GB' AS egress_gb
        )
    )
),
stg_resource_daily AS (
    SELECT
        q.*,
        p.vcpu_hours,
        p.memory_gb_hours,
        p.egress_gb,
        p.vcpu_hours * q.unit_price
            + p.memory_gb_hours * q.unit_price * CAST(0.15 AS DOUBLE)
            + p.egress_gb * q.unit_price * CAST(0.05 AS DOUBLE) AS daily_charge,
        sum(p.vcpu_hours) OVER (
            PARTITION BY q.account_id, q.resource_id
            ORDER BY q.day_index
            RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS trailing_2d_vcpu_hours
    FROM stg_usage_quality q
    JOIN stg_daily_metrics p
      ON p.account_id = q.account_id
     AND p.resource_id = q.resource_id
     AND p.usage_date = q.usage_date
),
stg_adjustment_daily AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CAST(adjustment_ts AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        sum(adjustment_amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_credit
    FROM stg_billing_adjustments
    WHERE adjustment_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-10 00:00:00'
      AND adjustment_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-12 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY account_id, CAST(adjustment_ts AS DATE)
),
stg_account_rollup AS (
    -- Environment detail plus an all-environments row for each account/day.
    SELECT
        account_id,
        usage_date,
        day_index,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(environment) = 1 THEN 'ALL_ENVIRONMENTS' ELSE environment END AS environment,
        GROUPING(environment) AS environment_grouping,
        sum(daily_charge) AS gross_charge,
        sum(vcpu_hours) AS vcpu_hours,
        sum(memory_gb_hours) AS memory_gb_hours,
        sum(egress_gb) AS egress_gb,
        sum(sample_total) AS sample_total,
        sum(valid_readings) AS valid_readings,
        sum(correction_readings) AS correction_readings
    FROM stg_resource_daily
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (account_id, usage_date, day_index, environment),
        (account_id, usage_date, day_index)
    )
)
SELECT
    roll.*,
    acct.account_name,
    acct.segment,
    CASE
        WHEN roll.environment_grouping = 1 THEN COALESCE(adj.approved_credit, 0)
        ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
    END AS approved_credit,
    round(
        roll.gross_charge - CASE
            WHEN roll.environment_grouping = 1 THEN COALESCE(adj.approved_credit, 0)
            ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        END,
        2
    ) AS net_charge
FROM stg_account_rollup roll
LEFT JOIN dim_cloud_accounts acct
  ON acct.account_id = roll.account_id
LEFT JOIN stg_adjustment_daily adj
  ON adj.account_id = roll.account_id
 AND adj.usage_date = roll.usage_date
ORDER BY roll.account_id, roll.usage_date, roll.environment_grouping DESC, roll.environment

WITH latest_subs AS (
    -- Keep only the newest profile snapshot for each subscriber.
    SELECT subscriber_id, acct_status, segment_cd, topics
    FROM (
        SELECT s.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY subscriber_id
                   ORDER BY snapshot_ts DESC, snapshot_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM subscriber_snapshots s
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
recipients AS (
    -- Flatten recipient structs and derive send-time attributes.
    SELECT d.batch_id,
           d.newsletter_nm,
           d.subject_txt,
           d.from_email,
           d.sent_at,
           DATE_TRUNC('DAY', d.sent_at) AS send_day,
           d.sent_at + INTERVAL '7' DAY AS open_window_end,
           item.subscriber_id,
           item.email_addr,
           item.variant_cd,
           item.send_status,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(d.from_email, '@(.+)$', 1) AS sender_domain,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(d.subject_txt), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-') AS subject_slug
    FROM send_dispatches d
    LATERAL VIEW explode(d.recipients) r AS item
),
enriched_sends AS (
    -- Add current profile attributes and normalize topic arrays.
    SELECT a.*,
           s.acct_status,
           s.segment_cd,
           TRANSFORM(COALESCE(s.topics, ARRAY()), x -> LOWER(x)) AS topic_tags,
           FILTER(
               COALESCE(s.topics, ARRAY()),
               x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x RLIKE '^(product|news)$'
           ) AS core_topics
    FROM recipients a
    LEFT JOIN latest_subs s
      ON s.subscriber_id = a.subscriber_id
),
open_gaps AS (
    -- Clean valid opens and inspect the prior open per recipient.
    SELECT e.event_id,
           a.batch_id,
           a.subscriber_id,
           a.sent_at,
           e.opened_at,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(COALESCE(e.device_txt, ''), '^([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS device_family,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(
               LOWER(COALESCE(e.source_txt, 'unknown')), '[^a-z0-9]+', '_'
           ) AS source_key,
           LAG(e.opened_at) OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.batch_id, a.subscriber_id
               ORDER BY e.opened_at, e.event_id
           ) AS prev_opened_at,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.batch_id, a.subscriber_id
               ORDER BY e.opened_at, e.event_id
               ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ) AS prev_2_open_cnt
    FROM enriched_sends a
    JOIN open_events e
      ON e.batch_id = a.batch_id
     AND e.subscriber_id = a.subscriber_id
    WHERE a.send_status = 'SENT'
      AND e.opened_at >= a.sent_at
      AND e.opened_at <= a.open_window_end
      AND (e.device_txt RLIKE '^(Mobile|Desktop|Tablet)' OR e.source_txt IS NOT NULL)
),
open_flags AS (
    -- Mark a new session after a gap of more than thirty minutes.
    SELECT g.*,
           CASE
               WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL
                OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
               THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END AS new_session_flag
    FROM open_gaps g
),
open_sessions AS (
    -- Convert gap flags into per-recipient session numbers.
    SELECT f.*,
           SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
               PARTITION BY batch_id, subscriber_id
               ORDER BY opened_at, event_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_id
    FROM open_flags f
)
-- Combine recipient coverage with open and session quality metrics.
SELECT a.batch_id,
       a.newsletter_nm,
       a.send_day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) AS recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) FILTER (WHERE a.send_status = 'SENT') AS sent_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) FILTER (WHERE a.send_status = 'BOUNCED') AS bounced_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.acct_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN a.subscriber_id END) AS active_recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN EXISTS(a.topic_tags, x -> x = 'product') THEN a.subscriber_id
       END) AS product_topic_recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SIZE(a.core_topics) > 0 THEN a.subscriber_id END) AS core_topic_recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT os.event_id) AS open_event_cnt,
       COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT os.event_id), 0) AS open_event_id_sum,
       COUNT(DISTINCT os.subscriber_id) AS unique_opener_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT os.session_id) AS session_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.sent_at, os.opened_at)), 2) AS avg_distinct_open_delay_min,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.sent_at, os.opened_at), 0.5) AS median_open_delay_min,
       SUM(CASE WHEN os.device_family = 'Mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_open_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN os.source_key = 'direct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_open_cnt,
       COALESCE(MAX(os.prev_2_open_cnt), 0) AS max_prev_2_open_cnt,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT os.subscriber_id)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) FILTER (WHERE a.send_status = 'SENT'), 0),
           2
       ) AS open_rate_pct,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN os.device_family = 'Mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT os.event_id), 0),
           2
       ) AS mobile_open_share_pct
FROM enriched_sends a
LEFT JOIN open_sessions os
  ON os.batch_id = a.batch_id
 AND os.subscriber_id = a.subscriber_id
GROUP BY a.batch_id, a.newsletter_nm, a.send_day
ORDER BY a.send_day, a.batch_id

/*
  App-store portfolio health report for March 2025.
  Combines download batches, platform mix, rating sentiment, and locale coverage.
  The final long format is suitable for a metric explorer dashboard.
*/
WITH stg_apps AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        app_name,
        category,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(store_profile.content_rating, ''), 'UNRATED') AS content_rating_label,
        store_profile.supported_locales AS supported_locales
    FROM dim_app_catalog
),
stg_downloads AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        app_id,
        country_code,
        downloaded_at,
        platform,
        download_count,
        gross_revenue,
        refund_count,
        FROM_JSON(event_json, 'STRUCT<channel: STRING, days_since_release: INT>') AS event_details
    FROM fct_app_downloads
    WHERE downloaded_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND downloaded_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
),
stg_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        rating_id,
        app_id,
        rated_at,
        stars,
        CASE
            WHEN stars IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
            WHEN stars >= 4 THEN 'PROMOTER'
            WHEN stars = 3 THEN 'NEUTRAL'
            ELSE 'DETRACTOR'
        END AS rating_band,
        COALESCE(stars, 0) AS stars_scored
    FROM fct_app_ratings
),
app_daily AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        DATE(downloaded_at) AS download_day,
        SUM(download_count) AS day_downloads,
        SUM(gross_revenue) AS day_revenue,
        SUM(refund_count) AS day_refunds,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(event_details.channel)) AS day_channels,
        SUM(SUM(download_count)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY app_id
            ORDER BY DATE(downloaded_at)
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 2 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_3d_downloads
    FROM stg_downloads
    GROUP BY app_id, DATE(downloaded_at)
),
platform_mix AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT app_id, platform, download_count
        FROM stg_downloads
    )
    PIVOT (
        SUM(download_count)
        FOR platform IN (
            'ios' AS ios_downloads,
            'android' AS android_downloads,
            'web' AS web_downloads
        )
    )
),
app_summary AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.ios_downloads,
        p.android_downloads,
        p.web_downloads,
        CAST(COALESCE(s.total_downloads, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_downloads,
        CAST(s.gross_revenue AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gross_revenue,
        s.median_daily_downloads,
        s.peak_3d_downloads,
        s.acquisition_channels,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM stg_ratings r
         WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.rating_band = 'PROMOTER') AS promoter_ratings,
        CAST((SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars)
              FROM stg_ratings r
              WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS median_rating,
        TRANSFORM(
            FILTER(a.supported_locales, locale -> locale LIKE 'en-%'),
            locale -> UPPER(locale)
        ) AS english_locales,
        CASE
            WHEN s.total_downloads IS NULL THEN 'NO ACTIVITY'
            WHEN s.total_downloads >= 100 THEN 'HIGH MOMENTUM'
            WHEN s.total_downloads >= 50 THEN 'STEADY'
            ELSE 'NICHE'
        END AS performance_label,
        CASE
            WHEN (SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars) FROM stg_ratings r
                  WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) IS NULL THEN 'UNRATED'
            WHEN (SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars) FROM stg_ratings r
                  WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) >= 4 THEN 'LOVED'
            WHEN (SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars) FROM stg_ratings r
                  WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) >= 3 THEN 'MIXED'
            ELSE 'CRITICAL'
        END AS rating_health
    FROM stg_apps a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            app_id,
            SUM(day_downloads) AS total_downloads,
            SUM(day_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
            SUM(day_refunds) AS total_refunds,
            PERCENTILE_APPROX(day_downloads, 0.5) AS median_daily_downloads,
            MAX(rolling_3d_downloads) AS peak_3d_downloads,
            ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_DISTINCT(FLATTEN(COLLECT_LIST(day_channels)))) AS acquisition_channels
        FROM app_daily
        GROUP BY app_id
    ) s ON s.app_id = a.app_id
    LEFT JOIN platform_mix p ON p.app_id = a.app_id
)
-- SQL UNPIVOT removes measures whose value is NULL.
SELECT
    app_id,
    app_name,
    category,
    content_rating_label,
    performance_label,
    rating_health,
    english_locales,
    acquisition_channels,
    promoter_ratings,
    metric_name,
    metric_value
FROM app_summary
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric_name IN (total_downloads, gross_revenue, median_rating)
)
ORDER BY metric_name, metric_value DESC NULLS LAST, performance_label, app_id

WITH latest_plan AS (
    -- Keep only the newest plan change for each subscriber.
    SELECT acct_id, plan_id, effective_ts
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY acct_id
                   ORDER BY effective_ts DESC, hist_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM plan_change_history h
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
call_enriched AS (
    -- Enrich March CDRs with the subscriber, latest plan, map features and text/JSON attributes.
    SELECT c.*,
           a.acct_nm,
           a.market_cd,
           a.acct_status,
           COALESCE(lp.plan_id, a.plan_id) AS plan_id,
           rp.plan_nm,
           ELEMENT_AT(rp.feature_limits, 'intl_min') AS intl_min_limit,
           SIZE(MAP_KEYS(rp.feature_limits)) AS feature_count,
           a.service_address.country AS service_country,
           FROM_JSON(
               a.alert_prefs,
               'STRUCT<data_cap_gb:INT,roam_opt_in:BOOLEAN,contact_email:STRING>'
           ) AS prefs,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.dest_number, '^\\+([0-9]{1,3})', 1) AS dial_prefix,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(c.cell_site, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '') AS normalized_site
    FROM call_detail_records c
    JOIN subscriber_accounts a
      ON a.acct_id = c.acct_id
     AND a.acct_status <> 'CLOSED'
    LEFT JOIN latest_plan lp ON lp.acct_id = c.acct_id
    LEFT JOIN rate_plans rp
      ON rp.plan_id = COALESCE(lp.plan_id, a.plan_id)
    WHERE c.call_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND c.call_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06 00:00:00'
),
call_flags AS (
    -- Derive routing and billable flags plus a numeric RANGE window over similar call durations.
    SELECT ce.*,
           CASE
               WHEN dest_number RLIKE '^\\+(44|33|49|81|61)' THEN 'INTERNATIONAL'
               ELSE 'DOMESTIC'
           END AS route_type,
           CASE
               WHEN call_status = 'CONNECTED' AND direction = 'OUTBOUND' THEN duration_sec
               ELSE 0
           END AS billable_sec,
           COALESCE(prefs.roam_opt_in, FALSE) AS roam_opt_in,
           COALESCE(prefs.data_cap_gb, 0) AS data_cap_gb,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY acct_id
               ORDER BY duration_sec
               RANGE BETWEEN 300 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_duration_calls
    FROM call_enriched ce
),
daily_usage AS (
    -- Aggregate filtered call measures by subscriber and usage day.
    SELECT acct_id,
           acct_nm,
           market_cd,
           plan_id,
           plan_nm,
           service_country,
           intl_min_limit,
           feature_count,
           data_cap_gb,
           TO_DATE(call_ts) AS usage_day,
           COUNT(*) AS total_calls,
           SUM(billable_sec) AS billable_sec,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE call_status = 'CONNECTED') AS connected_calls,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (
               WHERE roaming_ind AND call_status = 'CONNECTED'
           ) AS roaming_calls,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE route_type = 'INTERNATIONAL') AS intl_calls,
           AVG(nearby_duration_calls) AS avg_nearby_duration_calls,
           SUM(charge_amt) AS charge_amt
    FROM call_flags
    GROUP BY acct_id, acct_nm, market_cd, plan_id, plan_nm, service_country,
             intl_min_limit, feature_count, data_cap_gb, TO_DATE(call_ts)
),
usage_windows AS (
    -- Calculate a moving total over the two rows before the current usage day.
    SELECT du.*,
           COALESCE(
               SUM(billable_sec) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY acct_id
                   ORDER BY usage_day
                   ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
               ),
               0
           ) AS prior_two_day_billable_sec
    FROM daily_usage du
),
acct_summary AS (
    -- Roll daily activity up to subscriber level and retain accounts with at least three calls.
    SELECT acct_id,
           acct_nm,
           market_cd,
           plan_nm,
           service_country,
           intl_min_limit,
           feature_count,
           data_cap_gb,
           SUM(total_calls) AS total_calls,
           SUM(billable_sec) AS total_billable_sec,
           SUM(connected_calls) AS connected_calls,
           SUM(roaming_calls) AS roaming_calls,
           SUM(intl_calls) AS intl_calls,
           PERCENTILE_APPROX(billable_sec, 0.5) AS median_daily_billable_sec,
           ROUND(AVG(avg_nearby_duration_calls), 2) AS avg_nearby_duration_calls,
           MAX(prior_two_day_billable_sec) AS peak_prior_two_day_billable_sec,
           ROUND(SUM(charge_amt), 2) AS total_charge_amt
    FROM usage_windows
    GROUP BY acct_id, acct_nm, market_cd, plan_nm, service_country,
             intl_min_limit, feature_count, data_cap_gb
    HAVING SUM(total_calls) >= 3
)

    select
        vendor_id, vendor_name, region, payment_terms_days,
        coalesce(
            cast(from_json(profile_json, 'struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>').risk_score as decimal(10,2)),
            cast(50 as decimal(10,2))
        ) as risk_score,
        from_json(profile_json, 'struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>').diversity_certified as diversity_certified,
        from_json(profile_json, 'struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>').review_cycle as review_cycle,
        (select cast(avg(subtotal) as decimal(18,4)) from stg_purchase_orders) as portfolio_avg_subtotal
    from stg_vendor_master
    where active_flag = true
),
stg_order_scope as (
    -- Keep approved, unblocked orders for active vendors with a completed approval.
    select
        ord.*,
        ven.vendor_name, ven.region, ven.payment_terms_days,
        ven.risk_score, ven.diversity_certified, ven.review_cycle,
        ven.portfolio_avg_subtotal,
        cast(
            ord.subtotal + coalesce(ord.tax_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))
            + coalesce(ord.freight_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))
            as decimal(18,2)
        ) as gross_amount
    from stg_purchase_orders ord
    join stg_vendor_profile ven on ven.vendor_id = ord.vendor_id
    where ord.po_status in ('APPROVED', 'CLOSED')
      and exists (
          select 1 from stg_po_approvals app
          where app.po_id = ord.po_id and app.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
      )
      and not exists (
          select 1 from stg_po_line_items lin
          where lin.po_id = ord.po_id and lin.compliance_block = true
      )
),
stg_cost_components as (
    -- Unpivot monetary components; SQL UNPIVOT omits the null tax component.
    select
        po_id, vendor_id, ordered_at, region, component_name,
        cast(component_value as decimal(18,2)) as component_value
    from stg_order_scope
    unpivot (
        component_value for component_name in (subtotal, tax_amount, freight_amount)
    )
),
stg_vendor_costs as (
    -- Aggregate component economics, distinct-value diagnostics, and filtered counts.
    select
        vendor_id,
        count(distinct po_id) as po_count,
        count(*) filter (where component_name = 'tax_amount') as taxed_component_rows,
        count(*) filter (where component_name = 'freight_amount' and component_value > 0) as freight_component_rows,
        sum(case when component_name = 'subtotal' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end) as subtotal_spend,
        sum(case when component_name = 'freight_amount' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end) as freight_spend,
        round(

            * sum(case when component_name = 'freight_amount' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end)
            / nullif(sum(case when component_name = 'subtotal' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end), 0),
            2
        ) as freight_pct,
        avg(distinct component_value) as avg_distinct_component_value,
        sum(distinct component_value) as sum_distinct_component_value
    from stg_cost_components
    group by vendor_id
),

WITH latest_passes AS (
    -- Keep only the newest pass version and derive active benefit codes.
    SELECT ticket_id,
           performance_id,
           patron_profile,
           entitlements,
           ELEMENT_AT(reader_overrides, 'lane_hint') AS lane_hint,
           TRANSFORM(
               FILTER(entitlements, item -> item.benefit_status = 'ACTIVE'),
               item -> UPPER(item.benefit_code)
           ) AS active_benefit_codes
    FROM (
        SELECT sp.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY ticket_id
                   ORDER BY updated_at DESC, pass_version DESC
               ) AS recency_rank
        FROM stg_ticket_passes sp
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
pass_benefits AS (
    -- Flatten entitlement structs and summarize active benefits per ticket.
    SELECT lp.ticket_id,
           ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(
               CONCAT_WS(':', item.benefit_code, item.seat_zone)
           )) AS benefit_details,
           SIZE(COLLECT_SET(item.benefit_code)) AS benefit_type_count
    FROM latest_passes lp
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(lp.entitlements) AS item
    WHERE item.benefit_status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY lp.ticket_id
),
gate_metrics AS (
    -- Pivot gate observations into comparable string-valued health columns.
    SELECT gate_code, service_date, crowd_state, network_state
    FROM (
        SELECT gate_code, service_date, metric, metric_value
        FROM stg_gate_incidents
    ) observations
    PIVOT (
        MAX(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN ('CROWD' AS crowd_state, 'NETWORK' AS network_state)
    )
),
scoped_scans AS (
    -- Match scans to their performance access window and enrich ticket details.
    SELECT s.scan_id,
           s.ticket_id,
           p.performance_id,
           p.performance_name,
           p.starts_at,
           s.scanned_at,
           s.gate_code,
           s.scan_result,
           p.access_policy.default_gate AS default_gate,
           p.access_policy.late_grace_minutes AS late_grace_minutes,
           CONCAT_WS(
               ' / ', lp.patron_profile.display_name,
               CONCAT('MEMBER-', LPAD(CAST(lp.patron_profile.member_id AS STRING), 3, '0'))
           ) AS patron_label,
           ARRAY_JOIN(SPLIT(s.seat_label, '-'), '/') AS seat_ref,
           CONCAT_WS(
               '-', p.venue_code, LPAD(CAST(s.scan_id AS STRING), 3, '0'),
               ARRAY_JOIN(SPLIT(s.seat_label, '-'), '')
           ) AS scan_ref,
           lp.lane_hint,
           lp.active_benefit_codes,
           UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.scanned_at) AS scan_epoch
    FROM fct_entry_scans s
    JOIN latest_passes lp ON lp.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
    JOIN dim_performances p
      ON p.performance_id = lp.performance_id
     AND s.scanned_at BETWEEN p.doors_open_at - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
                          AND p.ends_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR
),
session_flags AS (
    -- Start a new entry session after a forty-five minute scanning gap.
    SELECT ss.*,
           CASE
               WHEN LAG(scanned_at) OVER (

               ) IS NULL THEN 1
               WHEN scanned_at > LAG(scanned_at) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY scanned_at, scan_id
               ) + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1

/*
  Daily work-order scrap review.
  Combines output counts, defect weighting, recent scrap context, and line targets.
  Null output measures are excluded by UNPIVOT; null scrap quantities mean zero.
*/
WITH output_long AS (
    SELECT work_order_id, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM production_output_counts
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            good_qty,
            rework_qty,
            audit_sample_qty
        )
    )
),
output_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        work_order_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'good_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS good_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'rework_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS rework_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'audit_sample_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS audit_sample_qty,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'rework_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(
                SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('good_qty', 'rework_qty') THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END),
                0
            ),
            2
        ) AS rework_share_pct
    FROM output_long
    GROUP BY work_order_id
),
scrap_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.scrap_entry_id,
        s.work_order_id,
        s.event_ts,
        s.operation_seq,
        s.defect_code,
        h.routing.primary_cell,
        h.routing.shift_lead,
        COALESCE(s.scrap_qty, 0) AS scrap_qty,
        COALESCE(s.rework_qty, 0) AS rework_qty,
        s.containment_state,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(s.scrap_qty, 0)
            * (s.material_cost + s.labor_cost)
            * COALESCE(element_at(h.defect_multipliers, s.defect_code), 1.0)
            AS DECIMAL(12,2)
        ) AS weighted_scrap_cost,
        EXISTS(h.allowed_defect_codes, code -> code = s.defect_code) AS defect_allowed,
        FILTER(
            TRANSFORM(h.allowed_defect_codes, code -> upper(code)),
            code -> code <> 'LEGACY'
        ) AS active_defect_allowlist
    FROM scrap_fact_entries s
    JOIN work_order_specs h
      ON h.work_order_id = s.work_order_id
),
scrap_windowed AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        SUM(scrap_qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY work_order_id
            ORDER BY operation_seq
            RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_operation_scrap,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY work_order_id
            ORDER BY event_ts DESC, scrap_entry_id DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM scrap_enriched se
),
latest_scrap AS (
    -- One deterministic context row per work order.
    SELECT sw.*
    FROM scrap_windowed sw
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY work_order_id
        ORDER BY event_ts DESC, scrap_entry_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
scrap_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        work_order_id,
        SUM(scrap_qty) AS total_scrap_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN containment_state = 'CUSTOMER_FOUND' THEN scrap_qty ELSE 0 END) AS customer_found_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN defect_allowed THEN weighted_scrap_cost ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END) AS allowed_defect_cost,
        SUM(weighted_scrap_cost) AS total_weighted_scrap_cost,
        percentile_approx(scrap_qty, 0.5) AS median_scrap_qty,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN containment_state = 'CUSTOMER_FOUND' THEN scrap_qty ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(scrap_qty), 0),
            2
        ) AS customer_found_pct
    FROM scrap_windowed
    GROUP BY work_order_id
)
SELECT
    sr.*,
    wo.plant_code,
    wo.line_code,
    wo.product_family,
    ls.primary_cell,
    ls.shift_lead,
    ls.event_ts AS last_scrap_ts,
    ls.defect_code AS last_defect_code,
    ls.nearby_operation_scrap,
    size(ls.active_defect_allowlist) AS active_allowed_defects,
    oru.good_qty,
    oru.rework_qty,
    oru.audit_sample_qty,
    oru.rework_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * sr.total_scrap_qty
        / NULLIF(oru.good_qty + sr.total_scrap_qty, 0),
        2
    ) AS scrap_rate_pct,
    COALESCE(lsc.scrap_target_pct, CAST(5.00 AS DECIMAL(5,2))) AS scrap_target_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN 100.0 * sr.total_scrap_qty
             / NULLIF(oru.good_qty + sr.total_scrap_qty, 0)
             > COALESCE(lsc.scrap_target_pct, CAST(5.00 AS DECIMAL(5,2)))
        THEN 'ABOVE_TARGET'
        ELSE 'WITHIN_TARGET'
    END AS scrap_status
FROM scrap_rollup sr
JOIN latest_scrap ls
  ON ls.work_order_id = sr.work_order_id
JOIN output_rollup oru
  ON oru.work_order_id = sr.work_order_id
JOIN work_order_specs wo
  ON wo.work_order_id = sr.work_order_id
LEFT JOIN line_scrap_controls lsc
  ON lsc.plant_code = wo.plant_code
 AND lsc.line_code = wo.line_code
-- Ignore small jobs and lines without enough accepted output.
WHERE wo.planned_qty >= 200
  AND oru.good_qty >= 100
ORDER BY scrap_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST, sr.work_order_id

/*
  Newsletter deliverability and engagement review.
  Variant-level send facts are compared with validated open events by
  campaign and subscriber region; null device buckets mean no valid opens.
*/
with stg_subscribers as (
    select
        subscriber_id,
        region,
        lifecycle_status,
        from_json(profile_json, 'struct<timezone:string,vip:boolean>') as subscriber_profile,
        element_at(preferences, 'digest') as digest_cadence
    from dim_subscribers
),
stg_send_variants as (
    -- Exploding test variants repeats the parent send and its cost.
    select
        s.send_id,
        s.campaign_id,
        s.sent_at,
        s.delivery_status,
        s.send_cost,
        s.subscriber_id,
        sub.region,
        sub.digest_cadence,
        sub.subscriber_profile.timezone as profile_timezone,
        coalesce(sub.subscriber_profile.vip, false) as is_vip,
        item.variant_code as variant_code,
        item.subject_line as subject_line,
        item.open_count as item_open_count,
        item.click_count as item_click_count
    from fct_newsletter_sends s
    join stg_subscribers sub
      on sub.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id
     and sub.lifecycle_status <> 'CHURNED'
    lateral view explode(s.variant_results) as item
),
stg_open_events as (
    -- Exclude pre-send timestamps and non-active recipients from event KPIs.
    select
        o.open_id,
        o.send_id,
        o.opened_at,
        upper(o.device_type) as device_type,
        s.campaign_id,
        sub.region
    from fct_open_events o
    join fct_newsletter_sends s
      on s.send_id = o.send_id
    join stg_subscribers sub
      on sub.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id
    where o.opened_at >= s.sent_at
      and sub.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
),
pvt_open_devices as (
    select
        campaign_id,
        region,
        mobile_opens,
        desktop_opens,
        tablet_opens
    from (
        select campaign_id, region, open_id, device_type
        from stg_open_events
    ) device_events
    pivot (
        count(open_id) as open_count
        for device_type in (
            'MOBILE' as mobile_opens,
            'DESKTOP' as desktop_opens,
            'TABLET' as tablet_opens
        )
    )
),
fct_campaign_metrics as (
    select
        campaign_id,
        region,
        count(distinct send_id) as send_count,
        count(distinct send_id) filter (
            where delivery_status = 'delivered'
        ) as delivered_sends,
        sum(distinct send_cost) filter (
            where delivery_status = 'delivered'
        ) as delivered_cost,
        count(distinct subscriber_id) as unique_recipients,
        sum(item_open_count) filter (
            where delivery_status = 'delivered'
        ) as recorded_opens,
        sum(item_click_count) filter (
            where item_click_count > 0
        ) as recorded_clicks,
        count(*) filter (where variant_code = 'B') as challenger_rows,
        count(*) filter (where digest_cadence = 'weekly') as weekly_digest_rows
    from stg_send_variants
    group by campaign_id, region
)
select
    m.*,
    c.campaign_name,
    coalesce(p.mobile_opens, 0) as mobile_opens,
    coalesce(p.desktop_opens, 0) as desktop_opens,
    coalesce(p.tablet_opens, 0) as tablet_opens,
    round(
        100.0 * m.recorded_clicks / nullif(m.recorded_opens, 0),
        2
    ) as click_to_open_pct,
    lag(m.delivered_sends, 1, 0) over (
        partition by m.region
        order by c.launch_date, m.campaign_id
    ) as previous_region_delivered_sends,
    lead(coalesce(p.mobile_opens, 0), 1, 0) over (
        partition by m.region
        order by c.launch_date, m.campaign_id
    ) as next_region_mobile_opens
from fct_campaign_metrics m
join dim_campaigns c
  on c.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
left join pvt_open_devices p
  on p.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
 and p.region = m.region
order by m.region, c.launch_date, m.campaign_id

with exploded_legs as (
    -- keep March posted authorizations and flatten their principal and fee legs
    select
        t.txn_id,
        t.acct_id,
        t.merchant_id,
        t.txn_ts,
        t.channel,
        t.cash_advance_flag,
        m.merchant_category,
        leg.leg_seq,
        leg.leg_type,
        cast(coalesce(leg.leg_amt, 0) as decimal(14,2)) as leg_amt,
        case
            when t.cash_advance_flag then 'CASH_ADVANCE'
            when t.channel = 'ECOM' then 'ONLINE'
            when coalesce(nullif(m.risk_tier, ''), 'STANDARD') = 'HIGH' then 'HIGH_RISK'
            else 'STANDARD'
        end as spend_class
    from card_txn t
    left join merchant_profile m
        on m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
    lateral view explode(t.legs) lv as leg
    where t.txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and t.txn_ts < timestamp '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
      and coalesce(nullif(t.status, ''), 'UNKNOWN') = 'POSTED'
),
acct_rollup as (
    -- build account metrics, including deduplicated amounts and filtered counts
    select
        e.acct_id,
        a.segment,
        cast(sum(distinct e.leg_amt) filter (
            where e.leg_type = 'PRINCIPAL'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as principal_total,
        cast(sum(e.leg_amt) filter (
            where e.leg_type = 'FEE'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as fee_total,
        cast(count(distinct e.txn_id) as decimal(20,4)) as txn_count,
        cast(percentile_approx(e.leg_amt, 0.5) as decimal(20,4)) as median_leg,
        cast(count(*) filter (
            where e.leg_type = 'FEE'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as fee_leg_count,
        cast(count(*) filter (
            where e.spend_class = 'ONLINE'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as online_leg_count
    from exploded_legs e
    join card_acct a
        on a.acct_id = e.acct_id
    group by e.acct_id, a.segment
),
metric_long as (
    -- turn the account measures into rows for a common pivot calculation
    select acct_id, segment, metric_name, metric_value
    from acct_rollup
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric_name in (
            principal_total,
            fee_total,
            txn_count,
            median_leg,
            fee_leg_count,
            online_leg_count
        )
    )
),
metric_wide as (
    -- restore named decimal measures with readable output aliases
    select *
    from metric_long
    pivot (
        round(sum(metric_value), 2)
        for metric_name in (
            'principal_total' as principal_spend,
            'fee_total' as fee_spend,
            'txn_count' as txn_count,
            'median_leg' as median_leg,
            'fee_leg_count' as fee_leg_count,
            'online_leg_count' as online_leg_count
        )
    )
),
ranked as (
    -- retain the two largest spending accounts per segment with a stable tie-break
    select
        p.*,
        row_number() over (
            partition by p.segment
            order by p.principal_spend desc nulls last, p.acct_id
        ) as segment_rank
    from metric_wide p
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by p.segment
        order by p.principal_spend desc nulls last, p.acct_id
    ) <= 2
)
select
    a.*,
    b.cust_id,
    b.status as acct_status,
    round(
        coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / nullif(b.credit_limit, 0) * 100,

    ) as limit_util_pct,
    case
        when b.credit_limit is null then 'LIMIT_UNKNOWN'
        when coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / nullif(b.credit_limit, 0) * 100 >= 5
            then 'HIGH_UTIL'
        when coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / nullif(b.credit_limit, 0) * 100 >= 4
            then 'MEDIUM_UTIL'
        else 'LOW_UTIL'
    end as util_band,
    cast(floor(coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / 100) as int) as spend_hundreds,
    cast(ceil(coalesce(a.fee_spend, 0) / 10) as int) as fee_tens,
    (
        select round(avg(src.credit_limit), 2)
        from card_acct src
        where src.status = 'ACTIVE'
    ) as active_avg_limit
from ranked a
left join card_acct b
    on b.acct_id = a.acct_id
order by a.segment, a.segment_rank, a.acct_id

WITH candidate_pool AS (
    SELECT
        a.application_id,
        a.candidate_id,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.full_name, ''), 'Name pending') AS candidate_name,
        a.job_family,
        a.application_status,
        a.applied_at,
        COALESCE(c.profile.years_exp, 0) AS years_exp,
        c.profile.notice_days AS notice_days,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.profile.referral_source, ''), 'Unknown') AS referral_source,
        ARRAY_JOIN(
            FILTER(
                TRANSFORM(c.skills, skill -> UPPER(skill)),
                skill -> skill IN ('SQL', 'PYTHON', 'SPARK', 'JAVA', 'SCALA')
            ),
            ', '
        ) AS core_skills,
        EXISTS(c.skills, skill -> LOWER(skill) IN ('python', 'sql', 'spark')) AS has_data_stack
    FROM applications a
    JOIN candidates c
      ON c.candidate_id = a.candidate_id
    WHERE (c.profile.years_exp IS NULL OR c.profile.years_exp >= 2)
      AND a.application_status IN ('SCREEN', 'INTERVIEW', 'OFFER', 'HIRED', 'REJECTED')
),
interview_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        application_id,
        interview_id,
        interviewer_id,
        started_at,
        duration_min,
        technical_score,
        communication_score,
        ownership_score,
        -- A gap over 36 hours starts another interview session.
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL
                  OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_id
            ORDER BY started_at, interview_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_id,
        AVG(CAST(duration_min AS DOUBLE)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_id
            ORDER BY started_at, interview_id
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_avg_duration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_id
            ORDER BY started_at DESC, interview_id DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i.application_id,
            i.interview_id,
            i.interviewer_id,
            i.started_at,
            i.duration_min,
            r.technical_score,
            r.communication_score,
            r.ownership_score,
            LAG(i.started_at) OVER (
                PARTITION BY i.application_id
                ORDER BY i.started_at, i.interview_id
            ) AS prev_started_at
        FROM interviews i
        JOIN interview_reviews r
          ON r.interview_id = i.interview_id
        JOIN candidate_pool cp
          ON cp.application_id = i.application_id
    ) sequenced
),
score_long AS (
    SELECT application_id, session_id, metric, score_value
    FROM interview_sessions
    UNPIVOT (
        score_value FOR metric IN (
            technical_score,
            communication_score,
            ownership_score
        )
    )
),
score_pivot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM score_long
    PIVOT (
        ROUND(AVG(score_value), 2)
        FOR metric IN (
            'technical_score' AS technical_avg,
            'communication_score' AS communication_avg,
            'ownership_score' AS ownership_avg
        )
    )
),
application_stats AS (
    SELECT
        application_id,
        COUNT(*) AS interview_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT interviewer_id) AS interviewer_count,
        ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT duration_min), 2) AS avg_distinct_duration,
        SUM(DISTINCT duration_min) AS distinct_duration_minutes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN recency_rank = 1 THEN session_id END) AS latest_session_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN recency_rank = 1 THEN ROUND(prior_avg_duration, 2) END) AS latest_prior_avg_duration,
        MAX(started_at) AS last_interview_at
    FROM interview_sessions
    GROUP BY application_id
)
SELECT
    cp.application_id,
    cp.candidate_name,
    cp.job_family,
    cp.application_status,
    cp.years_exp,
    cp.notice_days,
    cp.referral_source,
    COALESCE(cp.core_skills, 'Not listed') AS core_skills,
    cp.has_data_stack,
    COALESCE(st.interview_count, 0) AS interview_count,
    COALESCE(st.interviewer_count, 0) AS interviewer_count,
    st.avg_distinct_duration,
    COALESCE(st.distinct_duration_minutes, 0) AS distinct_duration_minutes,
    COALESCE(st.session_count, 0) AS session_count,
    st.latest_session_id,
    st.last_interview_at,
    st.latest_prior_avg_duration,
    sp.technical_avg,
    sp.communication_avg,
    sp.ownership_avg,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.application_status = 'HIRED' THEN 'Closed - hired'
        WHEN st.interview_count IS NULL THEN 'Awaiting first interview'
        WHEN COALESCE(sp.technical_avg, 0) >= 4.2
         AND sp.ownership_avg >= 4.0 THEN 'Advanced signal'
        WHEN COALESCE(sp.technical_avg, sp.communication_avg, 0) >= 3.0 THEN 'Mixed signal'
        ELSE 'At risk'
    END AS recommendation,
    CASE
        WHEN st.interviewer_count >= 4 THEN 'Large panel'
        WHEN st.interviewer_count >= 2 THEN 'Standard panel'
        WHEN st.interviewer_count = 1 THEN 'Single interviewer'
        ELSE 'No panel'
    END AS panel_label,
    CASE
        WHEN st.last_interview_at IS NULL THEN 'Schedule screen'
        WHEN st.latest_prior_avg_duration IS NULL THEN 'First session complete'
        WHEN st.session_count >= 2 THEN 'Multi-session debrief'
        ELSE 'Panel debrief'
    END AS follow_up_bucket
FROM candidate_pool cp
LEFT JOIN application_stats st
  ON st.application_id = cp.application_id
LEFT JOIN score_pivot sp
  ON sp.application_id = cp.application_id
 AND sp.session_id = st.latest_session_id
ORDER BY recommendation, application_id
