        "interview_id",
        "interviewer_id",
        "started_at",
        "duration_min",
        "technical_score",
        "communication_score",
        "ownership_score",
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 36 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0)).over(Window.partitionBy("application_id").orderBy("started_at", "interview_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
        F.avg(F.col("duration_min").cast("double")).over(Window.partitionBy("application_id").orderBy("started_at", "interview_id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("prior_avg_duration"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("application_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), F.col("interview_id").desc())).alias("recency_rank"),
    )
)

score_long = (
    interview_sessions
    .select(
        "application_id",
        "session_id",
        F.col("technical_score").alias("technical_score"),
        F.col("communication_score").alias("communication_score"),
        F.col("ownership_score").alias("ownership_score"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["application_id", "session_id"],
        values=["technical_score", "communication_score", "ownership_score"],
        variableColumnName="metric",
        valueColumnName="score_value",
    )
)

score_pivot = (
    score_long
    .groupBy("application_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["technical_score", "communication_score", "ownership_score"])
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("score_value"), 2).alias("avg_score"))
    .select(
        "application_id",
        F.col("technical_score").alias("technical_avg"),
        F.col("communication_score").alias("communication_avg"),
        F.col("ownership_score").alias("ownership_avg"),
    )
)

application_stats = (
    interview_sessions
    .groupBy("application_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("interview_count"),
        F.countDistinct("interviewer_id").alias("interviewer_count"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.distinct("duration_min")), 2).alias("avg_distinct_duration"),
        F.sum(F.distinct("duration_min")).alias("distinct_duration_minutes"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("session_count"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("recency_rank") == 1, F.col("session_id"))).alias("latest_session_id"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("recency_rank") == 1, F.round(F.col("prior_avg_duration"), 2))).alias("latest_prior_avg_duration"),
        F.max("started_at").alias("last_interview_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    candidate_pool.alias("cp")
    .join(application_stats.alias("st"), F.col("st.application_id") == F.col("cp.application_id"), "left")
    .join(score_pivot.alias("sp"), (F.col("sp.application_id") == F.col("cp.application_id")) & (F.col("sp.session_id") == F.col("cp.latest_session_id")), "left")
    .select(

        "cp.referral_source",
        F.coalesce(F.col("cp.core_skills"), F.lit("Not listed")).alias("core_skills"),
        "cp.has_data_stack",
        F.coalesce(F.col("st.interview_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("interview_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("st.interviewer_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("interviewer_count"),
        "st.avg_distinct_duration",
        F.coalesce(F.col("st.distinct_duration_minutes"), F.lit(0)).alias("distinct_duration_minutes"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("st.session_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("session_count"),
        "st.latest_session_id",
        "st.last_interview_at",
        "st.latest_prior_avg_duration",
        "sp.technical_avg",

        "sp.ownership_avg",

        "referral_source",
        "core_skills",

WITH parsed_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        from_json(
            checkout_payload,
            'device STRING, coupon STRING, risk_score INT'
        ) AS checkout,
        transform(
            coalesce(promo_tags, array()),
            tag -> upper(tag)
        ) AS normalized_tags,
        coalesce(
            element_at(fee_components, 'service_fee'),
            CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        ) AS service_fee
    FROM stg_ticket_purchases p
    WHERE purchased_at >= (
        SELECT date_trunc('DAY', min(sales_open_at))
        FROM stg_event_performances
        WHERE status <> 'DRAFT'
    )
),
event_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        pp.*,
        ep.venue_id,
        ep.event_name,
        ep.starts_at,
        ep.base_price,
        ep.status AS event_status,
        pp.checkout.device AS checkout_device,
        pp.checkout.coupon AS coupon,
        pp.checkout.risk_score AS risk_score,
        filter(
            normalized_tags,
            tag -> tag LIKE 'FRIEND%'
        ) AS friend_tags,
        exists(normalized_tags, tag -> tag = 'PRESALE') AS used_presale,
        aggregate(
            normalized_tags,
            0,
            (acc, tag) -> acc + length(tag)
        ) AS tag_chars,
        gross_paid + service_fee
            + coalesce(
                element_at(fee_components, 'facility_fee'),
                CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
            ) AS total_collected,
        datediff(
            date_trunc('DAY', starts_at),
            date_trunc('DAY', purchased_at)
        ) AS lead_days,
        starts_at - INTERVAL '2' HOUR AS doors_open_at,
        date_trunc('HOUR', purchased_at) AS purchase_hour,
        timestampdiff(DAY, sales_open_at, purchased_at) AS days_since_open
    FROM parsed_purchases pp
    JOIN stg_event_performances ep
      ON ep.event_id = pp.event_id
    WHERE ep.status = 'PUBLISHED'
),
scan_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        purchase_id,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE scan_outcome = 'VALID') AS valid_scan_count,
        min(scanned_at) AS first_scan_at,
        max(scanned_at) AS last_scan_at
    FROM stg_entry_scans
    GROUP BY purchase_id
),
seat_enriched AS (
    -- Missing section mappings remain visible for manual seat-map review.
    SELECT
        ep.*,
        sr.valid_scan_count,
        sr.first_scan_at,
        sr.last_scan_at,
        ss.section_tier,
        ss.capacity
    FROM event_purchases ep
    LEFT JOIN scan_rollup sr
      ON sr.purchase_id = ep.purchase_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_seating_sections ss
      ON ss.venue_id = ep.venue_id
     AND ss.section_code = ep.seat_hold.section_code
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        -- A numeric RANGE frame implements a trailing 24-hour revenue window.
        sum(total_collected) OVER (
            PARTITION BY event_id
            ORDER BY unix_timestamp(purchased_at)
            RANGE BETWEEN 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS revenue_last_24h
    FROM seat_enriched se
)
SELECT
    event_id,
    event_name,
    purchase_id,
    customer_id,
    seat_hold.section_code AS section_code,
    coalesce(section_tier, 'UNMAPPED') AS section_tier,
    checkout_device,
    coupon,
    risk_score,
    friend_tags,
    used_presale,
    tag_chars,
    seat_count,
    gross_paid,
    service_fee,
    total_collected,
    lead_days,
    doors_open_at,
    days_since_open,
    coalesce(valid_scan_count, 0) AS valid_scan_count,
    last_scan_at,
    timestampdiff(
        MINUTE,
        purchased_at,
        first_scan_at
    ) AS minutes_to_first_scan,
    round(revenue_last_24h, 2) AS revenue_last_24h,
    round(total_collected / seat_count, 2) AS collected_per_seat,
    CASE
        WHEN risk_score IS NULL THEN 'UNSCORED'
        WHEN risk_score >= 60 THEN 'REVIEW'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS risk_band
FROM metrics
ORDER BY event_id, purchase_id

WITH policy_base AS (
    -- Keep in-force policy shells and normalize account and contact attributes.
    SELECT
        p.policy_id,
        upper(regexp_replace(trim(p.acct_ref), '^ACCT-', '')) AS acct_key,
        p.holder_name,
        p.region_code,
        p.garaging_details.state AS garaging_state,
        lower(get_json_object(p.contact_json, '$.email')) AS contact_email
    FROM policy_contracts p
    WHERE p.policy_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'BOUND')
),
claim_base AS (
    -- Retain recognizable FNOL narratives and attach the normalized policy shell.
    SELECT
        c.claim_id,
        c.policy_id,
        c.opened_at,
        c.claim_status,
        c.adjuster_ref,
        c.paid_amt,
        p.acct_key,
        p.holder_name,
        p.region_code,
        p.garaging_state,
        p.contact_email,
        regexp_extract(c.loss_narrative, 'FNOL-([A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3})', 1) AS fnol_ref
    FROM claim_txns c
    JOIN policy_base p
      ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
    WHERE c.loss_narrative RLIKE 'FNOL-[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3}'
),
line_base AS (
    -- Remove non-positive assessment lines before exploding the nested estimate.
    SELECT
        c.*,
        a.reviewed_at,
        item.line_code,
        item.qty,
        item.net_amount AS net_line_amt
    FROM claim_base c
    JOIN claim_assessments a
      ON a.claim_id = c.claim_id
    LATERAL VIEW explode(
        filter(a.line_items, x -> x.qty > 0 AND x.net_amount > 0)
    ) li AS item
),
covered_lines AS (
    -- Match estimate lines to coverage, allowing a seven-day reporting grace period,
    -- and remove adjusters on the exclusion list using an anti-join pattern.
    SELECT
        c.*,
        w.coverage_id,
        w.coverage_code,
        w.limit_amt,
        w.deductible_amt
    FROM line_base c
    JOIN coverage_windows w
      ON w.policy_id = c.policy_id
     AND w.coverage_code = c.line_code
     AND c.opened_at BETWEEN w.start_at AND w.end_at + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    LEFT JOIN excluded_adjusters x
      ON x.adjuster_ref = c.adjuster_ref
    WHERE x.adjuster_ref IS NULL
),
branch_union AS (
    -- Split material estimates and small estimates into separately labelled branches.
    SELECT
        b.*,
        'STANDARD' AS branch_name
    FROM covered_lines b
    WHERE b.qty >= 2
       OR b.net_line_amt >= b.limit_amt * 0.5

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.*,
        'MINOR_REVIEW' AS branch_name
    FROM covered_lines b
    WHERE b.qty = 1
      AND b.net_line_amt < b.limit_amt * 0.5
)
-- Publish line-level claim review facts with a portfolio benchmark.
SELECT
    b.fnol_ref,
    b.claim_id,
    b.acct_key,
    b.holder_name,
    b.garaging_state,
    b.contact_email,
    date_format(b.opened_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS loss_date,
    b.branch_name,
    b.coverage_code,
    b.line_code,
    b.qty,
    b.net_line_amt,
    round(b.net_line_amt - least(b.net_line_amt, b.deductible_amt), 2) AS net_after_deductible,
    b.claim_status,
    (
        SELECT MAX(paid_amt)
        FROM claim_txns
        WHERE claim_status = 'CLOSED'
    ) AS closed_paid_benchmark
FROM branch_union b
ORDER BY
    b.fnol_ref,
    b.coverage_code,
    b.line_code,
    b.branch_name

    WHERE event_type IN ('meter', 'heartbeat')

),
stg_sequenced AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        p.payload.vehicle_soc AS vehicle_soc,
        p.payload.grid_voltage AS grid_voltage,
        p.payload.source AS payload_source,
        lag(event_id, 1, 'START') OVER charge_time AS prev_event_id,
        lag(event_ts, 1) OVER charge_time AS prev_event_ts,
        lead(measured_kw, 1, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) OVER charge_time AS next_kw,
        sum(interval_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY charge_ref
            ORDER BY unix_timestamp(event_ts)
            RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_kwh_30m
    FROM stg_parsed p
    WINDOW charge_time AS (
        PARTITION BY charge_ref
        ORDER BY event_ts, event_id
    )
),
stg_sessionized AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        -- A quiet period over 30 minutes starts another charging block.
        sum(
            CASE
                WHEN prev_event_id = 'START'
                  OR event_ts > prev_event_ts + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY charge_ref
            ORDER BY event_ts, event_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS block_seq,
        CASE
            WHEN next_kw = 0 THEN 'LAST_OR_ZERO'
            WHEN next_kw < measured_kw * 0.5 THEN 'FALLING'
            ELSE 'STEADY'
        END AS power_trend
    FROM stg_sequenced s
),
stg_txn_charges AS (
    SELECT
        t.charge_ref,
        sum(item.amount) AS listed_amount,
        -- Repeated amounts must not inflate the distinct component total.
        sum(DISTINCT item.amount) AS distinct_component_amount,
        count(DISTINCT item.component) AS component_count,
        count(DISTINCT item.tax_code) AS tax_code_count
    FROM fct_charge_transactions t
    LATERAL VIEW explode(t.line_items) exploded AS item
    GROUP BY t.charge_ref
),
fct_block_totals AS (
    SELECT
        charge_ref,
        concat(charge_ref, '-', block_seq) AS charging_block_id,
        block_seq,
        min(event_ts) AS block_started_at,
        max(event_ts) AS block_ended_at,
        sum(interval_kwh) AS block_kwh,
        round(avg(vehicle_soc), 1) AS avg_vehicle_soc,
        max(grid_voltage) AS max_grid_voltage,
        max(rolling_kwh_30m) AS peak_rolling_kwh_30m,
        count(*) AS reading_count,
        sum(CASE WHEN power_trend = 'FALLING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falling_readings
    FROM stg_sessionized
    GROUP BY charge_ref, block_seq
),
fct_enriched_blocks AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        t.driver_id,
        t.billing_profile.country AS billing_country,
        t.billing_profile.currency AS billing_currency,
        t.billing_profile.customer_tier AS customer_tier,
        st.site_name,
        st.site_traits.grid_region AS grid_region,
        c.listed_amount,
        c.distinct_component_amount,
        c.component_count,
        c.tax_code_count
    FROM fct_block_totals b
    JOIN fct_charge_transactions t
      ON t.charge_ref = b.charge_ref
    JOIN stg_txn_charges c
      ON c.charge_ref = b.charge_ref
    JOIN dim_charging_sites st
      ON st.site_id = t.site_id
     AND st.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND t.billing_profile.country = st.site_traits.country

    avg_vehicle_soc,
    max_grid_voltage,
    peak_rolling_kwh_30m,
    reading_count,
    falling_readings,
    listed_amount,
    distinct_component_amount,
    component_count,
    tax_code_count,
    CASE
        WHEN driver_id IS NULL THEN 'UNASSIGNED'
        WHEN customer_tier = 'gold' THEN 'PREMIUM'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS driver_segment,
    CASE
        WHEN block_kwh >= 8 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN block_kwh >= 3 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS energy_band,
    round(block_kwh / nullif(listed_amount, 0), 4) AS kwh_per_listed_unit,
    dense_rank() OVER (
        PARTITION BY site_name
        ORDER BY block_kwh DESC, charging_block_id
    ) AS site_energy_rank
FROM fct_enriched_blocks
WHERE block_kwh >= CAST(0.50 AS DECIMAL(10,3))
ORDER BY block_started_at, charge_ref, charging_block_id

WITH charge_lines AS (
    -- Normalize charge components and total only positive payment allocations.
    SELECT rc.lease_id,
           rc.charge_id,
           rc.posted_at,
           rc.due_at,
           component,
           amount,
           aggregate(
               transform(
                   filter(rc.payments, p -> p.amount > 0),
                   p -> cast(p.amount AS DOUBLE)
               ),
               CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
               (acc, p) -> acc + p
           ) AS valid_payment_total
    FROM rent_charges rc
    UNPIVOT (
        amount FOR component IN (
            rent_amount AS rent,
            fee_amount AS fee,
            discount_amount AS discount
        )
    )
),
payment_details AS (
    -- Flatten the payment structs for method-level collection reporting.
    SELECT rc.lease_id,
           rc.charge_id,
           rc.posted_at AS payment_at,
           payment.method AS payment_method,
           payment.amount AS payment_amount
    FROM rent_charges rc
    LATERAL VIEW explode(rc.payments) p AS payment
),
lease_enriched AS (
    -- Screen leases and add property policy, tenant and lease-timing attributes.
    SELECT l.*,
           p.market,
           p.base_rent,
           t.credit_score,
           element_at(p.service_rules, 'pets') AS pet_policy,
           date_trunc('month', l.start_at) AS lease_month,
           datediff(
               coalesce(l.end_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00'),
               l.start_at
           ) AS lease_term_days,
           timestampdiff(
               MONTH,
               l.start_at,
               coalesce(l.end_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00')
           ) AS lease_term_months,
           l.start_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS first_reminder_at,
           CASE
               WHEN l.end_at IS NULL THEN 'open'
               WHEN l.end_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00' THEN 'expired'
               ELSE 'active'
           END AS lease_phase
    FROM leases l
    JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = l.property_id
    JOIN tenants t ON t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id
    WHERE l.status <> 'draft'
      AND (t.credit_score IS NULL OR t.credit_score >= 600)
),
lease_financials AS (
    -- Combine normalized charges with exploded payment-method summaries.
    SELECT c.lease_id,
           c.net_charges,
           c.total_paid,
           p.card_paid,
           c.charge_count,
           p.last_payment_at
    FROM (
        SELECT lease_id,
               sum(amount) AS net_charges,
               sum(
                   CASE WHEN component = 'rent'
                        THEN valid_payment_total
                        ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2))
                   END
               ) AS total_paid,
               count(DISTINCT charge_id) AS charge_count
        FROM charge_lines
        GROUP BY lease_id
    ) c
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT lease_id,
               sum(
                   CASE WHEN payment_method = 'card'
                        THEN payment_amount
                        ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2))
                   END
               ) AS card_paid,
               max(payment_at) AS last_payment_at
        FROM payment_details
        GROUP BY lease_id
    ) p ON p.lease_id = c.lease_id
),
market_stats AS (
    -- Establish a market median before selecting the leading leases.
    SELECT le.market,
           percentile_approx(lf.net_charges, 0.5) AS market_median_net,
           count(*) AS leases_scored
    FROM lease_enriched le
    JOIN lease_financials lf ON lf.lease_id = le.lease_id
    GROUP BY le.market
),
ranked AS (
    -- Calculate trailing market performance and retain two leases per market.
    SELECT le.lease_id,
           le.property_id,
           le.tenant_id,
           le.market,
           le.base_rent,
           le.monthly_rent,
           le.deposit,
           le.status,
           le.start_at,
           le.end_at,
           le.credit_score,
           le.pet_policy,
           le.lease_month,
           le.lease_term_days,
           le.lease_term_months,
           le.first_reminder_at,
           le.lease_phase,
           lf.net_charges,
           lf.total_paid,
           lf.card_paid,
           lf.charge_count,
           lf.last_payment_at,
           round(
               avg(lf.net_charges) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY le.market
                   ORDER BY le.lease_month, le.lease_id
                   ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
               ),
               2
           ) AS prior_market_avg_net,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY le.market
               ORDER BY lf.net_charges DESC NULLS LAST, le.lease_id
           ) AS market_rank
    FROM lease_enriched le
    JOIN lease_financials lf ON lf.lease_id = le.lease_id
    QUALIFY market_rank <= 2
)
SELECT r.*,
       ms.market_median_net,
       ms.leases_scored,
       round(r.net_charges - ms.market_median_net, 2) AS net_vs_market_median,
       (SELECT max(t.credit_score) FROM tenants t) AS portfolio_best_credit
FROM ranked r
JOIN market_stats ms ON ms.market = r.market
ORDER BY r.market,
         r.net_charges DESC NULLS LAST,
         r.prior_market_avg_net NULLS LAST,
         r.lease_id

           cast(availability_pct as double) as availability_pct,
           technician_id,

    from generation_readings
    where reading_ts >= timestamp '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
      and reading_ts < timestamp '2025-06-04 00:00:00'
),
flagged_readings as (
    select reading_id,
           site_id,
           to_date(reading_ts) as reading_date,
           energy_kwh * coalesce(payload.meter_factor, 1.0) as adjusted_kwh,
           expected_kwh,
           availability_pct,
           technician_id,
           filter(
               transform(coalesce(payload.status_flags, array()), flag -> upper(flag)),
               flag -> flag <> 'TEST'
           ) as clean_flags,
           exists(
               coalesce(payload.status_flags, array()),
               flag -> upper(flag) = 'CURTAILED'
           ) as is_curtailed
    from parsed_readings
),
daily_generation as (
    select g.site_id,
           g.reading_date,
           sum(g.adjusted_kwh) as actual_kwh,
           sum(g.expected_kwh) as expected_kwh,
           avg(g.availability_pct) as availability_pct,
           round(
               100 * sum(case when g.is_curtailed then g.adjusted_kwh else 0.0 end)
               / nullif(sum(g.adjusted_kwh), 0),
               2
           ) as curtailment_pct,
           percentile_approx(g.availability_pct, 0.5) as median_availability,
           array_sort(collect_set(g.technician_id)) as technician_ids,
           array_sort(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(g.clean_flags)))) as status_flags,
           coalesce(o.outage_count, 0) as outage_count,
           coalesce(o.lost_kwh, 0.0) as lost_kwh
    from flagged_readings g
    left join (

        from outage_events

      on o.site_id = g.site_id
     and o.outage_date = g.reading_date
    group by g.site_id, g.reading_date, o.outage_count, o.lost_kwh
),
windowed_days as (
    select d.*,
           sum(actual_kwh) over (
               partition by site_id
               order by reading_date
               rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
           ) as prior_2day_kwh,
           avg(actual_kwh) over (
               partition by site_id
               order by actual_kwh
               range between 100 preceding and current row
           ) as nearby_output_avg
    from daily_generation d
),
plant_days as (
    select w.*, p.plant_name, p.region, p.capacity_kw
    from windowed_days w
    join plant_registry p
      on p.site_id = w.site_id
     and p.is_active = true
),
site_rollup as (
    select region,
           site_id,
           grouping(region) as region_grouping,
           grouping(site_id) as site_grouping,
           count(distinct reading_date) as observed_days,
           round(avg(distinct availability_pct), 2) as distinct_avg_availability,

           round(avg(median_availability), 2) as avg_daily_median_availability,

           sum(actual_kwh) as total_actual_kwh,
           sum(expected_kwh) as total_expected_kwh,
           sum(case when outage_count > 0 then lost_kwh else 0.0 end) as outage_loss_kwh,
           max(prior_2day_kwh) as prior_2day_kwh
    from plant_days
    group by rollup (region, site_id)
)
-- Long-form metrics feed the operating dashboard; SQL unpivot omits null metrics.
select region,
       site_id,
       region_grouping,
       site_grouping,
       observed_days,
       distinct_avg_availability,
       avg_curtailment_pct,
       avg_daily_median_availability,

from site_rollup
unpivot (

        total_actual_kwh,
        total_expected_kwh,
        outage_loss_kwh,
        prior_2day_kwh
    )
)

WITH segment_lines AS (
    -- Explode flown coupons so each booking segment can be evaluated independently.
    SELECT b.booking_id,
           b.passenger_id,
           b.pnr,
           b.booked_at,
           b.booking_channel,
           b.fare_basis,
           b.contact.country AS contact_country,
           b.contact.email AS contact_email,
           coupon_pos,
           coupon.coupon_id AS segment_id,
           coupon.origin,
           coupon.destination,
           coupon.depart_ts,
           coupon.cabin,
           coupon.base_fare,
           b.coupons
    FROM stg_flight_bookings b
    LATERAL VIEW posexplode(b.coupons) exploded AS coupon_pos, coupon
    WHERE b.booking_status = 'CONFIRMED'
      AND b.passenger_id IS NOT NULL
      AND coupon.is_flown
),
member_lines AS (
    -- Attach active loyalty profiles and derive array-level fare indicators.
    SELECT s.*,
           m.member_no,
           m.loyalty_tier,
           m.home_airport,
           aggregate(
               s.coupons,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2)),
               (acc, x) -> CAST(acc + CASE WHEN x.is_flown THEN x.base_fare ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END AS DECIMAL(12,2))
           ) AS flown_spend,
           exists(s.coupons, x -> x.cabin = 'BUSINESS') AS has_business_cabin,
           transform(
               filter(s.coupons, x -> x.is_flown AND x.base_fare > 100),
               x -> concat_ws(':', x.origin, x.destination)
           ) AS qualified_routes
    FROM segment_lines s
    LEFT JOIN dim_loyalty_members m
      ON m.passenger_id = s.passenger_id
     AND m.is_active = TRUE
),
scored_lines AS (
    -- Build itinerary labels, fare metrics, and a deterministic first-segment choice.
    SELECT ml.*,
           concat_ws(
               ':', ml.origin, ml.destination,
               lpad(CAST(ml.coupon_pos + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
               array_join(split(ml.booking_channel, '_'), '/')
           ) AS itinerary_code,
           regexp_extract(ml.pnr, '([A-Z]{2})', 1) AS pnr_prefix,
           regexp_replace(ml.pnr, '[^A-Z0-9]', '') AS clean_pnr,
           CASE
               WHEN ml.fare_basis RLIKE 'FLEX' THEN 'flexible'
               WHEN ml.fare_basis RLIKE 'SAVER' THEN 'restricted'
               ELSE 'standard'
           END AS fare_family,
           date_trunc('month', ml.depart_ts) AS travel_month,
           datediff(CAST(ml.depart_ts AS DATE), CAST(ml.booked_at AS DATE)) AS days_advance,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, ml.booked_at, ml.depart_ts) AS hours_before_departure,
           ml.depart_ts + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS segment_cutoff,
           array_join(ml.qualified_routes, '|') AS qualified_route_list,
           sum(ml.base_fare) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ml.passenger_id
               ORDER BY ml.base_fare
               RANGE BETWEEN 150 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_fare_spend,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ml.booking_id
               ORDER BY ml.depart_ts, ml.segment_id
           ) AS first_segment_rank
    FROM member_lines ml
    QUALIFY first_segment_rank = 1
),
promo_lines AS (
    -- Allow a promotion to remain usable for five days after its stated end.
    SELECT sl.*,
           fp.promo_code,
           fp.bonus_points
    FROM scored_lines sl
    LEFT JOIN dim_fare_promotions fp
      ON fp.eligible_tier = sl.loyalty_tier
     AND sl.booked_at BETWEEN fp.starts_at AND fp.ends_at + INTERVAL '5' DAY
),
ledger_rollup AS (
    -- Summarize current-year ledger activity, excluding point reversals.
    SELECT passenger_id,
           sum(points) AS ledger_points,
           count(*) AS ledger_entries,
           max(adjusted_at) AS last_ledger_at
    FROM fct_loyalty_ledger
    WHERE adjusted_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND reason_code <> 'REVERSAL'
    GROUP BY passenger_id
)
SELECT pl.booking_id,
       pl.passenger_id,
       coalesce(pl.member_no, 'UNENROLLED') AS member_no,
       pl.itinerary_code,
       concat_ws('/', pl.pnr_prefix, pl.clean_pnr) AS display_pnr,
       pl.contact_country,
       pl.origin,
       pl.destination,
       pl.cabin,
       CAST(pl.travel_month AS DATE) AS travel_month,
       pl.days_advance,
       pl.hours_before_departure,
       pl.segment_cutoff,
       pl.base_fare,
       pl.nearby_fare_spend,
       pl.flown_spend,
       pl.has_business_cabin,
       pl.qualified_route_list,
       pl.fare_family,
       coalesce(pl.promo_code, 'NO_PROMO') AS promo_code,
       coalesce(pl.bonus_points, 0) + coalesce(lr.ledger_points, 0) AS net_loyalty_points,
       coalesce(lr.ledger_entries, 0) AS ledger_entries
FROM promo_lines pl
LEFT JOIN ledger_rollup lr
  ON lr.passenger_id = pl.passenger_id
ORDER BY pl.depart_ts, pl.booking_id

WITH plan_dim AS (
    -- Decode active plan entitlements stored in the feature map.
    SELECT
        plan_id,
        monthly_fee,
        voice_overage_rate,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(plan_name), '[ _-]+', ' ') AS plan_name_norm,
        ELEMENT_AT(feature_limits, 'VOICE_MIN') AS voice_min_cap,
        ELEMENT_AT(feature_limits, 'SMS_CAP') AS sms_cap,
        COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(feature_limits, 'DATA_GB'), 0) AS data_gb_cap,
        SIZE(MAP_KEYS(feature_limits)) AS feature_count
    FROM rate_plan
    WHERE active_flag = TRUE
),
call_prep AS (
    -- Keep ratable events and normalize JSON devices and dialing prefixes.
    SELECT
        call_id,
        acct_id,
        call_ts,
        UNIX_TIMESTAMP(call_ts) AS call_epoch,
        usage_type,
        cell_id,
        COALESCE(duration_sec, 0) AS duration_sec,
        COALESCE(data_kb, 0) AS data_kb,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(called_number, '^\\+([0-9]+)-', 1) AS country_prefix,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            COALESCE(attrs.device_model, 'UNKNOWN'), '[ _-]+', ' '
        ) AS device_model,
        COALESCE(attrs.roaming, FALSE) AS is_roaming
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdr.*,
            FROM_JSON(
                attributes_json,
                'STRUCT<device_model:STRING,roaming:BOOLEAN>'
            ) AS attrs
        FROM call_detail_record cdr
        WHERE call_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
          AND call_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00'
          AND call_status RLIKE '^(COMPLETED|PARTIAL)$'
    ) x
),
call_enriched AS (
    -- Attach subscriber geography and calculate a numeric RANGE window.
    SELECT
        o.call_id,
        o.acct_id,
        o.call_epoch,
        o.usage_type,
        o.cell_id,
        o.duration_sec,
        o.data_kb,
        o.country_prefix,
        o.device_model,
        o.is_roaming,
        a.region,
        COALESCE(c.technology, 'UNKNOWN') AS radio_tech,
        SUM(o.duration_sec) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.acct_id
            ORDER BY o.call_epoch
            RANGE BETWEEN 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_24h_duration_sec
    FROM call_prep o
    JOIN subscriber_acct a
      ON a.acct_id = o.acct_id
     AND a.acct_status = 'ACTIVE'
    LEFT JOIN network_cell c
      ON c.cell_id = o.cell_id
     AND c.is_decommissioned = FALSE
),
acct_usage AS (
    -- Build account measures, including filtered and distinct aggregates.
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        region,
        COUNT(*) AS rated_events,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE radio_tech = 'UNKNOWN') AS unknown_radio_events,
        SUM(duration_sec) FILTER (WHERE usage_type = 'VOICE') AS voice_seconds,
        SUM(data_kb) FILTER (WHERE usage_type = 'DATA') AS data_kb,
        SUM(DISTINCT duration_sec) FILTER (WHERE usage_type = 'VOICE')
            AS distinct_voice_duration_sum,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cell_id) AS cells_used,
        MAX(rolling_24h_duration_sec) AS peak_rolling_24h_duration_sec,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_roaming = TRUE AND country_prefix <> '1'
        ) AS intl_roaming_events,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(device_model)) AS device_models
    FROM call_enriched
    GROUP BY acct_id, region
),
usage_pivot AS (
    -- Spread the string usage types into event-count measures.
    SELECT acct_id, voice_calls, sms_messages, data_sessions
    FROM (
        SELECT acct_id, usage_type
        FROM call_enriched
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        COUNT(*)
        FOR usage_type IN (
            'VOICE' AS voice_calls,
            'SMS' AS sms_messages,
            'DATA' AS data_sessions
        )
    )
)
SELECT
    a.acct_id,
    a.region,
    COALESCE(v.voice_calls, 0) AS voice_calls,
    COALESCE(v.sms_messages, 0) AS sms_messages,
    COALESCE(v.data_sessions, 0) AS data_sessions,
    COALESCE(u.rated_events, 0) AS rated_events,
    COALESCE(u.voice_seconds, 0) AS voice_seconds,
    COALESCE(u.data_kb, 0) AS data_kb,
    u.distinct_voice_duration_sum,
    COALESCE(u.cells_used, 0) AS cells_used,
    u.peak_rolling_24h_duration_sec,
    COALESCE(u.intl_roaming_events, 0) AS intl_roaming_events,
    u.device_models,
    p.plan_name_norm,
    p.feature_count,
    CASE
        WHEN u.acct_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_USAGE'
        WHEN COALESCE(u.voice_seconds, 0) > p.voice_min_cap * 60
            THEN 'VOICE_OVERAGE'
        WHEN COALESCE(u.data_kb, 0) > p.data_gb_cap * 1024 * 1024
            THEN 'DATA_OVERAGE'
        WHEN u.intl_roaming_events > 0 THEN 'ROAMING_REVIEW'
        ELSE 'WITHIN_PLAN'
    END AS usage_flag,
    ROUND(
        p.monthly_fee
        + CASE
            WHEN u.voice_seconds > p.voice_min_cap * 60 THEN
                (u.voice_seconds - p.voice_min_cap * 60) / 60.0
                * p.voice_overage_rate
            ELSE 0.0
          END
        + CASE
            WHEN u.data_kb > p.data_gb_cap * 1024 * 1024 THEN 5.0
            ELSE 0.0
          END,
        2
    ) AS estimated_charge,
    NTILE(3) OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(u.voice_seconds, 0) DESC, a.acct_id
    ) AS activity_tile,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(u.voice_seconds, 0) DESC, a.acct_id
    ) AS usage_rank
FROM subscriber_acct a
JOIN plan_dim p ON p.plan_id = a.plan_id
LEFT JOIN acct_usage u ON u.acct_id = a.acct_id
LEFT JOIN usage_pivot v ON v.acct_id = a.acct_id
WHERE a.acct_status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY activity_tile, a.acct_id

WITH stg_auth AS (
    -- Parse device evidence and map-based risk annotations from each authorization version.
    SELECT
        auth_id,
        card_id,
        merchant_id,
        auth_ts,
        ingest_ts,
        status,
        amount,
        channel,
        get_json_object(device_payload, '$.device_id') AS device_id,
        CAST(get_json_object(device_payload, '$.is_contactless') AS BOOLEAN) AS is_contactless,
        element_at(risk_flags, 'rule_code') AS rule_code,
        size(map_keys(risk_flags)) AS risk_flag_key_count
    FROM fct_card_authorizations
),
deduped_auth AS (
    -- Retain the latest ingested version of each authorization, with a deterministic tie-breaker.
    SELECT
        auth_id,
        card_id,
        merchant_id,
        auth_ts,
        status,
        amount,
        channel,
        device_id,
        is_contactless,
        rule_code,
        risk_flag_key_count
    FROM stg_auth
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY auth_id
        ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, auth_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
scoped_auth AS (
    -- Add card and merchant context, then anti-join authorizations inside effective block windows.
    SELECT
        a.auth_id,
        a.card_id,
        a.auth_ts,
        a.status,
        a.amount,
        a.channel,
        a.device_id,
        a.is_contactless,
        a.rule_code,
        a.risk_flag_key_count,
        c.customer_id,
        c.product_code,
        c.risk_tier,
        m.merchant_category,
        m.country_code AS merchant_country
    FROM deduped_auth a
    INNER JOIN dim_cards c
        ON c.card_id = a.card_id
    INNER JOIN dim_merchants m
        ON m.merchant_id = a.merchant_id
    LEFT JOIN stg_card_blocks b
        ON b.card_id = a.card_id
       AND a.auth_ts BETWEEN b.block_start AND b.block_end + INTERVAL '1' HOUR
    WHERE b.card_id IS NULL
),
daily_card_activity AS (
    -- Produce daily approval, decline, contactless, channel, and risk-rule KPIs per card.
    SELECT
        card_id,
        to_date(auth_ts) AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_auth_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DECLINED') AS declined_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_contactless = TRUE) AS contactless_count,
        round(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED'), 2) AS approved_amount,
        array_sort(collect_set(channel)) AS channel_mix,
        size(collect_set(rule_code)) AS triggered_rule_count
    FROM scoped_auth
    GROUP BY card_id, to_date(auth_ts)
),
activity_with_history AS (
    -- Attach customer reporting keys and spend from the two preceding observed activity rows.
    SELECT
        d.card_id,
        d.activity_date,
        d.total_auth_count,
        d.approved_count,
        d.declined_count,
        d.contactless_count,
        d.channel_mix,
        d.triggered_rule_count,
        c.customer_id,
        c.product_code,
        coalesce(
            SUM(d.approved_amount) OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.card_id
                ORDER BY d.activity_date
                ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
            ),
            CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        ) AS prior_2_day_approved_amount
    FROM daily_card_activity d
    INNER JOIN dim_cards c
        ON c.card_id = d.card_id
)
-- Publish a long-format KPI feed; SQL UNPIVOT omits any NULL metric values.
SELECT
    card_id,
    customer_id,
    activity_date,
    metric_name,
    metric_value,
    prior_2_day_approved_amount,
    channel_mix
FROM activity_with_history
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
        total_auth_count,
        approved_count,
        declined_count,
        contactless_count
    )
)
ORDER BY card_id, activity_date, metric_name

/*
  SaaS feature-adoption review for the March 2025 success meeting.
  Combines entitled accounts, active flag rollouts, daily product metrics,
  and billing transactions; disputed accounts are intentionally excluded.
*/
with acct_scope as (
    select a.acct_id, a.acct_name, a.region_cd, a.monthly_commit_usd,
           timestampdiff(day, a.activated_at, timestamp '2025-04-01 00:00:00') as acct_age_days,
           coalesce(nullif(a.success_owner, ''), 'unassigned') as success_owner,
           case
               when a.monthly_commit_usd is null then 'UNCONTRACTED'
               when a.monthly_commit_usd >= 1500 then 'ENTERPRISE'
               when a.monthly_commit_usd >= 500 then 'GROWTH'
               else 'STARTER'
           end as contract_segment
    from tenant_accounts a
    where a.status = 'ACTIVE'
      and a.activated_at <= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00' - interval '30' day
      and exists (
          select 1 from feature_rollouts r
          where r.acct_id = a.acct_id
            and r.enabled_at <= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
            and r.rollout_pct >= 50
            and (r.disabled_at is null or r.disabled_at > timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00')
      )
      and not exists (
          select 1 from invoice_txn i
          where i.acct_id = a.acct_id and i.txn_status = 'DISPUTED'
      )
),
usage_long as (
    -- Normalize metric names before the string-valued pivot.
    select acct_id, usage_dt, flag_key, metric, metric_value,
           date_trunc('month', cast(usage_dt as timestamp)) as usage_month
    from usage_metric_daily
    where usage_dt >= date '2025-03-01' and usage_dt < date '2025-04-01'
),
metric_pivot as (
    select *
    from usage_long
    pivot (
        sum(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'ACTIVE_USERS' as active_users_total,
            'API_CALLS' as api_calls_total,
            'MINUTES_USED' as minutes_used_total
        )
    )
),
usage_scored as (
    select p.usage_month, p.acct_id, p.usage_dt, p.flag_key,
           r.rollout_id, r.rollout_pct, a.acct_age_days,
           p.active_users_total, p.api_calls_total, p.minutes_used_total,
           datediff(date '2025-03-31', p.usage_dt) as days_to_month_end,
           date_trunc('day', greatest(r.enabled_at, cast(p.usage_dt as timestamp)))
               + interval '36' hour as next_review_at,
           sum(coalesce(p.api_calls_total, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) over w as prev_2d_api_calls,
           avg(p.minutes_used_total) over w as prev_2d_avg_minutes
    from metric_pivot p
    join acct_scope a on a.acct_id = p.acct_id
    join feature_rollouts r
      on r.acct_id = p.acct_id
     and r.flag_key = p.flag_key
     and r.enabled_at <= cast(p.usage_dt as timestamp) + interval '1' day
     and (r.disabled_at is null or r.disabled_at > cast(p.usage_dt as timestamp))
    window w as (
        partition by p.acct_id, p.flag_key
        order by p.usage_dt, concat_ws('|', p.acct_id, p.flag_key, cast(p.usage_dt as string))
        rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
    )
),
invoice_summary as (
    -- Distinct dollar aggregates de-duplicate values repeated by migration jobs.
    select acct_id,
           sum(distinct cast(amount_usd as decimal(18,2))) as distinct_invoice_amt_usd,
           round(avg(distinct coalesce(usage_credit_usd, cast(0 as decimal(10,2)))), 2) as avg_credit_usd,
           count(distinct txn_id) as txn_cnt,
           count(*) filter (where txn_status = 'POSTED') as posted_txn_cnt,
           count(*) filter (where txn_status = 'VOID') as void_txn_cnt
    from invoice_txn
    where invoice_dt >= date '2025-02-01' and invoice_dt <= date '2025-03-31'
    group by acct_id
),
feature_summary as (
    select acct_id,
           array_sort(collect_set(flag_key)) as enabled_flags,
           size(array_sort(collect_set(flag_key))) as enabled_flag_cnt,
           transform(array_sort(collect_set(flag_key)), x -> upper(x)) as flag_labels,
           filter(array_sort(collect_set(flag_key)), x -> x like 'ai_%') as ai_flags,
           exists(array_sort(collect_set(flag_key)), x -> x = 'ai_assist') as has_ai_assist,
           max(usage_dt) as last_usage_dt
    from usage_scored
    group by acct_id
)
select s.acct_id, a.acct_name, a.region_cd, a.contract_segment, a.success_owner,

/*
  Hotel ancillary-revenue review for the March operating meeting.
  Keeps only sellable reservations, validates add-on dates against the stay,
  and compares daily service revenue with property targets and trailing sales.
*/
WITH active_reservations AS (
    SELECT
        b.reservation_id,
        b.hotel_id,
        b.guest_id,
        b.check_in,
        b.nights,
        b.add_ons,
        b.guest_profile.loyalty_tier AS loyalty_tier,
        b.guest_profile.home_country AS home_country,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(b.confirmation_code, '^HTL-([A-Z]+)-', 1) AS booking_region,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(b.channel, '[[:space:]]+', '_') AS normalized_channel,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM stg_reservation_bookings b2
            WHERE b2.hotel_id = b.hotel_id
              AND b2.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_OUT')
        ) AS hotel_active_reservation_count,
        TRANSFORM(
            FILTER(b.add_ons, x -> x.amount > CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),
            x -> UPPER(x.service_code)
        ) AS paid_service_codes
    FROM stg_reservation_bookings b
    JOIN dim_hotels h
      ON h.hotel_id = b.hotel_id
     AND h.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_OUT')
      AND b.confirmation_code RLIKE '^HTL-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+$'
      AND b.check_in BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
),
exploded_services AS (
    -- LATERAL VIEW intentionally removes reservations without add-ons.
    SELECT
        ar.reservation_id,
        ar.hotel_id,
        ar.check_in,
        ar.nights,
        item.service_code AS service_code,
        item.service_date AS service_date,
        item.amount AS amount
    FROM active_reservations ar
    LATERAL VIEW explode(ar.add_ons) AS item
    WHERE item.amount IS NOT NULL
      AND item.service_date >= ar.check_in
      AND item.service_date < DATE_ADD(ar.check_in, ar.nights)
),
hotel_service_summary AS (
    SELECT
        hotel_id,
        SUM(DISTINCT amount) AS distinct_addon_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT service_code) AS distinct_service_types,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(service_code)) AS service_catalog
    FROM exploded_services
    GROUP BY hotel_id
),
service_daily AS (
    SELECT
        hotel_id,
        service_date,
        SUM(amount) AS gross_service_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT reservation_id) AS paying_reservations,
        SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hotel_id
            ORDER BY service_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS trailing_service_revenue,
        AVG(SUM(amount)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hotel_id
            ORDER BY service_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS trailing_service_avg
    FROM exploded_services
    GROUP BY hotel_id, service_date
),
metric_pivot AS (
    -- Targets arrive as long-form strings in the operations feed.
    SELECT hotel_id, occupancy_target, adr_target, revpar_target
    FROM stg_hotel_performance_metrics
    PIVOT (
        MAX(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'OCCUPANCY_TARGET' AS occupancy_target,
            'ADR_TARGET' AS adr_target,
            'REVPAR_TARGET' AS revpar_target
        )
    )
),
service_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        hotel_id,
        service_date,
        SUM(gross_service_revenue) AS service_revenue,
        SUM(paying_reservations) AS paying_reservation_days,
        GROUPING(service_date) AS is_hotel_total,
        GROUPING_ID(hotel_id, service_date) AS grouping_level
    FROM service_daily
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (hotel_id, service_date),
        (hotel_id)
    )
)
SELECT
    r.hotel_id,
    h.hotel_name,
    h.city,
    r.service_date,
    CASE WHEN r.is_hotel_total = 1 THEN 'HOTEL_TOTAL' ELSE 'DAILY' END AS revenue_grain,
    r.service_revenue,
    r.paying_reservation_days,
    d.trailing_service_revenue,
    d.trailing_service_avg,
    p.occupancy_target,
    p.adr_target,
    p.revpar_target,
    s.distinct_addon_revenue,
    s.distinct_service_types,
    ARRAY_JOIN(s.service_catalog, ',') AS service_catalog
FROM service_rollup r
JOIN dim_hotels h ON h.hotel_id = r.hotel_id
JOIN hotel_service_summary s ON s.hotel_id = r.hotel_id
LEFT JOIN metric_pivot p ON p.hotel_id = r.hotel_id
LEFT JOIN service_daily d
  ON d.hotel_id = r.hotel_id
 AND d.service_date = r.service_date
 AND r.grouping_level = 0
ORDER BY r.hotel_id, r.grouping_level DESC, r.service_date

WITH campaign_base AS (
    -- Keep established campaigns and normalize their JSON, array, and map attributes.
    SELECT camp.campaign_id, camp.creator_id, camp.campaign_name, camp.category, camp.goal_amount,
           FROM_JSON(camp.metadata_json,
                     'STRUCT<video_url:STRING,featured:BOOLEAN,review_score:DOUBLE>') AS metadata,
           TRANSFORM(camp.reward_tags, tag -> LOWER(tag)) AS normalized_tags,
           FILTER(camp.reward_tags, tag -> tag IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(tag) >= 5) AS meaningful_tags,
           EXISTS(camp.reward_tags, tag -> LOWER(tag) = 'early_bird') AS has_early_bird,
           ELEMENT_AT(camp.channel_budgets, 'community') AS community_budget,
           MAP_KEYS(camp.channel_budgets) AS budget_channels,
           MAP_VALUES(camp.channel_budgets) AS budget_amounts
    FROM campaign_profiles camp
    WHERE camp.launched_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND camp.goal_amount >= CAST(5000 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
),
touch_gaps AS (
    -- Find the previous genuine touch for each backer within each campaign.
    SELECT touch.touch_id, touch.backer_id, touch.campaign_id, touch.touched_at, touch.touch_type,
           LAG(touch.touched_at, 1) OVER (
               PARTITION BY touch.backer_id, touch.campaign_id
               ORDER BY touch.touched_at, touch.touch_id
           ) AS previous_touch_at
    FROM backer_touchpoints touch
    JOIN campaign_base camp ON camp.campaign_id = touch.campaign_id
    WHERE touch.touch_type <> 'bot_test'
),
touch_sessions AS (
    -- Start a new session after thirty minutes and number sessions cumulatively.
    SELECT gaps.*,
           SUM(CASE
                   WHEN gaps.previous_touch_at IS NULL
                     OR gaps.touched_at > gaps.previous_touch_at + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END) OVER (
               PARTITION BY gaps.backer_id, gaps.campaign_id
               ORDER BY gaps.touched_at, gaps.touch_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_seq
    FROM touch_gaps gaps
),
session_summary AS (
    -- Summarize distinct backer sessions and observed touch types per campaign.
    SELECT sess.campaign_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(':', sess.backer_id,
                                    CAST(sess.session_seq AS STRING))) AS session_count,
           ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(sess.touch_type)) AS touch_types
    FROM touch_sessions sess
    GROUP BY sess.campaign_id
),
pledge_enriched AS (
    -- Add pledge windows, peer rankings, and retain each backer's latest pledge.
    SELECT pledge.pledge_id, pledge.campaign_id, pledge.backer_id, pledge.pledged_at,
           pledge.amount, pledge.status, pledge.payment_method, camp.has_early_bird,
           LAG(pledge.amount, 2, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) OVER (
               PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id ORDER BY pledge.pledged_at, pledge.pledge_id
           ) AS amount_two_back,
           LEAD(pledge.amount, 1, pledge.amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id ORDER BY pledge.pledged_at, pledge.pledge_id
           ) AS next_amount,
           SUM(pledge.amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id ORDER BY pledge.pledged_at
               RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS rolling_48h_amount,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id ORDER BY pledge.amount DESC, pledge.pledge_id
           ) AS amount_dense_rank,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id ORDER BY pledge.amount, pledge.pledge_id
           ) AS amount_percentile,
           NTILE(3) OVER (
               PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id ORDER BY pledge.amount DESC, pledge.pledge_id
           ) AS amount_tercile
    FROM pledge_ledger pledge
    JOIN campaign_base camp ON camp.campaign_id = pledge.campaign_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY pledge.campaign_id, pledge.backer_id
                ORDER BY pledge.pledged_at DESC, pledge.pledge_id DESC
            ) = 1
),
campaign_rollup AS (
    -- Combine funded and review-worthy pledges, then calculate campaign KPIs.
    SELECT ps.campaign_id, ps.segment,
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS pledge_count,
           CAST(COALESCE(SUM(ps.amount) FILTER (WHERE ps.status = 'succeeded'),
                         CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS DOUBLE) AS gross_amount,
           CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ps.backer_id) AS DOUBLE) AS unique_backers,
           CAST(COALESCE(sess.session_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS session_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.status = 'succeeded') AS confirmed_pledges,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.status = 'refunded') AS refunded_pledges,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.amount_tercile = 1) AS top_tercile_pledges,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.amount > ps.amount_two_back) AS increasing_pledges,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.amount > ps.next_amount) AS above_next_pledges,
           ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(COALESCE(ps.payment_method, 'unknown'))) AS payment_methods,
           ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_LIST(DISTINCT ps.status)) AS observed_statuses,
           MAX(ps.amount_percentile) AS amount_percentile_peak,
           MIN(ps.amount_dense_rank) AS best_amount_rank,
           MAX(ps.rolling_48h_amount) AS max_rolling_48h_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT enriched.*, 'confirmed' AS segment
        FROM pledge_enriched enriched
        WHERE enriched.status = 'succeeded'
          AND enriched.amount >= CAST(30 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        UNION ALL
        SELECT enriched.*, 'needs_review' AS segment
        FROM pledge_enriched enriched
        WHERE enriched.status <> 'succeeded'
           OR enriched.amount < CAST(30 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
    ) ps
    LEFT JOIN session_summary sess ON sess.campaign_id = ps.campaign_id
    GROUP BY ps.campaign_id, ps.segment, sess.session_count
)
-- Reshape the headline KPIs into a long campaign-segment health report.
SELECT camp.campaign_id, camp.campaign_name, camp.metadata.video_url AS video_url,
       roll.segment, metric_name, metric_value,
       roll.confirmed_pledges, roll.refunded_pledges, roll.top_tercile_pledges,
       roll.increasing_pledges, roll.above_next_pledges,
       roll.payment_methods, roll.observed_statuses,
       ROUND(roll.amount_percentile_peak, 4) AS amount_percentile_peak,
       roll.best_amount_rank, roll.max_rolling_48h_amount,
       COALESCE(camp.community_budget, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS community_budget,
       camp.meaningful_tags, sess.touch_types
FROM campaign_rollup roll
JOIN campaign_base camp ON camp.campaign_id = roll.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sess2.campaign_id, sess2.touch_types FROM session_summary sess2
) sess ON sess.campaign_id = roll.campaign_id
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric_name IN (pledge_count, gross_amount, unique_backers, session_count)
)

        m.winery_id,

        w.region_code,
        m.carrier_code,
        m.shipped_at,
        m.promised_at,
        m.delivered_at,
        m.status,
        m.case_count,
        m.distance_km,
        m.bottle_value,
        w.delivery_profile.country as destination_country,
        w.delivery_profile.bonded as bonded_destination,
        coalesce(sw.service_tier, 'UNMAPPED') as service_tier,
        concat_ws(
            ':', 'WINE', w.region_code,
            lpad(cast(m.shipment_id as string), 6, '0'),
            upper(m.carrier_code)
        ) as tracking_ref,
        array_join(
            filter(
                transform(split(m.route_code, '-'), x -> upper(trim(x))),
                x -> x <> ''
            ),
            '/'
        ) as route_path,
        date_trunc('month', m.shipped_at) as ship_month,
        datediff(m.promised_at, m.shipped_at) as days_to_promise,
        case
            when m.status = 'DELIVERED'
            then datediff(m.delivered_at, m.shipped_at)
            else datediff(m.promised_at + interval '2' day, m.shipped_at)
        end as service_days,
        timestampdiff(
            hour, m.shipped_at,
            coalesce(m.delivered_at, m.promised_at + interval '2' day)
        ) as transit_hours,
        m.linehaul_cost,
        m.handling_cost,
        m.insurance_cost
    from shipment_manifest m
    join winery_accounts w
        on w.winery_id = m.winery_id
       and w.active_flag = true
    left join service_windows sw
        on sw.carrier_code = m.carrier_code
       and m.shipped_at between sw.starts_at and sw.ends_at + interval '36' hour
    where m.status <> 'DRAFT'
),
scan_metrics as (
    -- summarize scan quality and delay evidence per shipment
    select
        shipment_id,
        count(*) filter (where scan_type = 'DELAY') as delay_scans,
        sum(case when temperature_c >= 8 then 1 else 0 end) as hot_scans,
        round(
            100.0 * sum(case when temperature_c >= 8 then 1 else 0 end) / count(*),
            2
        ) as hot_scan_pct,
        max(scanned_at) as last_scan_at
    from delivery_scans
    group by shipment_id
),
cost_rows as (
    -- turn the three invoice amount columns into component rows
    select shipment_id, cost_component, cost_value
    from dispatch_base
    unpivot (
        cost_value for cost_component in (
            linehaul_cost,
            handling_cost,
            insurance_cost
        )
    )
),
cost_metrics as (
    -- price each shipment while retaining the count of populated components
    select

        round(sum(cost_value), 2) as total_cost,

    from cost_rows
    group by shipment_id

           captured_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS count_valid_until,
           on_hand_units, reserved_units, backroom_units,
           location.storage_zone, location.aisle_code,
           element_at(quality_scores, 'source_grade') AS source_grade,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(supplier_code, ''), 'UNASSIGNED') AS supplier_code
    FROM (
        SELECT s.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY store_id, sku
                   ORDER BY captured_at DESC, snapshot_id DESC
               ) AS recency_rank
        FROM stg_inventory_snapshots s
        WHERE snapshot_status = 'VALID'
          AND captured_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '7' DAY
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
stock_components AS (

    SELECT store_id, sku, snapshot_id, captured_at, count_valid_until,
           storage_zone, aisle_code, source_grade, supplier_code,
           stock_component, component_units
    FROM latest_inventory

        component_units FOR stock_component IN
            (on_hand_units, reserved_units, backroom_units)
    )
),
stock_rollup AS (

           MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at,
           MAX(count_valid_until) AS count_valid_until,
           MAX(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', captured_at) AS DATE)) AS snapshot_day,
           MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, captured_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 12:00:00')) AS snapshot_age_hours,
           MAX(storage_zone) AS storage_zone,
           MAX(aisle_code) AS aisle_code,
           MAX(source_grade) AS source_grade,
           MAX(supplier_code) AS supplier_code,
           SUM(CASE WHEN stock_component = 'on_hand_units' THEN component_units ELSE 0 END) AS on_hand_units,
           SUM(CASE WHEN stock_component = 'reserved_units' THEN component_units ELSE 0 END) AS reserved_units,
           SUM(CASE WHEN stock_component = 'backroom_units' THEN component_units ELSE 0 END) AS backroom_units
    FROM stock_components
    GROUP BY store_id, sku, snapshot_id
),
daily_demand AS (
    -- Numeric day offsets support a deterministic three-row calendar-day frame.
    SELECT store_id, sku, sale_day, day_offset, daily_units,
           ROUND(AVG(daily_units) OVER (
               PARTITION BY store_id, sku
               ORDER BY day_offset RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ), 2) AS rolling_3d_avg_units,
           SUM(daily_units) OVER (
               PARTITION BY store_id, sku
               ORDER BY day_offset RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS rolling_3d_units,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY store_id, sku ORDER BY sale_day DESC
           ) AS demand_recency
    FROM (

               DATE_TRUNC('DAY', event_ts) AS sale_day,
               DATEDIFF(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', event_ts), DATE '2025-03-01') AS day_offset,
               SUM(units_sold) AS daily_units

    PIVOT (
        FIRST(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'SPOILAGE_UNITS' AS spoilage_units,
            'SOLD_UNITS' AS sold_units
        )
    )
),
proposal_options AS (

           MAX(item.suggested_units) AS max_suggested_units,
           MIN(item.lead_hours) AS fastest_lead_hours
    FROM stg_replenishment_reviews r
    LATERAL VIEW explode(r.proposals) AS item
    WHERE r.review_status = 'APPROVED'
